fm/fm1-p2-10-0.mp3.text: Not until the legal team signs off.

fm/fm1-p2-10-1.mp3.text: Most of the staff support it.

fm/fm1-p2-10-2.mp3.text: At the head office in Denver.

fm/fm1-p2-10-q.mp3.text: When should we announce the merger to the staff?

fm/fm1-p2-11-1.mp3.text: At the security desk in the lobby.

fm/fm1-p2-11-q.mp3.text: Where can I pick up my visitor's badge?

fm/fm1-p2-12-0.mp3.text: A demonstration of our new blender.

fm/fm1-p2-12-1.mp3.text: Ms. Ruiz has been keeping track of them.

fm/fm1-p2-12-q.mp3.text: Where are the samples for tomorrow's product demonstration?

fm/fm1-p2-13-q.mp3.text: Where should we set up the registration table?

fm/fm1-p2-14-2.mp3.text: The new shipment hasn't come in yet.

fm/fm1-p2-14-q.mp3.text: Why are the shelves in aisle five empty?

fm/fm1-p2-15-q.mp3.text: Why did Mr. Delgado cancel his subscription?

fm/fm1-p2-16-0.mp3.text: Has she turned in the equipment request form?

fm/fm1-p2-16-2.mp3.text: No, she hasn't met the team.

fm/fm1-p2-16-q.mp3.text: Why hasn't the new hire received her laptop yet?

fm/fm1-p2-17-0.mp3.text: The fair runs for three days.

fm/fm1-p2-17-q.mp3.text: How many brochures should we bring to the trade fair?

fm/fm1-p2-18-0.mp3.text: Turn left at the next corner.

fm/fm1-p2-18-q.mp3.text: How was the turnout at last night's fundraiser?

fm/fm1-p2-19-q.mp3.text: How do I request time off for next month?

fm/fm1-p2-20-0.mp3.text: Did you check the style guide on the shared drive?

fm/fm1-p2-20-1.mp3.text: The report is due on Friday.

fm/fm1-p2-20-q.mp3.text: How should I format the references in this report?

fm/fm1-p2-21-0.mp3.text: The painters are still working in there.

fm/fm1-p2-21-q.mp3.text: Is the new break room open yet?

fm/fm1-p2-22-0.mp3.text: He leased a car last year.

fm/fm1-p2-22-2.mp3.text: I'm reading it as we speak.

fm/fm1-p2-22-q.mp3.text: Did you get a chance to look over the lease agreement?

fm/fm1-p2-23-0.mp3.text: Yes, but on a reduced schedule.

fm/fm1-p2-23-q.mp3.text: Will the shuttle bus be running over the holiday weekend?

fm/fm1-p2-24-1.mp3.text: Only when the machines are running.

fm/fm1-p2-24-2.mp3.text: I'll get you a glass of water.

fm/fm1-p2-24-q.mp3.text: Do we have to wear safety glasses in the lab?

fm/fm1-p2-25-0.mp3.text: The campaign was a big success.

fm/fm1-p2-25-1.mp3.text: Next year's conference is in Chicago.

fm/fm1-p2-25-2.mp3.text: The board votes on it Thursday.

fm/fm1-p2-25-q.mp3.text: Has next year's marketing budget been approved?

fm/fm1-p3-01-01.mp3.text: Hi, Ms. Delgado. This is Victor from Northside Auto Repair. I'm calling about your car.

fm/fm1-p3-01-02.mp3.text: Oh, hi. Is it ready? I was hoping to pick it up after work today.

fm/fm1-p3-01-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, not yet. The brake pads need to be replaced, and the ones for your model are out of stock.

fm/fm1-p3-01-04.mp3.text: Oh no. When do you think they'll come in?

fm/fm1-p3-01-05.mp3.text: Our supplier says Thursday morning. I'm really sorry about the delay.

fm/fm1-p3-01-06.mp3.text: That's a problem. I need a car to get to work for the next two days.

fm/fm1-p3-01-07.mp3.text: I understand. We can lend you one of our courtesy cars free of charge until yours is ready.

fm/fm1-p3-01-08.mp3.text: That would be great. I'll come by around five thirty to pick it up.

fm/fm1-p3-01-09.mp3.text: Perfect. Just remember to bring your driver's license.

fm/fm1-p3-02-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm calling from Carver Engineering. We're planning a staff outing, and I'd like to buy twenty tickets for Saturday evening's performance of The Glass Harbor.

fm/fm1-p3-02-02.mp3.text: Certainly. Let me check what's available. Hmm, the orchestra section is nearly full. I couldn't seat twenty people together there.

fm/fm1-p3-02-03.mp3.text: That's OK. Our budget is seventy dollars a person, so it was probably too expensive anyway.

fm/fm1-p3-02-04.mp3.text: Well, there's plenty of room in the balcony, and those are our cheapest seats.

fm/fm1-p3-02-05.mp3.text: I'd rather not put people way up there, though. Some of our staff have trouble with stairs.

fm/fm1-p3-02-06.mp3.text: I understand. Then I recommend the other section within your budget. It's on the second level, and there's an elevator.

fm/fm1-p3-02-07.mp3.text: Perfect. Let's do that. Also, do you offer any discount for groups?

fm/fm1-p3-02-08.mp3.text: For groups of fifteen or more, we waive the booking fee. I'll e-mail you the tickets once your payment goes through.

fm/fm1-p3-03-01.mp3.text: Morning, Hassan, Pete. Have you seen the forecast? Heavy rain is expected all day tomorrow.

fm/fm1-p3-03-02.mp3.text: Yeah. That's bad news for the Whitfield job. We can't lay patio stones on wet ground.

fm/fm1-p3-03-03.mp3.text: Right. I'm thinking we should move it to Friday and do the tree planting at the Linwood Hotel tomorrow instead. Rain won't hurt that.

fm/fm1-p3-03-04.mp3.text: The thing is, the stone supplier is dropping off the materials at the Whitfields' house tomorrow at eight.

fm/fm1-p3-03-05.mp3.text: Hmm. Can we push the delivery back?

fm/fm1-p3-03-06.mp3.text: I called them earlier. It's already on the truck.

fm/fm1-p3-03-07.mp3.text: OK, then one of you will have to meet the driver there and make sure everything's covered with tarps.

fm/fm1-p3-03-08.mp3.text: I can do that. It's on my way. I'll join the others at the hotel afterward.

fm/fm1-p3-03-09.mp3.text: Great. And I'll call Mrs. Whitfield to let her know about the new schedule.

fm/fm1-p3-04-01.mp3.text: Hello, Ms. Fontaine. This is Gary Okoro from Lexis Translation Services. I'm calling about the instruction manual for your new pressure washer.

fm/fm1-p3-04-02.mp3.text: Hi, Gary. Is the Spanish version still on track for the twentieth?

fm/fm1-p3-04-03.mp3.text: Mostly, yes. But our translators came across several technical terms that aren't in the glossary you sent us.

fm/fm1-p3-04-04.mp3.text: Oh, I see. Our engineers added some new features at the last minute.

fm/fm1-p3-04-05.mp3.text: That explains it. If we guess at the meanings, there might be errors, so we'd rather confirm them with you first.

fm/fm1-p3-04-06.mp3.text: Of course. Could you send me a list of the terms? I'll ask our engineering team to define them.

fm/fm1-p3-04-07.mp3.text: Sure. I'll e-mail it to you this afternoon. If we get the definitions by Monday, we can still meet the deadline.

fm/fm1-p3-04-08.mp3.text: That shouldn't be a problem. I'll make it a priority.

fm/fm1-p3-05-01.mp3.text: Excuse me, are you the owner? I'm Mia Castellano, a location manager with Brightline Productions.

fm/fm1-p3-05-02.mp3.text: Yes, I'm Oscar. What can I do for you?

fm/fm1-p3-05-03.mp3.text: We're shooting a television commercial next month, and our director loves the look of your café. Would you let us film here?

fm/fm1-p3-05-04.mp3.text: Interesting. How long would it take?

fm/fm1-p3-05-05.mp3.text: Just one day. We'd come on a Monday, since I see you're closed then. And of course, we'd pay a location fee.

fm/fm1-p3-05-06.mp3.text: Hmm, Monday is when we get our weekly deliveries and do a deep cleaning.

fm/fm1-p3-05-07.mp3.text: I see. What if we started at noon, after your deliveries arrive? Our crew would also clean up completely before leaving.

fm/fm1-p3-05-08.mp3.text: That might work. Could you send me the details in writing so I can think it over?

fm/fm1-p3-05-09.mp3.text: Absolutely. I'll e-mail you a proposal with the dates and the fee this evening.

fm/fm1-p3-06-01.mp3.text: OK, let's look at the catering numbers for the third quarter. Overall, orders are up about ten percent.

fm/fm1-p3-06-02.mp3.text: That's good news. But one branch is still way behind the others.

fm/fm1-p3-06-03.mp3.text: That's not surprising. That kitchen was closed for three weeks in August for repairs.

fm/fm1-p3-06-04.mp3.text: Right, so we shouldn't read too much into that. But the branch with the next-lowest number concerns me.

fm/fm1-p3-06-05.mp3.text: What about offering free delivery on catering orders over two hundred dollars? We could test it there for a month.

fm/fm1-p3-06-06.mp3.text: I like that. And if it works, we can expand it to every location.

fm/fm1-p3-06-07.mp3.text: Agreed. Kenji, can you draft a flyer for the promotion? I'd like to send it to local businesses near that branch.

fm/fm1-p3-06-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll have a draft ready by Thursday.

fm/fm1-p3-07-01.mp3.text: Hi, welcome to Peak Form Fitness. How can I help you?

fm/fm1-p3-07-02.mp3.text: Hi. My company is sending me to our office in Singapore for three months. Can I put my membership on hold while I'm away?

fm/fm1-p3-07-03.mp3.text: Yes, you can freeze it for up to six months. There's a small fee of ten dollars per month, though.

fm/fm1-p3-07-04.mp3.text: That's fine. It's still much cheaper than canceling and paying the sign-up fee again later.

fm/fm1-p3-07-05.mp3.text: Exactly. I just need you to fill out this form. Could I see your membership card, please?

fm/fm1-p3-07-06.mp3.text: Sure, here it is. When will the freeze begin?

fm/fm1-p3-07-07.mp3.text: It can start on the first of next month. You'll get a confirmation e-mail later today.

fm/fm1-p3-07-08.mp3.text: Great. Oh, and before I go, I'd like to pick up a class schedule for this month.

fm/fm1-p3-07-09.mp3.text: Of course. They're on the table next to the entrance.

fm/fm1-p3-08-01.mp3.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

fm/fm1-p3-08-02.mp3.text: Hi, I work at Halvorsen Consulting on the twelfth floor, but I think I left my ID badge at home. I can't get through the security gate.

fm/fm1-p3-08-03.mp3.text: No problem. I can give you a temporary pass for today. Could I see a photo ID, like a driver's license?

fm/fm1-p3-08-05.mp3.text: Thank you. I'll also need to call your office to confirm that you work there. It's just standard procedure.

fm/fm1-p3-08-06.mp3.text: Of course. You can ask for our receptionist, Linda.

fm/fm1-p3-08-07.mp3.text: OK, she's confirmed it. Here's your pass. Please return it to this desk before you leave this evening.

fm/fm1-p3-08-08.mp3.text: I will. Thanks so much for your help.

fm/fm1-p3-09-01.mp3.text: Hi, Sam. Have you signed up for Community Service Day yet? The deadline is Friday.

fm/fm1-p3-09-02.mp3.text: Not yet. I just looked at the options, but I'll be at the sales conference in Chicago until the twelfth.

fm/fm1-p3-09-03.mp3.text: Oh, so the first two activities are out for you.

fm/fm1-p3-09-04.mp3.text: Right. I was thinking about the home repair project. I've always wanted to try something like that.

fm/fm1-p3-09-05.mp3.text: Actually, I heard that one requires construction experience. They're renovating a kitchen for a local family.

fm/fm1-p3-09-06.mp3.text: Hmm, I've never done anything like that. I guess I'll choose the remaining one, then.

fm/fm1-p3-09-07.mp3.text: Good choice. By the way, the company is providing T-shirts for all volunteers. Just enter your size on the sign-up form.

fm/fm1-p3-09-08.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll fill it out this afternoon.

fm/fm1-p3-10-01.mp3.text: Hi, this is Teresa Novak, the office manager at Fairmount Insurance. Your company takes care of the plants in our office.

fm/fm1-p3-10-02.mp3.text: Yes, Ms. Novak. This is Derek at GreenSpace Interiors. Is something wrong?

fm/fm1-p3-10-03.mp3.text: Well, several of the plants by the windows in our conference room have brown leaves. Some of them look like they're dying.

fm/fm1-p3-10-04.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. That room probably gets too much direct sunlight in the summer, and those plants may not be suited to it.

fm/fm1-p3-10-05.mp3.text: I see. What do you recommend?

fm/fm1-p3-10-06.mp3.text: I can replace them with varieties that handle bright light better. Since that's covered by your service contract, there won't be any additional charge.

fm/fm1-p3-10-07.mp3.text: That's good to hear. When could someone come by?

fm/fm1-p3-10-08.mp3.text: Our technician, Anita, will be in your area on Wednesday. I'll ask her to bring a few samples so you can choose.

fm/fm1-p3-11-01.mp3.text: Luis, are we all set to record this week's episode of the company podcast? Our guest, Dr. Amrita Sen, should be here at ten.

fm/fm1-p3-11-02.mp3.text: Almost. The studio's main microphone started making a buzzing sound yesterday, so I've ordered a replacement.

fm/fm1-p3-11-04.mp3.text: Not until tomorrow. But I can borrow one from the video team. It's not quite as good, but listeners probably won't notice.

fm/fm1-p3-11-05.mp3.text: OK. Also, Dr. Sen's assistant called. She has to leave by eleven to catch a flight.

fm/fm1-p3-11-06.mp3.text: Hmm, these interviews usually run close to an hour, and we haven't even done a sound check.

fm/fm1-p3-11-07.mp3.text: I'll keep my introduction short and skip a couple of the less important questions.

fm/fm1-p3-11-08.mp3.text: That should help. I'll go set up the borrowed microphone now so we're ready when she walks in.

fm/fm1-p3-12-01.mp3.text: Hi, Ethan. Thanks for stopping by the gallery. I wanted to go over the plans for your exhibition before the opening on the fifteenth.

fm/fm1-p3-12-02.mp3.text: Sure. I brought the final list of my paintings. There are twenty-two in total.

fm/fm1-p3-12-03.mp3.text: Great. Have all of them been framed?

fm/fm1-p3-12-04.mp3.text: Most of them. The framing shop is still working on the four largest ones. They said they'd be done by the twelfth.

fm/fm1-p3-12-05.mp3.text: That's cutting it close. We need about three days to hang everything and adjust the lighting.

fm/fm1-p3-12-06.mp3.text: I know. I could ask the shop to deliver those directly here instead of to my studio. That would save a day.

fm/fm1-p3-12-07.mp3.text: Good idea. Also, our marketing team would like to interview you for our newsletter. Would you have time this week?

fm/fm1-p3-12-08.mp3.text: Sure. Thursday afternoon works best for me.

fm/fm1-p3-13-01.mp3.text: Dr. Ibarra, the alarm on freezer number two went off about twenty minutes ago. The temperature's rising.

fm/fm1-p3-13-02.mp3.text: Oh no. That's where we keep the blood samples for the Hollis study. Kwame, is there room in the other freezers?

fm/fm1-p3-13-03.mp3.text: Freezer three is almost empty. We cleared it out last week for the new project.

fm/fm1-p3-13-04.mp3.text: Good. Let's move everything there right away. Daniel, please write down which shelf each box goes on so nothing gets lost.

fm/fm1-p3-13-05.mp3.text: Will do. Should I call the manufacturer about the broken unit?

fm/fm1-p3-13-06.mp3.text: It's still under warranty, so yes. Ask them to send a technician as soon as possible.

fm/fm1-p3-13-07.mp3.text: I think the problem might be the door seal. I noticed it wasn't closing tightly on Monday.

fm/fm1-p3-13-08.mp3.text: Make sure to mention that when you call, Daniel. It could speed up the repair.

fm/fm1-p4-01-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Lindqvist. This is Monica Reyes from Halverson Moving Services.

fm/fm1-p4-01-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about your move to Oak Ridge this Saturday.

fm/fm1-p4-01-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the large truck we reserved for you was damaged in a minor accident yesterday, and it won't be repaired in time.

fm/fm1-p4-01-04.mp3.text: We have two options for you.

fm/fm1-p4-01-05.mp3.text: We can keep your Saturday date and use two smaller trucks, or we can move you on Sunday with a truck the same size as the original one.

fm/fm1-p4-01-06.mp3.text: Either way, there will be no extra charge.

fm/fm1-p4-01-07.mp3.say: Please call me back at 5 5 5, 0 1 3 6 by five o'clock today so I can finalize the schedule with our crew.
fm/fm1-p4-01-07.mp3.text: Please call me back at 555-0136 by five o'clock today so I can finalize the schedule with our crew.

fm/fm1-p4-02-01.mp3.text: Good morning, members, and welcome to the Fairmont Community Recreation Center.

fm/fm1-p4-02-02.mp3.text: I have an update about today's group fitness classes.

fm/fm1-p4-02-03.mp3.text: Workers are refinishing the floor in Studio A today, so no one will be able to use that room until tomorrow.

fm/fm1-p4-02-04.mp3.text: The morning class scheduled for Studio A will be moved to Studio B, which is free at that time.

fm/fm1-p4-02-05.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the evening class in Studio A has been canceled, since Studio B is already booked for a private event tonight.

fm/fm1-p4-02-07.mp3.text: To thank you for your patience, anyone who stops by the front desk today can pick up a free guest pass for a friend.

fm/fm1-p4-03-01.mp3.text: Has your office started to look a little dull?

fm/fm1-p4-03-02.mp3.text: Brighten it up with GreenDesk, the region's leading office plant rental service.

fm/fm1-p4-03-03.mp3.text: Simply tell us about your space, and our designers will choose plants that suit the lighting and size of each room.

fm/fm1-p4-03-04.mp3.text: Best of all, you never have to worry about keeping them alive.

fm/fm1-p4-03-05.mp3.text: One of our specialists will visit every two weeks to water, trim, and replace any plant that isn't doing well.

fm/fm1-p4-03-06.mp3.text: Studies show that greenery can make employees feel more relaxed and productive.

fm/fm1-p4-03-07.mp3.text: Sign up before the end of March, and your first month of service will be completely free.

fm/fm1-p4-03-08.mp3.text: Visit www.greendesk.example.com to schedule a free consultation.

fm/fm1-p4-04-01.mp3.text: In local news, the long-awaited Elmhurst Station Market will finally open to the public on September fifth.

fm/fm1-p4-04-02.mp3.text: The historic train station, which has been empty since 1998, was purchased by the city three years ago.

fm/fm1-p4-04-03.mp3.text: Construction was supposed to be completed last spring, but workers discovered serious damage to the roof, which took several extra months to repair.

fm/fm1-p4-04-04.mp3.text: When it opens, the market will feature more than forty vendors selling fresh produce, baked goods, and handmade crafts.

fm/fm1-p4-04-05.mp3.text: City officials say there are still a few spaces available for local businesses.

fm/fm1-p4-04-06.mp3.text: Applications for these vendor spaces can be submitted on the city's Web site until August tenth.

fm/fm1-p4-04-07.mp3.text: We'll have more on this story, including an interview with the market's director, after the break.

fm/fm1-p4-05-01.mp3.text: Before we wrap up, there's one more issue I need to raise.

fm/fm1-p4-05-02.mp3.text: Our seafood supplier informed me yesterday that the price of salmon will go up by about thirty percent starting next month.

fm/fm1-p4-05-03.mp3.text: Since the grilled salmon is one of our most popular dinner entrees, this will have a big impact on our costs.

fm/fm1-p4-05-04.mp3.text: We basically have two choices: raise the price of the dish or replace it with something else.

fm/fm1-p4-05-05.mp3.text: Chef Ramos prepared a trout dish for the kitchen staff to try on Tuesday, and the reaction was very positive.

fm/fm1-p4-05-06.mp3.text: I know some of you would like more time to think this over.

fm/fm1-p4-05-07.mp3.text: But the new menus go to the printer on Friday.

fm/fm1-p4-05-08.mp3.text: So please e-mail me your preference by tomorrow afternoon, and I'll announce the final decision on Thursday.

fm/fm1-p4-06-01.mp3.text: Welcome to Channel 8, and thank you for visiting our broadcast center today.

fm/fm1-p4-06-02.mp3.text: My name is Gregory, and I'll be showing you how our programs are produced.

fm/fm1-p4-06-03.mp3.text: Normally, our tours start in the newsroom, but our news team is getting ready for a live broadcast at noon, so we'll stop by there at the end instead.

fm/fm1-p4-06-04.mp3.text: That means we'll begin at the next stop on your route map.

fm/fm1-p4-06-05.mp3.text: Before we go in, I'd like to remind you that you're welcome to take pictures, but please make sure your camera flash is turned off.

fm/fm1-p4-06-06.mp3.text: Bright flashes can interfere with our lighting equipment.

fm/fm1-p4-06-07.mp3.text: Also, at the end of the tour, each of you will receive a Channel 8 coffee mug as a souvenir.

fm/fm1-p4-07-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the final session of the Northern Education Facilities Conference.

fm/fm1-p4-07-02.mp3.text: It's my pleasure to introduce our closing speaker, architect Hannah Moretti.

fm/fm1-p4-07-03.mp3.text: Over the past fifteen years, Ms. Moretti's firm has designed more than thirty schools across the region.

fm/fm1-p4-07-04.mp3.text: Her buildings are known for their use of natural light and solar power, which has helped many school districts cut their energy bills nearly in half.

fm/fm1-p4-07-05.mp3.text: Today, she'll talk about how classroom design can affect the way students learn.

fm/fm1-p4-07-06.mp3.text: After her talk, Ms. Moretti will be signing copies of her new book in the main lobby.

fm/fm1-p4-07-07.mp3.text: Copies are available for purchase at the registration desk.

fm/fm1-p4-07-08.mp3.text: Now, please join me in welcoming Hannah Moretti.

fm/fm1-p4-08-01.mp3.text: Welcome back, everyone. In this session, we'll focus on the project summary, the first page of any grant proposal.

fm/fm1-p4-08-02.mp3.text: Many applicants treat the summary as an afterthought and write it at the last minute.

fm/fm1-p4-08-04.mp3.text: Keep in mind that reviewers have a stack of these on their desks.

fm/fm1-p4-08-05.mp3.text: If your first page doesn't clearly explain what you want to do and why it matters, they may never read the rest.

fm/fm1-p4-08-06.mp3.text: So keep your summary under three hundred words, and state the amount you're requesting in the first paragraph.

fm/fm1-p4-08-07.mp3.text: Now, I've handed out two sample summaries from last year's applicants.

fm/fm1-p4-08-08.mp3.text: Take ten minutes to read them with a partner and decide which one you'd fund, and why.

fm/fm1-p4-09-01.mp3.text: Hi, Ms. Abernathy, it's Victor Lund from Lund Interior Contractors, calling about the lobby renovation at your office building.

fm/fm1-p4-09-02.mp3.text: I just heard from our supplier that the gray marble tile you selected has been discontinued by the manufacturer.

fm/fm1-p4-09-03.mp3.text: They have a few boxes left, but not nearly enough to cover the whole floor.

fm/fm1-p4-09-04.mp3.text: The supplier did recommend a porcelain tile that looks very similar, and it's actually more resistant to scratches, which is a plus for a busy area like a lobby.

fm/fm1-p4-09-05.mp3.text: The only issue is that it has to be shipped from overseas.

fm/fm1-p4-09-06.mp3.text: That would push back our completion date by about a week.

fm/fm1-p4-09-07.mp3.text: I'll bring some samples to your office on Thursday morning so you can compare them in person.

fm/fm1-p4-10-01.mp3.text: You're listening to WKMB Community Radio, and it's time for our weekend events roundup.

fm/fm1-p4-10-02.mp3.text: This Saturday, the Riverside Park Summer Film Festival returns for its sixth year.

fm/fm1-p4-10-03.mp3.text: Three family-friendly movies will be shown on a giant outdoor screen, starting at seven P.M.

fm/fm1-p4-10-04.mp3.text: Admission is free, but seating is not provided, so be sure to bring a blanket or a folding chair.

fm/fm1-p4-10-05.mp3.text: Food trucks will be selling snacks and drinks throughout the evening.

fm/fm1-p4-10-06.mp3.text: Organizers expect a big crowd, so arriving early is a good idea.

fm/fm1-p4-10-07.mp3.text: If it rains, the event will move indoors to the Harmon Community Center on Fifth Street.

fm/fm1-p4-10-08.mp3.say: For more information, call the parks department at 5 5 5, 0 1 7 2.
fm/fm1-p4-10-08.mp3.text: For more information, call the parks department at 555-0172.

fm/fm2-p2-01-1.mp3.text: Mr. Grant has it reserved until noon.

fm/fm2-p2-01-q.mp3.text: Can our team use the company van for the site visit?

fm/fm2-p2-02-1.mp3.text: Yes, I'll call to check on them.

fm/fm2-p2-02-q.mp3.text: Didn't the caterer say they'd be here by eleven?

fm/fm2-p2-03-q.mp3.text: You're presenting at the sales meeting, aren't you?

fm/fm2-p2-04-0.mp3.text: Only if you register at the front office.

fm/fm2-p2-04-q.mp3.text: Isn't the gym in this building open to all tenants?

fm/fm2-p2-05-1.mp3.text: See the figure on page two.

fm/fm2-p2-05-q.mp3.text: The quarterly figures went to headquarters, didn't they?

fm/fm2-p2-06-2.mp3.text: A double room with a view.

fm/fm2-p2-06-q.mp3.text: Shouldn't we confirm the hotel reservation for the clients?

fm/fm2-p2-07-1.mp3.text: It goes on sale before Friday.

fm/fm2-p2-07-q.mp3.text: Haven't you used this editing software before?

fm/fm2-p2-08-0.mp3.text: Afterward, so people can comment on it.

fm/fm2-p2-08-q.mp3.text: Should we hand out the surveys before or after the presentation?

fm/fm2-p2-09-0.mp3.text: Up front, so I can see the slides.

fm/fm2-p2-09-1.mp3.text: The stage was set up yesterday.

fm/fm2-p2-09-2.mp3.text: I'll be back in a minute.

fm/fm2-p2-09-q.mp3.text: Do you want to sit near the stage or in the back?

fm/fm2-p2-10-q.mp3.text: Is the workshop free, or is there a registration fee?

fm/fm2-p2-11-0.mp3.text: The copies are in the tray.

fm/fm2-p2-11-1.mp3.text: Let's see what the technician says first.

fm/fm2-p2-11-q.mp3.text: Should we repair the old copier or lease a new one?

fm/fm2-p2-12-2.mp3.text: The last bus leaves at ten.

fm/fm2-p2-12-q.mp3.text: Would you rather present first or last?

fm/fm2-p2-13-2.mp3.text: Actually, the regional manager stepped in.

fm/fm2-p2-13-q.mp3.text: Is Kendra or Paul handling the client's complaint?

fm/fm2-p2-14-0.mp3.text: I'll take the stairs to the third floor.

fm/fm2-p2-14-2.mp3.text: You should let the front desk know.

fm/fm2-p2-14-q.mp3.text: The vending machine on the third floor took my money.

fm/fm2-p2-15-0.mp3.text: Your bag is on the shelf.

fm/fm2-p2-15-1.mp3.text: Security can give you a temporary one.

fm/fm2-p2-15-q.mp3.text: I think I left my badge at home today.

fm/fm2-p2-16-2.mp3.text: Then we should send it out more often.

fm/fm2-p2-16-q.mp3.text: Our website traffic doubled after the newsletter went out.

fm/fm2-p2-17-1.mp3.text: I heard it on the radio.

fm/fm2-p2-17-2.mp3.text: Maybe we should try a different one.

fm/fm2-p2-17-q.mp3.text: We still haven't heard back from the landscaping company.

fm/fm2-p2-18-2.mp3.text: Could she give her talk by video?

fm/fm2-p2-18-q.mp3.text: The keynote speaker's flight was canceled.

fm/fm2-p2-19-2.mp3.text: Yes, the report was very long.

fm/fm2-p2-19-q.mp3.text: These sales figures don't match the ones in my report.

fm/fm2-p2-20-1.mp3.text: Yes, I know the workshop well.

fm/fm2-p2-20-q.mp3.text: Do you know if Ms. Barros is coming to the workshop?

fm/fm2-p2-21-q.mp3.text: Could you send me the minutes from Tuesday's meeting?

fm/fm2-p2-22-2.mp3.text: Of course not. Just leave me a key.

fm/fm2-p2-22-q.mp3.text: Would you mind watering my plants while I'm away?

fm/fm2-p2-23-q.mp3.text: Could you tell me where the fitting rooms are?

fm/fm2-p2-24-2.mp3.text: I'd like a larger size, please.

fm/fm2-p2-24-q.mp3.text: Why don't we move the training to a larger room?

fm/fm2-p2-25-0.mp3.text: I'll be driving to work that day.

fm/fm2-p2-25-q.mp3.text: I was wondering if I could borrow your parking pass on Friday.

fm/fm2-p3-01-01.mp3.text: Excuse me. I'm repainting my kitchen, and I'd like a gallon of paint in this color. I brought a sample chip from another store.

fm/fm2-p3-01-02.mp3.text: Sure. Our scanner can match almost any color. It only takes a couple of minutes.

fm/fm2-p3-01-03.mp3.text: Great. Also, my kitchen walls get a lot of steam from cooking. Is there a type of paint that holds up better in kitchens?

fm/fm2-p3-01-04.mp3.text: Yes, I'd recommend our semi-gloss finish. It stands up well to moisture, so it's popular for kitchens and bathrooms.

fm/fm2-p3-01-05.mp3.text: That sounds perfect. How much is it?

fm/fm2-p3-01-06.mp3.text: It's thirty-eight dollars a gallon. But if you join our rewards program today, you'll get fifteen percent off this purchase.

fm/fm2-p3-01-07.mp3.text: Sure, why not? What do I need to do?

fm/fm2-p3-01-08.mp3.text: Just type your name and e-mail address into this tablet while I mix your paint.

fm/fm2-p3-02-01.mp3.text: Rosa, the truck from Brennan Foods just pulled into the yard. They weren't supposed to get here until two o'clock.

fm/fm2-p3-02-02.mp3.text: That's almost three hours early. And all four dock doors are busy with the furniture shipment right now.

fm/fm2-p3-02-03.mp3.text: Hi, I'm the Brennan driver. Sorry for showing up early, but traffic was light. I have another pickup across town at one, so I can't wait around too long.

fm/fm2-p3-02-04.mp3.text: I understand. Jake, how long until door two is free?

fm/fm2-p3-02-05.mp3.text: Maybe forty minutes. The crew there is almost finished.

fm/fm2-p3-02-06.mp3.text: OK. Since this load is refrigerated, it has to go straight into cold storage. Jake, could you pull two people from the returns area to help unload once door two opens?

fm/fm2-p3-02-07.mp3.text: Sure, I'll go get them now.

fm/fm2-p3-02-08.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll wait in my truck until you're ready.

fm/fm2-p3-03-01.mp3.text: Martin, have you looked at how the new check-in tablets are working out? Patients are still lining up at the front desk.

fm/fm2-p3-03-02.mp3.text: I have. A lot of our older patients aren't comfortable typing in their insurance details, so they come to the desk anyway.

fm/fm2-p3-03-03.mp3.text: That's what I was afraid of. We spent quite a bit on those tablets.

fm/fm2-p3-03-04.mp3.text: Well, I don't think the tablets themselves are the problem. It's just that nobody shows patients how to use them.

fm/fm2-p3-03-05.mp3.text: You might be right. What if someone stood near the entrance in the mornings to walk people through the process?

fm/fm2-p3-03-06.mp3.text: Our receptionists are already stretched thin.

fm/fm2-p3-03-07.mp3.text: Hmm. Then let's find out if any of our volunteers could help. I'll e-mail the volunteer coordinator this afternoon.

fm/fm2-p3-04-01.mp3.text: Thanks for showing me around, Mr. Dunn. As I mentioned on the phone, we're holding a retirement dinner for our company's founder on May tenth.

fm/fm2-p3-04-02.mp3.text: Congratulations to him. How many guests are you expecting?

fm/fm2-p3-04-03.mp3.text: We sent out a hundred invitations. Seventy people have replied so far, but I'm sure more will.

fm/fm2-p3-04-04.mp3.text: Then you should plan for the full hundred. Will you need a dance floor? If so, it takes up the space of about twenty seats.

fm/fm2-p3-04-05.mp3.text: Yes, we've hired a jazz band, so people will definitely want to dance.

fm/fm2-p3-04-06.mp3.text: All right. The rental fee also includes tables, linens, and a sound system for the band.

fm/fm2-p3-04-07.mp3.text: Perfect. Our budget is tight, so I'll take the smallest room that has enough space for everyone.

fm/fm2-p3-04-08.mp3.text: Sounds good. I'll draw up the contract and e-mail it to you this afternoon.

fm/fm2-p3-05-01.mp3.text: Ms. Abara, I've finished walking through your house, and I think we can list it for sale by the end of the month.

fm/fm2-p3-05-02.mp3.text: That's great news. Do you think I need to make any changes before then?

fm/fm2-p3-05-03.mp3.text: Mostly small things. The living room would look much bigger with some of the furniture removed, and the front door could use a fresh coat of paint.

fm/fm2-p3-05-04.mp3.text: I can handle the painting myself. But where would I put the furniture? I'm living here until June.

fm/fm2-p3-05-05.mp3.text: Many of my clients rent a storage unit for a couple of months. There's one on Pine Road with reasonable rates.

fm/fm2-p3-05-06.mp3.text: Hmm, I'd rather not pay for that. My brother has a garage.

fm/fm2-p3-05-07.mp3.text: Great. Then I'd like to schedule a photographer to take pictures for the listing. How does next Wednesday sound?

fm/fm2-p3-05-08.mp3.text: I'll be at work that day, but I can leave a key with my neighbor so the photographer can get in.

fm/fm2-p3-06-01.mp3.text: Thanks for joining us, Mr. Okonkwo. Hana and I wanted to go over the cover options for your cookbook before we send it to the printer.

fm/fm2-p3-06-02.mp3.text: My pleasure. I have to say, I liked the second design the most, the one with the photo of the market stalls.

fm/fm2-p3-06-03.mp3.text: That's our favorite as well. The only issue is that the photographer is asking for a higher fee than we expected to use that image on a cover.

fm/fm2-p3-06-05.mp3.text: About eight hundred dollars more. That would put us over our design budget.

fm/fm2-p3-06-06.mp3.text: One option is for Hana to recreate a similar scene as an illustration. It would keep the same feel.

fm/fm2-p3-06-07.mp3.text: I like that idea, but would it delay the release? My bookstore tour starts in October.

fm/fm2-p3-06-08.mp3.text: Not at all. I could have a draft ready by Friday.

fm/fm2-p3-07-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like a round-trip ticket to Kestrel Island for today, please.

fm/fm2-p3-07-02.mp3.text: Sure. Will you be bringing that bicycle with you?

fm/fm2-p3-07-03.mp3.text: Yes. I'm meeting some friends there for a cycling tour around the island.

fm/fm2-p3-07-04.mp3.text: Then you'll need to take a sailing that carries bikes. Not all of our boats do.

fm/fm2-p3-07-05.mp3.text: OK. Our tour starts at one o'clock near the terminal on the island, so I need to get there before then.

fm/fm2-p3-07-06.mp3.text: No problem. That'll be fifteen dollars round-trip, plus five for the bicycle.

fm/fm2-p3-07-08.mp3.text: Thank you. And when you come back, keep in mind that the last boat that takes bikes leaves the island at six.

fm/fm2-p3-08-01.mp3.text: Neil, I was reconciling last month's accounts, and it looks like we paid Copperleaf Printing twice for the same invoice.

fm/fm2-p3-08-03.mp3.text: The invoice was e-mailed to both of us, and we each entered it into the payment system. It was a little over three thousand dollars.

fm/fm2-p3-08-04.mp3.text: Oh no. I should have checked whether it had already been entered. Have you contacted Copperleaf yet?

fm/fm2-p3-08-05.mp3.text: Not yet. I wanted to talk to you first. We could ask for a refund, or they could apply the extra payment to our next order.

fm/fm2-p3-08-06.mp3.text: We order brochures from them every quarter, so a credit makes more sense.

fm/fm2-p3-08-07.mp3.text: Agreed. I'll call their billing department this afternoon. And going forward, maybe vendors should send invoices to just one address.

fm/fm2-p3-08-08.mp3.text: Good idea. I'll set up a shared accounts-payable inbox tomorrow.

fm/fm2-p3-09-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm taking the intermediate Spanish class on Tuesday evenings, but I'm finding it a little too difficult. Is it possible to switch to a lower level?

fm/fm2-p3-09-02.mp3.text: Sure. We have a beginner class on Thursdays at seven. It's the same length, eight weeks.

fm/fm2-p3-09-03.mp3.text: Thursdays work for me. Will I have to pay anything extra?

fm/fm2-p3-09-04.mp3.text: No, the tuition is the same, so there's no charge for switching. But you'll need a different textbook.

fm/fm2-p3-09-05.mp3.text: Oh, OK. Do you sell it here?

fm/fm2-p3-09-06.mp3.text: We do. It's twenty-five dollars, and students get ten percent off here at the front desk.

fm/fm2-p3-09-07.mp3.text: Great, then I'll buy one now.

fm/fm2-p3-09-08.mp3.text: Here you go. And I'll let the Thursday instructor know you'll be joining the class.

fm/fm2-p3-10-01.mp3.text: Hi, this is Paul from the IT help desk. You called about a problem in Conference Room B?

fm/fm2-p3-10-02.mp3.text: Yes, thanks for coming so fast. The screen keeps going black whenever I connect my laptop, and I have a video call with a client in Seoul at ten.

fm/fm2-p3-10-03.mp3.text: Let me take a look. Hmm, the cable on this table is damaged. That's probably what's causing it.

fm/fm2-p3-10-05.mp3.text: Not with me. They're kept in the storeroom on the fifth floor, and it might take a while to find the right one.

fm/fm2-p3-10-07.mp3.text: Right. Then let's move you to Room D across the hall. Its system was upgraded last week, and it connects to any laptop wirelessly.

fm/fm2-p3-10-08.mp3.text: That would be perfect. Could you help me connect, though? I've never used a wireless setup.

fm/fm2-p3-10-09.mp3.text: Of course. Bring your laptop, and I'll walk you through it.

fm/fm2-p3-11-01.mp3.text: Felipe, I got the shipping quotes for the pump parts going to our customer in Monterrey. I put them into a chart for you.

fm/fm2-p3-11-02.mp3.text: Thanks. Falcon Freight is the cheapest by a good margin. Can they meet our deadline?

fm/fm2-p3-11-03.mp3.text: That's the problem. They need ten business days, and the customer wants the parts within a week.

fm/fm2-p3-11-04.mp3.text: What about Norrland Cargo? Their price is pretty reasonable, too.

fm/fm2-p3-11-05.mp3.text: Remember, they're the company that damaged our shipment of valves last spring. The customer was really unhappy.

fm/fm2-p3-11-06.mp3.text: Right, I'd forgotten about that. Then let's go with whichever of the other two is less expensive.

fm/fm2-p3-11-07.mp3.text: OK. I'll book it this morning so the parts can go out tomorrow.

fm/fm2-p3-12-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling Horizon Travel. This is Owen.

fm/fm2-p3-12-02.mp3.text: Hi, Owen. My name is Grace Tanaka. I booked a five-day package tour to Lisbon through your agency last week.

fm/fm2-p3-12-03.mp3.text: Yes, Ms. Tanaka, I have your booking right here. How can I help?

fm/fm2-p3-12-04.mp3.text: I'd like to stay one more night at the end of the trip. Could I add a night at the same hotel?

fm/fm2-p3-12-05.mp3.text: Let me check. Yes, they have a room available. It'll be an extra 140 dollars, and I'll move your return flight to the following day.

fm/fm2-p3-12-06.mp3.text: Is there a fee for changing the flight?

fm/fm2-p3-12-07.mp3.text: Normally, there's a fifty-dollar fee, but your package includes one free change.

fm/fm2-p3-12-09.mp3.text: I'll e-mail you an updated itinerary within the hour. Please check that all the details are correct.

fm/fm2-p3-13-01.mp3.text: Dr. Patel, a team from Corvale University has asked to rent time on our electron microscope next month. They'd pay by the hour.

fm/fm2-p3-13-02.mp3.text: That could bring in some useful income. But our own schedule for it is already pretty full, isn't it?

fm/fm2-p3-13-03.mp3.text: It is during the day. But nobody has booked it on Tuesday or Thursday evenings for the past few months.

fm/fm2-p3-13-04.mp3.text: That's good to know, Tomas. Would someone from our staff need to be there with them?

fm/fm2-p3-13-05.mp3.text: Yes, for safety reasons, a trained technician has to supervise every session. I could cover the evenings, as long as it counts as overtime.

fm/fm2-p3-13-06.mp3.text: That's fine. The rental fee should more than cover your extra hours.

fm/fm2-p3-13-07.mp3.text: Great. Then I'll draft an agreement with the evening time slots and the hourly rate.

fm/fm2-p3-13-08.mp3.text: Good. Please send it to our legal department for review before it goes to Corvale.

fm/fm2-p4-01-01.mp3.text: Good morning, passengers, and welcome aboard the Bayline Ferry to Marlow Island.

fm/fm2-p4-01-02.mp3.text: Our crossing today will take approximately forty minutes, and the water is calm, so we expect a smooth ride.

fm/fm2-p4-01-03.mp3.text: Hot and cold drinks, sandwiches, and pastries are available at the snack bar on the lower deck.

fm/fm2-p4-01-04.mp3.text: For your safety, please remain seated while the ferry is leaving the dock.

fm/fm2-p4-01-05.mp3.text: Life jackets can be found under every seat.

fm/fm2-p4-01-06.mp3.text: Please note that passengers are not permitted on the vehicle deck during the trip.

fm/fm2-p4-01-07.mp3.text: Drivers will be asked to return to their cars about ten minutes before we arrive.

fm/fm2-p4-01-08.mp3.text: Thank you for traveling with Bayline, and enjoy the view.

fm/fm2-p4-02-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming, everyone. Let's start by looking at the guest feedback we received last quarter.

fm/fm2-p4-02-02.mp3.text: As you can see, the largest number of complaints was about long waits at check-in.

fm/fm2-p4-02-03.mp3.text: We've already dealt with that by installing self-service kiosks in the lobby, and the lines have gotten much shorter.

fm/fm2-p4-02-04.mp3.text: So today, I'd like to concentrate on the issue that came in second.

fm/fm2-p4-02-05.mp3.text: Our current equipment is over eight years old, and it simply can't handle the number of devices guests bring these days.

fm/fm2-p4-02-06.mp3.text: I've asked two companies to submit proposals for upgrading the system.

fm/fm2-p4-02-07.mp3.text: Before we choose one, I need each department head to tell me which areas of the hotel have the worst problems.

fm/fm2-p4-02-08.mp3.text: Please send me that information by Wednesday.

fm/fm2-p4-03-01.mp3.text: Planning a home improvement project this spring?

fm/fm2-p4-03-02.mp3.text: Before you spend hundreds of dollars on tools you might use only once, stop by the new rental center at Corley Hardware.

fm/fm2-p4-03-03.mp3.text: We rent everything from pressure washers to tile saws, by the hour, the day, or the week.

fm/fm2-p4-03-04.mp3.text: A floor sander, for example, rents for just twenty-five dollars a day.

fm/fm2-p4-03-05.mp3.text: That's less than a dinner for two.

fm/fm2-p4-03-06.mp3.text: And if you're not sure how to use a tool, our staff will give you a free demonstration before you take it home.

fm/fm2-p4-03-07.mp3.text: This month only, show your Corley Rewards card and get your second rental day free.

fm/fm2-p4-03-08.mp3.text: Corley Hardware, on Route 12, next to Pinewood Mall.

fm/fm2-p4-04-01.mp3.text: In local news, the Dunmore Public Library announced today that it will stop charging late fees on overdue books beginning July first.

fm/fm2-p4-04-02.mp3.text: Library director Alan Whitcomb explained that the fees bring in very little money each year, yet they were keeping many residents from using the library at all.

fm/fm2-p4-04-03.mp3.text: Last year, the library tested the policy at two of its seven branches.

fm/fm2-p4-04-04.mp3.text: According to Mr. Whitcomb, books at those branches were actually returned sooner on average than before.

fm/fm2-p4-04-05.mp3.text: Patrons will still have to pay for items that are lost or damaged.

fm/fm2-p4-04-06.mp3.text: In addition, any fines that residents currently owe will be cleared, as long as they visit a branch before the end of June.

fm/fm2-p4-04-07.mp3.text: For more on this and other stories, visit our Web site.

fm/fm2-p4-05-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Castillo. This is Andrea from Pemberton Uniforms, calling about the order for your cafe staff.

fm/fm2-p4-05-02.mp3.text: I'm happy to say that the embroidery with your cafe's logo came out beautifully.

fm/fm2-p4-05-03.mp3.text: However, I'm afraid there's going to be a delay with one part of your order.

fm/fm2-p4-05-04.mp3.text: Our supplier ran out of the item you ordered the most of, and they won't have more until the end of the month.

fm/fm2-p4-05-05.mp3.text: Everything else is packed and ready to go.

fm/fm2-p4-05-06.mp3.text: If you'd like, we can ship those items to you tomorrow and send the rest separately when it arrives.

fm/fm2-p4-05-07.mp3.text: In that case, we'll cover the shipping cost for the second delivery.

fm/fm2-p4-05-08.mp3.text: Otherwise, we can hold everything and send it all together. Just let me know which option you prefer.

fm/fm2-p4-06-01.mp3.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to Hollow Creek Dairy.

fm/fm2-p4-06-02.mp3.text: I'm Rachel, and my family has run this farm for three generations.

fm/fm2-p4-06-03.mp3.text: First, we'll walk over to the barn, where you'll see how our cows are milked.

fm/fm2-p4-06-04.mp3.text: After that, we'll visit the room where we make our cheese and yogurt.

fm/fm2-p4-06-05.mp3.text: Before we go into the barn, please put on the plastic shoe covers in the basket by the door.

fm/fm2-p4-06-06.mp3.text: They help keep the animals healthy.

fm/fm2-p4-06-07.mp3.text: Also, please don't feed the cows, since they follow a special diet.

fm/fm2-p4-06-08.mp3.text: At the end of the tour, we'll stop at our farm shop, where you can taste several kinds of cheese for free.

fm/fm2-p4-07-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the official opening of Tessaro Software's new headquarters.

fm/fm2-p4-07-02.mp3.text: Twelve years ago, this company was just three people sharing a table in my brother's kitchen.

fm/fm2-p4-07-03.mp3.text: Today, we have over four hundred employees in five countries, so I think it's fair to say we needed a slightly bigger table.

fm/fm2-p4-07-04.mp3.text: I'd especially like to thank our facilities team, who moved everything from our old offices over a single weekend without any disruption to our customers.

fm/fm2-p4-07-05.mp3.text: This building was designed with your feedback in mind.

fm/fm2-p4-07-06.mp3.text: You asked for quiet spaces for focused work, and you'll find them on every floor.

fm/fm2-p4-07-07.mp3.text: In a moment, team leaders will take you on short tours of your new work areas.

fm/fm2-p4-08-01.mp3.text: Welcome to the Eastside Makerspace, and thanks for signing up for this introduction to our laser cutter.

fm/fm2-p4-08-02.mp3.text: This machine can cut wood, acrylic, and cardboard with amazing precision, but it can also be dangerous if it's used incorrectly.

fm/fm2-p4-08-03.mp3.text: Today, I'll walk you through the basic controls and safety rules.

fm/fm2-p4-08-04.mp3.text: At the end of the session, you'll take a short written test.

fm/fm2-p4-08-05.mp3.text: Anyone who passes will be allowed to use the machine on their own.

fm/fm2-p4-08-06.mp3.text: To reserve time on the laser cutter, use the online calendar on our members' page.

fm/fm2-p4-08-07.mp3.text: Each member can book up to two hours per day, so that everyone gets a chance to use it.

fm/fm2-p4-08-08.mp3.text: Okay, let's start by looking at the emergency stop button.

fm/fm2-p4-09-01.mp3.text: Okay, everyone, before we open this morning, I want to talk about our hours for the holiday season.

fm/fm2-p4-09-02.mp3.text: Starting December first, the cafe will open an hour earlier, at six A.M., and close at nine P.M. instead of eight.

fm/fm2-p4-09-03.mp3.text: We expect a lot more customers, especially in the mornings.

fm/fm2-p4-09-04.mp3.text: That means we'll need extra help on every shift.

fm/fm2-p4-09-05.mp3.text: Anyone who works more than forty hours a week will be paid overtime, of course.

fm/fm2-p4-09-06.mp3.text: There's a sign-up sheet in the break room for the extra shifts.

fm/fm2-p4-09-07.mp3.text: Please write your name next to the shifts you want by this Friday.

fm/fm2-p4-10-03.mp3.text: Buses depart every fifteen minutes, and the last one leaves at seven P.M., when the exhibit hall closes.

fm/fm2-p4-10-04.mp3.text: Please have your expo admission badge ready to show the driver.

fm/fm2-p4-10-05.mp3.text: Also, don't miss the outdoor kitchen demonstration starting at four o'clock on the main stage.

fm/fm3-p2-03-1.mp3.text: Every hour on the half hour.
