fm/fm3-p3-01-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a refill of my allergy medication. The last name is Varga.

fm/fm3-p3-01-02.mp3.text: Let me check. I'm afraid your prescription has no refills left. We'll need a new authorization from your doctor before we can fill it.

fm/fm3-p3-01-03.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't realize that. I've only got two tablets left, and I'm leaving on a business trip tomorrow.

fm/fm3-p3-01-04.mp3.text: Don't worry. I can call your doctor's office right now and request the authorization. They usually respond within a couple of hours.

fm/fm3-p3-01-05.mp3.text: That would be great. Is there any way I could have it delivered, though? I won't have time to come back today.

fm/fm3-p3-01-06.mp3.text: Sure. We offer free home delivery for orders placed before three o'clock. Just give me your address and a phone number, and we'll send it over this evening.

fm/fm3-p3-01-07.mp3.text: Perfect. Let me write them down for you.

fm/fm3-p3-02-01.mp3.text: Priscilla, Junko, the Fairhaven Library board reviewed our design yesterday. They love it, but they've asked us to add a rooftop reading terrace.

fm/fm3-p3-02-02.mp3.text: A rooftop terrace? The roof wasn't designed to hold that kind of weight. We'd have to reinforce the whole structure.

fm/fm3-p3-02-03.mp3.text: I ran some rough numbers this morning. Extra steel and another elevator stop would add about eight percent to the construction cost.

fm/fm3-p3-02-04.mp3.text: And the board's budget is fixed. They made that clear at our first meeting.

fm/fm3-p3-02-05.mp3.text: Well, we could cover it by switching the exterior from stone to brick panels. From the street, they look almost the same.

fm/fm3-p3-02-06.mp3.text: The board did choose the stone themselves, though.

fm/fm3-p3-02-07.mp3.text: True. Let's not make that decision for them. Junko, could you put together two versions, one with the terrace and brick, and one without the terrace, so they can compare?

fm/fm3-p3-02-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll have both ready for Thursday's presentation.

fm/fm3-p3-03-01.mp3.text: Hi, I have a day pass for the lounge. My flight to Lisbon has been delayed three hours, so I'll be here for a while.

fm/fm3-p3-03-02.mp3.text: Welcome to the Skyward Lounge. Food and drinks are complimentary, and the buffet is just past the reception desk.

fm/fm3-p3-03-03.mp3.text: Thanks. Actually, I need to join a video conference at two o'clock. Is there somewhere quiet I could do that?

fm/fm3-p3-03-04.mp3.text: We have private work pods on the upper level. They're very popular, though, so guests normally reserve them well in advance.

fm/fm3-p3-03-05.mp3.text: Oh. Are any still available at two?

fm/fm3-p3-03-06.mp3.text: Let me see. Actually, one just opened up. The guest who booked it has already gone to board his flight. I'll reserve it for you now.

fm/fm3-p3-03-07.mp3.text: That's a relief. And would you mind letting me know if my departure gate changes? I'll have my headphones on.

fm/fm3-p3-03-08.mp3.text: Not at all. We'll send a text message to the phone number on your booking.

fm/fm3-p3-04-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to book a space for a volleyball tournament for my company's employees on Saturday. There'll be about thirty players.

fm/fm3-p3-04-02.mp3.text: Sure. Here's a list of what's still open that day. Both of our gyms have full-size volleyball nets.

fm/fm3-p3-04-03.mp3.text: Will family members be able to watch? A lot of people are planning to bring their kids.

fm/fm3-p3-04-04.mp3.text: In that case, you'll want Gym A. It has bleachers along one wall. Gym B only has a few benches.

fm/fm3-p3-04-05.mp3.text: OK. But I'd rather not take a morning slot. Some of our staff are driving in from our Bayford office.

fm/fm3-p3-04-06.mp3.text: Then that leaves one option. Just so you know, groups larger than twenty-five must have a certified first aider on site.

fm/fm3-p3-04-07.mp3.text: Oh, we didn't plan for that. Can you provide one?

fm/fm3-p3-04-08.mp3.text: Yes, for an extra forty dollars. I'll add that to your booking right now.

fm/fm3-p3-05-01.mp3.text: Welcome to Hivewell. You must be Ms. Mansour. You're here for the tour?

fm/fm3-p3-05-02.mp3.text: That's right. I run a small app development studio with two partners. Our office lease ends next month, so we're looking into coworking instead.

fm/fm3-p3-05-03.mp3.text: Great. Here are our monthly plans. How often would your team be here?

fm/fm3-p3-05-04.mp3.text: Pretty much every weekday. We'd come and go, though, since we visit clients a lot.

fm/fm3-p3-05-05.mp3.text: Then a limited number of visits won't be enough. Would you need to leave anything here overnight?

fm/fm3-p3-05-06.mp3.text: Yes, we each use two large monitors. Carrying them back and forth every day isn't realistic.

fm/fm3-p3-05-07.mp3.text: In that case, the open seating won't work for you. Those desks are cleared every evening.

fm/fm3-p3-05-08.mp3.text: I see. Is there somewhere we could meet with clients, too?

fm/fm3-p3-05-09.mp3.text: Members can book our conference rooms. Why don't I show you one now? There's a networking lunch in the main room at noon, but the smaller ones are free.

fm/fm3-p3-06-01.mp3.text: Gareth, the regional managers want every store to have a local authors table near the entrance. What do you think?

fm/fm3-p3-06-02.mp3.text: I like the idea, but who would choose the titles? Our buyers here at headquarters don't know every local writer.

fm/fm3-p3-06-03.mp3.text: The store managers would. They'd pick up to twenty titles each and order them straight from the publishers.

fm/fm3-p3-06-04.mp3.text: Hmm. Ordering outside our central system makes inventory hard to track. The pilot we ran in the Lakeport stores last year was a mess.

fm/fm3-p3-06-05.mp3.text: That's true, but that's because we didn't have the new inventory software then. Now every purchase shows up automatically.

fm/fm3-p3-06-06.mp3.text: OK, then. But the front tables are where we put our bestsellers.

fm/fm3-p3-06-07.mp3.text: I've seen the sales figures. Customers who buy a local title usually pick up something else, too.

fm/fm3-p3-06-08.mp3.text: All right, you've convinced me. Could you write up a proposal for Monday's executive meeting?

fm/fm3-p3-06-09.mp3.text: Sure. I'll send you a draft by Friday.

fm/fm3-p3-07-01.mp3.text: Ruben, Dariusz, Orchard Mutual just called. They need fifteen bilingual customer service agents for their new call center, and they'd like them to start in three weeks.

fm/fm3-p3-07-02.mp3.text: Fifteen in three weeks? We only have about six qualified people in our database right now.

fm/fm3-p3-07-03.mp3.text: And most of those six are already interviewing for other positions.

fm/fm3-p3-07-04.mp3.text: I know. But it's a big contract, and they've agreed to raise our placement fee if we meet the deadline.

fm/fm3-p3-07-05.mp3.text: What if we held a hiring event? Candidates could take the language test and interview on the same day.

fm/fm3-p3-07-06.mp3.text: Good idea. The community college has a career center we could use. I know the director there.

fm/fm3-p3-07-07.mp3.text: Great. Dariusz, could you find out when the center is available? And Ruben, please start on the job posting.

fm/fm3-p3-07-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll have a draft ready this afternoon.

fm/fm3-p3-08-01.mp3.text: Hello, this is Anders from Sunreach Solar. I'm calling to confirm your panel installation for next Wednesday.

fm/fm3-p3-08-02.mp3.text: Hi, Anders. Before you come, I have a question. My neighbor said panels shouldn't go on an old roof, and mine is about fifteen years old.

fm/fm3-p3-08-03.mp3.text: That's a good question. Our crew checked your roof during the site visit, and it's in good condition. It should last at least another ten years.

fm/fm3-p3-08-04.mp3.text: Oh, good. And how long will the installation take? I work from home, and I have some video calls that day.

fm/fm3-p3-08-05.mp3.text: Usually about six hours. There'll be some noise, and we'll need to turn off your electricity for about an hour in the afternoon.

fm/fm3-p3-08-06.mp3.text: Hmm, that could be a problem. Could you tell me exactly when?

fm/fm3-p3-08-07.mp3.text: I can't promise an exact time now, but I'll ask the crew leader to call you that morning.

fm/fm3-p3-08-08.mp3.text: Thanks. That would help me plan my day.

fm/fm3-p3-09-01.mp3.text: Imogen, Belcourt Hotels just placed an order for forty bags of almond flour. They want it delivered by Friday for a pastry event.

fm/fm3-p3-09-02.mp3.text: Forty? We only have twelve in the warehouse. Our main grower had a poor harvest, so shipments have been small all month.

fm/fm3-p3-09-03.mp3.text: Could we buy the rest from another distributor? I'd hate to lose this account.

fm/fm3-p3-09-04.mp3.text: I already checked. They've all raised their prices by at least thirty percent, so we'd lose money on the order.

fm/fm3-p3-09-05.mp3.text: What if we sent the twelve bags along with our almond and oat flour blend? It works well in most recipes.

fm/fm3-p3-09-06.mp3.text: Their head pastry chef is Mr. Aldana.

fm/fm3-p3-09-07.mp3.text: Right. He's very particular about following his recipes exactly. OK, I'll call him, explain the situation, and ask how many bags he really needs by Friday.

fm/fm3-p3-09-08.mp3.text: Good. And let him know we can deliver the rest early next week.

fm/fm3-p3-10-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm opening a bicycle repair shop on Quarry Street, and I'd like to hang a sign above the entrance. Do I need a permit for that?

fm/fm3-p3-10-02.mp3.text: You do if the sign extends over the sidewalk. You'll need to complete an application and include a drawing that shows the sign's size and how it'll be attached.

fm/fm3-p3-10-03.mp3.text: OK. I have the design on my tablet. Could I submit it electronically?

fm/fm3-p3-10-04.mp3.text: Yes, you can upload everything through the city's online portal. Applications sent that way are actually processed faster.

fm/fm3-p3-10-05.mp3.text: Great. How long does approval usually take?

fm/fm3-p3-10-06.mp3.text: About ten business days. But since Quarry Street is in the historic district, the design review board has to approve it, too. They meet on the first Monday of each month.

fm/fm3-p3-10-07.mp3.text: Hmm, that's next week. I'd better get my application in right away.

fm/fm3-p3-10-08.mp3.text: Good idea. And here's a checklist of what the board looks at, such as colors and materials.

fm/fm3-p3-11-01.mp3.text: OK, let's talk about tomorrow's front page. Ignacio, how's your story on the city council's vote on the new transit line?

fm/fm3-p3-11-02.mp3.text: That's the problem. The council postponed the vote until next Tuesday. One of the members asked for an updated cost report first.

fm/fm3-p3-11-03.mp3.text: So we don't have a lead story. Marisol, do you have anything we could use?

fm/fm3-p3-11-04.mp3.text: I've got some great shots of the clock tower restoration. It reopens to the public tomorrow morning, so the timing works.

fm/fm3-p3-11-05.mp3.text: I could write an article to go with them. I interviewed the lead architect last month for a feature that never ran.

fm/fm3-p3-11-06.mp3.text: Good. But we should still mention the vote. Readers have been following it closely.

fm/fm3-p3-11-07.mp3.text: I'll put a short update on page three explaining why it was delayed.

fm/fm3-p3-11-08.mp3.text: Perfect. Marisol, please send your five best photos to the design desk by six so they can start on the layout.

fm/fm3-p3-11-09.mp3.text: Will do. I'll choose ones that show the inside of the tower.

fm/fm3-p3-12-01.mp3.text: Hi, I saw an ad for the Corvan hybrid SUV on your Web site. I'd like to take one for a test drive.

fm/fm3-p3-12-02.mp3.text: Of course. Unfortunately, we sold the last one on our lot this morning. But our other dealership on Highway 9 has two in stock.

fm/fm3-p3-12-03.mp3.text: Oh. Is that far from here?

fm/fm3-p3-12-04.mp3.text: About twenty minutes. I could have one brought over tomorrow morning, if that works for you.

fm/fm3-p3-12-05.mp3.text: Tomorrow's fine. I'm also thinking about trading in my current car. Could someone tell me what it's worth?

fm/fm3-p3-12-06.mp3.text: Sure. Our appraiser can look at it while you're on the test drive. Just bring your car's maintenance records with you.

fm/fm3-p3-12-07.mp3.text: Great. I'll come by at ten, then.

fm/fm3-p3-13-01.mp3.text: Callum, the deep-sea exhibition opens in October, and the director wants us to sell a souvenir that's tied to it. Have you looked at last month's sales?

fm/fm3-p3-13-02.mp3.text: Yes. Postcards sold the most by far, but they're so cheap that we don't make much money on them.

fm/fm3-p3-13-03.mp3.text: Right. We should go with something that sells for more. What about the item that came in second?

fm/fm3-p3-13-04.mp3.text: That's a good choice. We could print the giant squid illustration from the exhibition poster on it.

fm/fm3-p3-13-05.mp3.text: I like that. Do you think our usual manufacturer could produce them in time?

fm/fm3-p3-13-06.mp3.text: They've had some delays lately. I'll contact a couple of other companies and compare their schedules.

fm/fm3-p3-13-07.mp3.text: OK. And I'll ask the exhibition designer for a high-resolution file of the illustration.

fm/fm3-p4-01-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Brandvold. This is Keiko from Lantern Portrait Studio.

fm/fm3-p4-01-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about the staff photos we're scheduled to take at your accounting firm next Tuesday.

fm/fm3-p4-01-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, our photographer, Arturo, has come down with the flu, so he won't be able to make it that day.

fm/fm3-p4-01-04.mp3.text: We could send another photographer on Tuesday, or we could move the session to the following Monday so that Arturo can do it himself.

fm/fm3-p4-01-05.mp3.text: Either way, we'll still bring the lighting equipment and backgrounds you chose.

fm/fm3-p4-01-06.mp3.text: Also, please remind your employees not to wear white shirts, since they don't photograph well against our backgrounds.

fm/fm3-p4-01-07.mp3.text: Give me a call at five-five-five, zero-one-four-eight once you've decided which option works best for you.

fm/fm3-p4-02-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon, passengers, and thank you for traveling with Silverline Coaches.

fm/fm3-p4-02-02.mp3.text: In about ten minutes, we'll be stopping at the Pine Hollow service area so you can stretch your legs and get something to eat.

fm/fm3-p4-02-03.mp3.text: Please be back on board by two forty-five, as we need to stay on schedule for our arrival in Carverton.

fm/fm3-p4-02-04.mp3.text: Keep in mind, lunch hour is just starting.

fm/fm3-p4-02-05.mp3.text: If you'd rather not wait in line, there's a convenience store right next to the entrance with sandwiches and drinks.

fm/fm3-p4-02-06.mp3.text: When you get off, please take your valuables with you, since the bus will be locked while I refuel.

fm/fm3-p4-02-07.mp3.text: Finally, the restroom on board will be closed for cleaning during the stop, so please use the ones in the main building.

fm/fm3-p4-03-01.mp3.text: Are you a caterer, baker, or food truck owner who needs more space to cook?

fm/fm3-p4-03-02.mp3.text: Harborpoint Kitchen Hub rents fully equipped commercial kitchens by the month, so you can grow your business without building a kitchen of your own.

fm/fm3-p4-03-03.mp3.text: Every plan includes access to our walk-in refrigerators, dishwashing station, and loading dock.

fm/fm3-p4-03-04.mp3.text: And this month only, we're offering a special deal on the plan that gives you fifty hours of kitchen time.

fm/fm3-p4-03-05.mp3.text: Sign up for that plan before May thirty-first, and your first month is twenty-five percent off.

fm/fm3-p4-03-06.mp3.text: Not sure if we're the right fit?

fm/fm3-p4-03-07.mp3.text: Come to one of our free open houses, held every Saturday morning, and see the space for yourself.

fm/fm3-p4-03-08.mp3.text: Visit harborpointkitchen.example.com to reserve your spot.

fm/fm3-p4-04-01.mp3.text: In city news, the Redford Transit Authority says its bike-share program will add forty new stations by the end of the summer.

fm/fm3-p4-04-02.mp3.text: Until now, the bikes have been available only downtown, but the new stations will be placed near train stops in the northern and western neighborhoods.

fm/fm3-p4-04-03.mp3.text: Officials say the goal is to make it easier for commuters to get to work without driving.

fm/fm3-p4-04-04.mp3.text: The expansion is being paid for largely by a grant from the state's clean air fund, so ride prices won't change.

fm/fm3-p4-04-05.mp3.text: However, some business owners on Lanford Avenue are concerned that the stations will take away street parking spaces their customers rely on.

fm/fm3-p4-04-06.mp3.text: The transit authority will hold a public meeting at City Hall next Thursday evening to discuss station locations.

fm/fm3-p4-04-07.mp3.text: Residents who can't attend can submit comments on the authority's Web site until the end of the month.

fm/fm3-p4-05-01.mp3.text: Okay, let's go over where we are with the October issue of Coastal Table.

fm/fm3-p4-05-02.mp3.text: First, thank you all for getting your articles in on time.

fm/fm3-p4-05-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, there's a problem with our cover story on the Driftwood Grill.

fm/fm3-p4-05-04.mp3.text: A water pipe burst in the restaurant last week, so it's closed for repairs and we can't photograph the dining room as planned.

fm/fm3-p4-05-05.mp3.text: The owner says they'll reopen in time for us to do the shoot on the day the page layout is due.

fm/fm3-p4-05-06.mp3.text: That's tight, so the design team will need to leave space for the photos and add them as soon as they're ready.

fm/fm3-p4-05-07.mp3.text: Yolanda, could you call the printer this afternoon and ask whether they could give us one extra day, just in case?

fm/fm3-p4-06-01.mp3.text: Before we finish today's team meeting, I want to talk about last month's numbers.

fm/fm3-p4-06-02.mp3.text: Our average wait time for callers went up to almost eight minutes, which is twice what it was in the spring.

fm/fm3-p4-06-03.mp3.text: Most of that increase came from customers calling with questions about our new billing statements.

fm/fm3-p4-06-04.mp3.text: Now, I know some of you have suggested hiring more agents.

fm/fm3-p4-06-05.mp3.text: The budget for this year has already been set.

fm/fm3-p4-06-06.mp3.text: So instead, we're going to add a short recorded message that explains how to read the new statement before callers reach an agent.

fm/fm3-p4-06-07.mp3.text: I'd like two volunteers to help write the script for that message.

fm/fm3-p4-06-08.mp3.text: If you're interested, send me an e-mail by Wednesday.

fm/fm3-p4-07-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Greystone Paper Recycling Plant.

fm/fm3-p4-07-02.mp3.text: I'm Haruka, and I'll be your guide for the next hour.

fm/fm3-p4-07-03.mp3.text: Every day, trucks bring about two hundred tons of used paper and cardboard here, and we turn it into new packaging material.

fm/fm3-p4-07-04.mp3.text: We'll start in the sorting area, where you'll see how workers remove plastic and metal from the paper.

fm/fm3-p4-07-05.mp3.text: The machines there are very loud, so please put on the earplugs in the bags I just handed out.

fm/fm3-p4-07-06.mp3.text: Also, photos are not allowed inside the production building, so please keep your phones in your pockets.

fm/fm3-p4-07-07.mp3.text: At the end of the tour, each of you will receive a notebook made from our recycled paper.

fm/fm3-p4-08-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and thank you for coming to the Urban Green Spaces Conference.

fm/fm3-p4-08-02.mp3.text: It's my pleasure to introduce our keynote speaker, landscape architect Imani Seward.

fm/fm3-p4-08-03.mp3.text: Ms. Seward is best known for turning an abandoned rail yard in Port Calder into Meridian Park, which now attracts over a million visitors a year.

fm/fm3-p4-08-04.mp3.text: That project earned her firm a national design award last year.

fm/fm3-p4-08-05.mp3.text: Today, she'll talk about how cities can add green space even when land is limited, for example, by building gardens on rooftops.

fm/fm3-p4-08-06.mp3.text: Ms. Seward has also kindly agreed to stay after her talk to sign copies of her new book, which is on sale at the registration desk.

fm/fm3-p4-08-07.mp3.text: Now, please join me in welcoming Imani Seward.

fm/fm3-p4-09-01.mp3.text: Thanks for joining this afternoon's workshop on writing product descriptions for online stores.

fm/fm3-p4-09-02.mp3.text: Many small sellers spend hours on their photos and then write just a line or two about the product itself.

fm/fm3-p4-09-03.mp3.text: But according to a recent survey, nearly half of online shoppers have returned an item because it didn't match its description.

fm/fm3-p4-09-04.mp3.text: In other words, a vague description doesn't just cost you sales; it can also cost you money after the sale.

fm/fm3-p4-09-05.mp3.text: So today, we'll focus on including the details customers actually look for, like exact measurements and materials.

fm/fm3-p4-09-06.mp3.text: In a moment, I'll hand out some descriptions written by previous participants.

fm/fm3-p4-09-07.mp3.text: I'd like you to work in pairs and mark any information you think is missing.

fm/fm3-p4-10-01.mp3.text: Hi, Ms. Thornbury. This is Anselm calling from Allegro Instrument Repair.

fm/fm3-p4-10-02.mp3.text: I wanted to let you know that we've finished replacing the strings and the bridge on your cello.

fm/fm3-p4-10-03.mp3.text: It sounds great now, and it's ready to be picked up anytime this week.

fm/fm3-p4-10-04.mp3.text: The total came to a little less than our estimate, because we didn't need to repair the case after all.

fm/fm3-p4-10-05.mp3.text: Please note that we're closed on Wednesday for inventory, so you may want to come by on another day.

fm/fm3-p4-10-06.mp3.text: Also, when you come in, we'd be happy to clean any other instrument you bring, free of charge.

fm/fm3-p4-10-07.mp3.text: If you have any questions, you can reach me at five-five-five, zero-one-seven-two.

fm/fm4-p2-01-1.mp3.text: A local artist named Ines Duarte.

fm/fm4-p2-01-q.mp3.text: Who painted the mural in the main lobby?

fm/fm4-p2-02-0.mp3.text: The announcement goes out on Friday.

fm/fm4-p2-02-q.mp3.text: Who's been chosen to represent us at the industry summit?

fm/fm4-p2-03-q.mp3.text: What's included in the deluxe cleaning package?

fm/fm4-p2-04-2.mp3.text: They're meeting again next month to discuss it.

fm/fm4-p2-04-q.mp3.text: What did the board decide about the Lisbon expansion?

fm/fm4-p2-05-2.mp3.text: Yes, it was a great summer.

fm/fm4-p2-05-q.mp3.text: When does the summer internship program begin?

fm/fm4-p2-06-0.mp3.text: Let's ask the director what she prefers.

fm/fm4-p2-06-2.mp3.text: Yes, we won it last year.

fm/fm4-p2-06-q.mp3.text: Where should we display the award the team won?

fm/fm4-p2-07-0.mp3.text: To the AV office on the second floor.

fm/fm4-p2-07-q.mp3.text: Where do I return the projector after the seminar?

fm/fm4-p2-08-1.mp3.text: To accommodate the crowds for the new exhibit.

fm/fm4-p2-08-q.mp3.text: Why did the museum extend its hours this month?

fm/fm4-p2-09-1.mp3.text: The servers are in the basement.

fm/fm4-p2-09-2.mp3.text: It depends on how much data we have.

fm/fm4-p2-09-q.mp3.text: How long will the server migration take?

fm/fm4-p2-10-1.mp3.text: Let's look at last December's numbers first.

fm/fm4-p2-10-q.mp3.text: How many temporary workers will we need for the holiday rush?

fm/fm4-p2-11-q.mp3.text: Are you bringing the sample fabrics to the meeting?

fm/fm4-p2-12-0.mp3.text: I haven't checked my e-mail since lunch.

fm/fm4-p2-12-q.mp3.text: Did the photographer send the catalog photos?

fm/fm4-p2-13-0.mp3.text: Only if your manager approves it.

fm/fm4-p2-13-1.mp3.text: The roof is covered in snow.

fm/fm4-p2-13-q.mp3.text: Is the conference fee covered by our department?

fm/fm4-p2-14-2.mp3.text: They're in the box on my desk.

fm/fm4-p2-14-q.mp3.text: Haven't the new name tags been printed yet?

fm/fm4-p2-15-1.mp3.text: Yes, when I booked my ticket.

fm/fm4-p2-15-q.mp3.text: You ordered the vegetarian meal for the flight, didn't you?

fm/fm4-p2-16-1.mp3.text: He's been called away to the Denver office.

fm/fm4-p2-16-q.mp3.text: Isn't Dimitri presenting the sales forecast on Friday?

fm/fm4-p2-17-0.mp3.text: Light gray would look more modern.

fm/fm4-p2-17-2.mp3.text: The lobby is on the first floor.

fm/fm4-p2-17-q.mp3.text: Should we paint the lobby walls beige or light gray?

fm/fm4-p2-18-1.mp3.text: I borrowed a book last week.

fm/fm4-p2-18-2.mp3.text: The community center's tables are booked that day.

fm/fm4-p2-18-q.mp3.text: Should we rent the tables or borrow them from the community center?

fm/fm4-p2-19-1.mp3.text: Yes, we've hired three new staff.

fm/fm4-p2-19-2.mp3.text: The venue doesn't allow live performances.

fm/fm4-p2-19-q.mp3.text: Are we hiring a band for the gala or just playing recorded music?

fm/fm4-p2-20-1.mp3.text: Try stirring the food halfway through.

fm/fm4-p2-20-q.mp3.text: The new microwave in the break room isn't heating evenly.

fm/fm4-p2-21-0.mp3.text: That's when the website was down for a week.

fm/fm4-p2-21-q.mp3.text: Our online sales dropped sharply in August.

fm/fm4-p2-22-0.mp3.text: Congratulations! You'll be great at that.

fm/fm4-p2-22-q.mp3.text: I've been asked to judge the company photo contest.

fm/fm4-p2-23-q.mp3.text: Could you lock the supply closet when you leave?

fm/fm4-p2-24-0.mp3.text: It takes about an hour to charge.

fm/fm4-p2-24-2.mp3.text: There's an app that shows all of them.

fm/fm4-p2-24-q.mp3.text: Can you tell me where the nearest charging station is?

fm/fm4-p2-25-1.mp3.text: Ms. Ferreira is only free until noon.

fm/fm4-p2-25-q.mp3.text: Would you mind if I moved the meeting to the afternoon?

fm/fm4-p3-01-01.mp3.text: OK, before you two start your rounds, there's a change. A tour group of forty is arriving at noon instead of three, so the eighth-floor rooms have to be ready first.

fm/fm4-p3-01-02.mp3.text: All of them? Some of the guests on eight don't check out until eleven.

fm/fm4-p3-01-03.mp3.text: I know. Do the empty rooms first, and leave the late checkouts for this afternoon.

fm/fm4-p3-01-04.mp3.text: That's fine, but my cart is almost out of bath towels. The laundry delivery still hasn't come up.

fm/fm4-p3-01-05.mp3.text: The laundry room told me their main dryer broke down overnight. They're running behind.

fm/fm4-p3-01-06.mp3.text: There are extra towels in the storage closet on the fourth floor. We set them aside for the pool.

fm/fm4-p3-01-07.mp3.text: Good idea. Yesenia, take two stacks from there for now. I'll let the pool attendant know.

fm/fm4-p3-01-08.mp3.text: Got it. I'll head down there as soon as I finish room 812.

fm/fm4-p3-02-01.mp3.text: Keiko, the beta testers sent in their reports on the budgeting app. Most of them like the new design, but there's a problem with the bank-syncing feature.

fm/fm4-p3-02-03.mp3.text: For about a third of the testers, it imports the same transactions twice. So their spending totals end up doubled.

fm/fm4-p3-02-04.mp3.text: That's not good. We're supposed to launch on the twentieth, and the investors are expecting a demo next Thursday.

fm/fm4-p3-02-05.mp3.text: Our engineers think they can fix it, but they'd need at least two more weeks to test it properly.

fm/fm4-p3-02-06.mp3.text: The press release has already gone out.

fm/fm4-p3-02-07.mp3.text: I understand. But if users see the wrong numbers on day one, they won't trust the app.

fm/fm4-p3-02-08.mp3.text: You're right. Let's launch without syncing and add it in an update. Can you write a note to the testers explaining the change?

fm/fm4-p3-03-01.mp3.text: Good news, Hank. Brookvale Markets wants to carry produce from our co-op in all twelve of its stores starting next summer.

fm/fm4-p3-03-02.mp3.text: That's great. They'd be our biggest customer by far. Did they say which crops they're interested in?

fm/fm4-p3-03-03.mp3.text: They'll take whatever we can supply in large volumes. I was thinking we'd offer them the crop we harvested the most of last season.

fm/fm4-p3-03-04.mp3.text: That won't work. Every bit of that crop is already promised to the cannery in Dale City under our three-year contract.

fm/fm4-p3-03-05.mp3.text: Oh, right. Then let's go with the next largest. That would still keep their shelves full.

fm/fm4-p3-03-06.mp3.text: Agreed. But before they sign anything, Brookvale requires all suppliers to pass a food safety audit.

fm/fm4-p3-03-07.mp3.text: We've never had one of those. Who arranges it?

fm/fm4-p3-03-08.mp3.text: I'll call the agricultural extension office tomorrow. They can recommend an inspector.

fm/fm4-p3-04-01.mp3.text: Hello, Dr. Lowenthal? This is Anton Rusk at Bellhaven Dental Lab. I'm calling about the crown for your patient, Mr. Dufresne.

fm/fm4-p3-04-02.mp3.text: Yes, he's scheduled to have it fitted on Friday. Is there a problem?

fm/fm4-p3-04-03.mp3.text: The impression you sent us got slightly bent during shipping. If I make the crown from it, it might not fit properly.

fm/fm4-p3-04-04.mp3.text: Oh no. Can you work with it at all?

fm/fm4-p3-04-05.mp3.text: Not reliably. But if your office has a digital scanner, you could send us a scan file instead. That'd be faster than mailing a new impression.

fm/fm4-p3-04-06.mp3.text: We actually bought one last month. I'll have my assistant scan Mr. Dufresne's teeth tomorrow morning.

fm/fm4-p3-04-07.mp3.text: Great. Once I receive the file, I can have the crown finished in two days.

fm/fm4-p3-04-08.mp3.text: So Friday won't work. I'll ask our receptionist to move his appointment to next week.

fm/fm4-p3-05-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm planning a fundraising dinner for the Sorrel Valley Animal Shelter next month, and I'd like to rent a tent for it.

fm/fm4-p3-05-02.mp3.text: Sure, I can help with that. How many people are you expecting?

fm/fm4-p3-05-03.mp3.text: About a hundred and twenty. Everyone will be seated at round tables for the meal.

fm/fm4-p3-05-04.mp3.text: Then I'd recommend the smallest tent that seats your whole group. Anything bigger, and the space would feel empty.

fm/fm4-p3-05-05.mp3.text: That makes sense. And since we're a nonprofit, is there any kind of discount?

fm/fm4-p3-05-06.mp3.text: We don't discount the tents themselves, but for charities, we deliver and set up for free.

fm/fm4-p3-05-07.mp3.text: That's very helpful. The dinner will be held in Thistledown Park, by the way.

fm/fm4-p3-05-08.mp3.text: Oh, the city requires an event permit for any tent there. Could you e-mail me a copy of yours before we schedule delivery?

fm/fm4-p3-06-01.mp3.text: Thanks for meeting with me, Femi and Mireya. The historical society has offered to lend us its large-format scanner so we can digitize the Cobbleton Gazette archive.

fm/fm4-p3-06-02.mp3.text: That's wonderful. Researchers have been asking for online access to those old issues for years.

fm/fm4-p3-06-03.mp3.text: How long can we keep the scanner, though? There are almost ninety years of papers down in the basement.

fm/fm4-p3-06-04.mp3.text: Only six weeks. They need it back for their own project in March.

fm/fm4-p3-06-05.mp3.text: Then we can't scan everything. Maybe we should start with the issues people request most often, from the fifties and sixties.

fm/fm4-p3-06-06.mp3.text: I agree. Those pages are also the most fragile. The paper is starting to crumble.

fm/fm4-p3-06-07.mp3.text: All right, let's do that. Femi, could you put together a volunteer schedule? We'll need someone at the scanner every day we're open.

fm/fm4-p3-06-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll post a sign-up sheet at the circulation desk this afternoon.

fm/fm4-p3-07-01.mp3.text: Craig, the folding machine on line two has jammed four times this morning. Every time, it's been with the new recycled cardboard.

fm/fm4-p3-07-02.mp3.text: I was afraid of that. The recycled board is softer than what we used before, so it bends before the machine can crease it.

fm/fm4-p3-07-03.mp3.text: We can't switch back, though. Pellbrook Foods specifically asked for recycled packaging in their new contract.

fm/fm4-p3-07-04.mp3.text: No, but we could slow the line down. At eighty percent speed, the jams should mostly stop.

fm/fm4-p3-07-05.mp3.text: That would put us behind on the Pellbrook order, though. It ships on Monday.

fm/fm4-p3-07-06.mp3.text: Well, if we add a Saturday shift, we'd make up the difference. Several operators have told me they'd like the extra hours.

fm/fm4-p3-07-07.mp3.text: OK. Overtime needs the plant manager's approval, though. Let me go talk to her now.

fm/fm4-p3-08-01.mp3.text: Mr. Brannigan, thanks for coming by the studio. I have an update on the seating for your cafe.

fm/fm4-p3-08-02.mp3.text: Good. Are the benches still on track to be upholstered next week?

fm/fm4-p3-08-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the blue velvet you chose is back-ordered until late April. The mill had a production delay.

fm/fm4-p3-08-04.mp3.text: Late April? We open on April second.

fm/fm4-p3-08-05.mp3.text: I know. So I pulled some alternatives. This green fabric is in stock, and it's stain-resistant, which is practical for a cafe.

fm/fm4-p3-08-06.mp3.text: Hmm. The whole color scheme was built around that blue.

fm/fm4-p3-08-07.mp3.text: Then there's this one. It's a very close match in color, but it's a cotton blend, so it'd need cleaning more often.

fm/fm4-p3-08-08.mp3.text: I can live with that. Could you send a sample to my business partner? She'll want to see it before we decide.

fm/fm4-p3-09-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm Elias Benali from Skyrail Freight. I'm checking on a shipment of cut flowers that came in from Bogota this morning.

fm/fm4-p3-09-02.mp3.text: Let me look it up. Yes, it's here, but it arrived after the cutoff for the connection to Winnipeg, so it missed the early afternoon flight.

fm/fm4-p3-09-03.mp3.text: That's what I was worried about. Flowers can't sit around for long. What's the next option?

fm/fm4-p3-09-04.mp3.text: There's space on the flight that leaves later this afternoon, but it's a smaller aircraft with no refrigerated hold.

fm/fm4-p3-09-05.mp3.text: That won't do. The boxes have to stay cold the whole way.

fm/fm4-p3-09-06.mp3.text: Then I can book it on the one after that. All of this evening's flights have refrigeration available.

fm/fm4-p3-09-07.mp3.text: Please do. And can you keep the boxes in your cold storage room until then?

fm/fm4-p3-09-08.mp3.text: Of course. There's a daily fee of forty dollars, which will be added to your invoice.

fm/fm4-p3-10-01.mp3.text: OK, Noelle, Arjun, the spring recital is three weeks away. How are the students' preparations going?

fm/fm4-p3-10-02.mp3.text: My piano students are in good shape. But the grand piano in our recital hall sounds terrible. It hasn't been tuned since September.

fm/fm4-p3-10-03.mp3.text: And one of the keys sticks. I noticed it last week while I was accompanying my violin students.

fm/fm4-p3-10-04.mp3.text: I'll call the piano tuner today. But he's usually booked weeks in advance.

fm/fm4-p3-10-05.mp3.text: If he can't come in time, the community center on Halsey Street has a nice piano. We could hold the recital there.

fm/fm4-p3-10-06.mp3.text: That might work even better. Their hall has more seats, and lots of families have been asking for extra tickets this year.

fm/fm4-p3-10-07.mp3.text: Good point. Noelle, could you find out whether their hall is available on the twenty-third?

fm/fm4-p3-10-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll call them during my lunch break.

fm/fm4-p3-11-01.mp3.text: Dmitri, we ran out of the spicy chicken wraps by twelve-thirty again today. That's the third time this week.

fm/fm4-p3-11-02.mp3.text: I know. The office workers at Fallon Business Park love them. But the truck's refrigerator only holds so much.

fm/fm4-p3-11-03.mp3.text: Could we prepare a second batch and keep it in a cooler?

fm/fm4-p3-11-04.mp3.text: The health inspector was pretty clear about that. All our ingredients have to be stored in the truck's built-in refrigerator.

fm/fm4-p3-11-05.mp3.text: OK. Then how about a pre-order system? Customers could order online the night before, so we'd know exactly how many to make.

fm/fm4-p3-11-06.mp3.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not great with technology.

fm/fm4-p3-11-08.mp3.text: Really? Could you ask her what she'd charge? If it's reasonable, let's try it next month.

fm/fm4-p3-12-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Thorsby. This is Nora Kaminski from Bluestem Tax Advisors in Suite 510.

fm/fm4-p3-12-02.mp3.text: Hi, Ms. Kaminski. What can I do for you?

fm/fm4-p3-12-03.mp3.text: Our staff will be working on Saturdays until the end of April, and it gets really cold in our office on weekends.

fm/fm4-p3-12-04.mp3.text: Right. The heating system runs on a timer. It shuts off at six on Friday evening and comes back on Monday morning.

fm/fm4-p3-12-05.mp3.text: Is there any way to keep it running on Saturdays?

fm/fm4-p3-12-06.mp3.text: Yes, tenants can request after-hours heating. There's an hourly charge, which is added to your monthly rent statement.

fm/fm4-p3-12-07.mp3.text: That's fine. We'll need it from eight to four every Saturday. How do I set that up?

fm/fm4-p3-12-08.mp3.text: Just fill out the request form on our tenant portal. I'll e-mail you the link this afternoon.

fm/fm4-p3-13-01.mp3.text: Hello, Ms. Arakawa. This is Oren Fiske from the Coastal Agritech Forum. We're looking for a Japanese interpreter for our conference in May.

fm/fm4-p3-13-02.mp3.text: Thanks for calling. What are the dates, and what kind of sessions will there be?

fm/fm4-p3-13-03.mp3.text: May eighth and ninth. They're mostly technical talks on irrigation and soil sensors, with several speakers from Japan.

fm/fm4-p3-13-04.mp3.text: I'm available both days. For full-day simultaneous interpretation, though, I always work with a partner. We switch every thirty minutes.

fm/fm4-p3-13-05.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't realize that. Is that standard?

fm/fm4-p3-13-06.mp3.text: Yes. It's tiring work, and switching keeps the quality high. I can recommend a colleague I often work with.

fm/fm4-p3-13-07.mp3.text: Please do. Is there anything you'll need from us ahead of time?

fm/fm4-p3-13-08.mp3.text: Copies of the speakers' slides, if possible. The technical vocabulary can be tricky, so I like to prepare a glossary.

fm/fm4-p4-01-01.mp3.text: Hi, Priya. This is Gordon Mabry from Keystone Staffing.

fm/fm4-p4-01-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about the temporary receptionist position at Mendel Architecture that we talked about last week.

fm/fm4-p4-01-03.mp3.text: They looked at your resume, and they'd like to interview you as soon as possible.

fm/fm4-p4-01-04.mp3.text: The office manager can meet with you tomorrow at ten at their office on Wickham Street.

fm/fm4-p4-01-05.mp3.text: The position is for three months, but they mentioned that it might turn into a permanent job.

fm/fm4-p4-01-07.mp3.text: Please call me back at five-five-five, zero-one-one-nine by this evening to confirm, and remember to bring a list of your references to the interview.

fm/fm4-p4-02-01.mp3.text: Good evening, fans, and welcome to Quillon Field, home of the Ellisport Owls.

fm/fm4-p4-02-02.mp3.text: Because of heavy rain in the area, the start of tonight's game has been delayed.

fm/fm4-p4-02-03.mp3.text: Our grounds crew is covering the field right now, and we expect to begin play in about forty-five minutes.

fm/fm4-p4-02-04.mp3.text: In the meantime, we encourage you to move to the covered seating area on the upper level to stay dry.

fm/fm4-p4-02-05.mp3.text: All food stands on the main concourse will remain open during the delay.

fm/fm4-p4-02-06.mp3.text: And to thank you for your patience, every fan with a ticket to tonight's game will receive a coupon for a free drink.

fm/fm4-p4-02-07.mp3.text: Just show your ticket at any food stand to pick one up.

fm/fm4-p4-03-01.mp3.text: Is your bicycle making strange noises, but you never seem to have time to take it to a shop?

fm/fm4-p4-03-02.mp3.text: Let Spokes on the Go come to you!

fm/fm4-p4-03-03.mp3.text: Our mechanics travel in fully equipped vans and can repair your bike right outside your home or office.

fm/fm4-p4-03-04.mp3.text: Most repairs take less than an hour, so you can be back on the road the same day.

fm/fm4-p4-03-05.mp3.text: We also offer group service days for companies that want to encourage their employees to ride to work.

fm/fm4-p4-03-06.mp3.text: Booking is easy: just choose a time on our Web site, spokesonthego.example.com.

fm/fm4-p4-03-07.mp3.text: And if you book before the end of April, your first tune-up is half price.

fm/fm4-p4-04-01.mp3.text: In local news, the Brennick City Council has approved a plan to turn the former Vandermeer Textile Mill into apartments and shops.

fm/fm4-p4-04-02.mp3.text: The mill closed nearly twenty years ago, and the building has been empty ever since.

fm/fm4-p4-04-03.mp3.text: Under the plan, the developer, Quarrystone Properties, must keep the building's brick exterior and its well-known clock tower.

fm/fm4-p4-04-04.mp3.text: Council members say the project will help address the city's shortage of affordable housing.

fm/fm4-p4-04-06.mp3.text: Some nearby residents worry that the additional traffic will crowd the narrow streets around the mill.

fm/fm4-p4-04-07.mp3.text: In response, the developer has agreed to pay for a new traffic signal at the corner of Mill Road and Fifth Street.

fm/fm4-p4-04-08.mp3.text: Construction is expected to begin next spring.

fm/fm4-p4-05-01.mp3.text: All right, everyone, let's have a quick meeting before we start dinner service.

fm/fm4-p4-05-02.mp3.text: First, there's a change to tonight's specials.

fm/fm4-p4-05-03.mp3.text: Our supplier couldn't deliver one of the main ingredients, so we won't be serving the most expensive special on the list.

fm/fm4-p4-05-04.mp3.text: Please let guests know about this when you hand them their menus.

fm/fm4-p4-05-05.mp3.text: Second, a party of twenty is arriving at seven for a company retirement dinner.

fm/fm4-p4-05-06.mp3.text: They'll be in the back room, and Bettina will be in charge of their table.

fm/fm4-p4-05-07.mp3.text: Finally, the new handheld ordering devices arrived today.

fm/fm4-p4-05-08.mp3.text: After we close tonight, please stay for fifteen minutes so I can show you how to use them.

fm/fm4-p4-06-01.mp3.text: Welcome to the Seacliff Aquarium's behind-the-scenes tour.

fm/fm4-p4-06-02.mp3.text: Today, you'll see the areas where our staff keep our animals healthy, which most visitors never get to see.

fm/fm4-p4-06-03.mp3.text: Before we start, there's one quick change.

fm/fm4-p4-06-04.mp3.text: Our veterinarians are treating a sea turtle right now, so we'll skip the stop right after the kitchen and visit it at the end instead, if time allows.

fm/fm4-p4-06-05.mp3.text: Also, some of the floors back here are wet, so please watch your step and hold on to the handrails.

fm/fm4-p4-06-06.mp3.text: When we get to the kitchen, you'll have a chance to help our staff prepare lunch for the penguins.

fm/fm4-p4-06-07.mp3.text: And as a thank-you for joining us, you'll each get a pass for a free return visit.

fm/fm4-p4-07-01.mp3.text: Thank you so much for this award.

fm/fm4-p4-07-02.mp3.text: When the Tarrant County Engineering Society called to tell me our team had won, I was honestly surprised.

fm/fm4-p4-07-03.mp3.text: The Glenhaven pedestrian bridge was one of the most difficult projects of my career.

fm/fm4-p4-07-04.mp3.text: Because the river floods almost every spring, we had to design a structure that could be built in just a few dry months.

fm/fm4-p4-07-05.mp3.text: We solved that problem by building most of the bridge's sections in a factory and then lifting them into place.

fm/fm4-p4-07-06.mp3.text: Of course, none of this would have been possible without the residents of Glenhaven, who shared their ideas at every stage of planning.

fm/fm4-p4-07-07.mp3.text: That's why I'm donating the prize money to the town's new riverside walking trail.

fm/fm4-p4-08-01.mp3.text: Good morning, and thank you all for volunteering as gallery guides here at the Pelham Art Museum.

fm/fm4-p4-08-02.mp3.text: In today's training session, we'll practice answering the kinds of questions visitors ask most often.

fm/fm4-p4-08-03.mp3.text: Many of these questions aren't about the art at all; people mostly want to know where the restrooms, elevators, and cafe are.

fm/fm4-p4-08-04.mp3.text: So the first thing I'd like you to do is study the floor plan in your welcome folder.

fm/fm4-p4-08-05.mp3.text: Of course, you'll also get questions about the paintings.

fm/fm4-p4-08-06.mp3.text: If you don't know an answer, it's fine to say so and send the visitor to the information desk.

fm/fm4-p4-08-07.mp3.text: Later this morning, our head curator will join us and walk us through the new photography exhibit.

fm/fm4-p4-09-01.mp3.text: Hello, Ms. Ilunga. This is Leopold from the front desk at the Thistlewood Conference Center.

fm/fm4-p4-09-02.mp3.text: After your sales seminar ended yesterday, our cleaning staff found a black laptop bag in Meeting Room C.

fm/fm4-p4-09-03.mp3.text: It has a name tag with your company's logo on it, so we think it belongs to someone in your group.

fm/fm4-p4-09-04.mp3.text: For now, we're keeping it in a locked cabinet at the front desk.

fm/fm4-p4-09-05.mp3.text: The owner can pick it up any day between eight A.M. and six P.M., but they'll need to show a photo ID.

fm/fm4-p4-09-06.mp3.text: If that's not convenient, we can also send it by courier, but there would be a small delivery fee.

fm/fm4-p4-09-07.mp3.text: Please call me at five-five-five, zero-one-eight-seven and let me know how you'd like to proceed.

fm/fm4-p4-10-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming to this month's fundraising committee meeting.

fm/fm4-p4-10-02.mp3.text: As you know, our goal for the spring campaign is to raise sixty thousand dollars to build a new medical wing at the animal shelter.

fm/fm4-p4-10-03.mp3.text: So far, we've collected about twenty-five thousand, and the campaign ends in three weeks.

fm/fm4-p4-10-04.mp3.text: We have a lot of work to do.

fm/fm4-p4-10-05.mp3.text: One idea is to ask local businesses to match whatever our individual donors give during the final week.

fm/fm4-p4-10-06.mp3.text: Oakhurst Hardware has already agreed to match up to five thousand dollars.

fm/fm4-p4-10-07.mp3.text: I'd like each of you to contact at least two more businesses before our next meeting.

fm/fm4-p4-10-08.mp3.text: I've put a list of possible companies on the table by the door.

fm/fm5-p2-01-2.mp3.text: The mayor has agreed to do it.

fm/fm5-p2-01-q.mp3.text: Who's going to cut the ribbon at the store opening?

fm/fm5-p2-02-0.mp3.text: Yes, it's on the third floor.

fm/fm5-p2-02-q.mp3.text: Who's supposed to sign off on the new floor layout?

fm/fm5-p2-03-q.mp3.text: What was the attendance like at yesterday's book signing?

fm/fm5-p2-04-0.mp3.text: The city's posting a map tomorrow.

fm/fm5-p2-04-1.mp3.text: About three hours and ten minutes.

fm/fm5-p2-04-q.mp3.text: Which route is the marathon taking through downtown?

fm/fm5-p2-05-q.mp3.text: When does the farmers market close today?

fm/fm5-p2-06-0.mp3.text: I can lift about twenty kilos.

fm/fm5-p2-06-1.mp3.text: The supplier said they're on back order.

fm/fm5-p2-06-q.mp3.text: When will the replacement parts for the forklift arrive?

fm/fm5-p2-07-1.mp3.text: I lived in Brazil for three years.

fm/fm5-p2-07-q.mp3.text: Where did you learn to speak Portuguese?

fm/fm5-p2-08-2.mp3.text: One of its tires went flat.

fm/fm5-p2-08-q.mp3.text: Why did the delivery van come back early?

fm/fm5-p2-09-0.mp3.text: Have you seen the weather forecast?

fm/fm5-p2-09-q.mp3.text: Why was the hiking trip called off?

fm/fm5-p2-10-2.mp3.text: It's a little noisier than I expected.

fm/fm5-p2-10-q.mp3.text: How do you like working in the new open office?

fm/fm5-p2-11-q.mp3.text: Do you have the code for the side door?

fm/fm5-p2-12-0.mp3.text: I'll tell her you stopped by.

fm/fm5-p2-12-1.mp3.text: There's a posting on the bank's website.

fm/fm5-p2-12-2.mp3.text: A branch fell in the storm.

fm/fm5-p2-12-q.mp3.text: Is the downtown branch hiring part-time tellers?

fm/fm5-p2-13-1.mp3.text: Our contract runs through next March.

fm/fm5-p2-13-q.mp3.text: Will the software license need to be renewed this year?

fm/fm5-p2-14-1.mp3.text: Post it on the bulletin board.

fm/fm5-p2-14-q.mp3.text: You're the one who designed this poster, aren't you?

fm/fm5-p2-15-0.mp3.text: Turn left at the end of the hall.

fm/fm5-p2-15-2.mp3.text: An electrician is coming this afternoon.

fm/fm5-p2-15-q.mp3.text: Haven't they fixed the hallway lights yet?

fm/fm5-p2-16-0.mp3.text: I'd like to order the soup.

fm/fm5-p2-16-2.mp3.text: Their account was put on hold.

fm/fm5-p2-16-q.mp3.text: The order from Halvorsen Foods went out on Monday, didn't it?

fm/fm5-p2-17-q.mp3.text: Would you like your receipt printed or e-mailed?

fm/fm5-p2-18-0.mp3.text: Most of our clients are overseas.

fm/fm5-p2-18-q.mp3.text: Should we hold the product demo in person or online?

fm/fm5-p2-19-0.mp3.text: Just leave them until I've looked them over.

fm/fm5-p2-19-q.mp3.text: Do you want me to file these invoices or shred them?

fm/fm5-p2-20-2.mp3.text: I have one, and I love it.

fm/fm5-p2-20-q.mp3.text: I'm thinking about getting a standing desk.

fm/fm5-p2-21-1.mp3.text: I guess I'll take the train, then.

fm/fm5-p2-21-q.mp3.text: The parking garage is closing for repairs next week.

fm/fm5-p2-22-1.mp3.text: There's another carton in the storeroom.

fm/fm5-p2-22-q.mp3.text: I don't think we ordered enough cups for the tasting event.

fm/fm5-p2-23-q.mp3.text: Could you hold the elevator, please?

fm/fm5-p2-24-0.mp3.text: Kenji's already collecting money for it.

fm/fm5-p2-24-1.mp3.text: I split my time between offices.

fm/fm5-p2-24-q.mp3.text: Why don't we split the cost of the farewell gift?

fm/fm5-p2-25-2.mp3.text: The instructions are taped to the side.

fm/fm5-p2-25-q.mp3.text: Could you show me how to use the new label maker?

fm/fm5-p3-01-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling Spokeline Bicycle Couriers. This is Rosalind speaking.

fm/fm5-p3-01-02.mp3.text: Hi, Rosalind. I'm calling from Vesely and Kurtz, a law firm on Quillon Street. I need to get some signed contracts to a client's office in the Waterside district.

fm/fm5-p3-01-03.mp3.text: No problem. When do they need to be there?

fm/fm5-p3-01-04.mp3.text: The client is reviewing them at a meeting at two thirty, and it's about noon now. I'd like to go with the cheapest service that gets them there in time.

fm/fm5-p3-01-05.mp3.text: Sure, I can arrange that. A rider will come to your office in about fifteen minutes.

fm/fm5-p3-01-06.mp3.text: Great. Is there anything I should do before the rider arrives?

fm/fm5-p3-01-07.mp3.text: Yes. Rain is expected this afternoon, so please seal the contracts in a waterproof envelope if you have one.

fm/fm5-p3-01-08.mp3.text: Will do. We keep plastic mailers in our supply room. I'll put them in one right now.

fm/fm5-p3-02-01.mp3.text: Gideon, Priyanka, thanks for coming. Stonebridge High School has asked if their students can visit our residents every week as part of a community service class.

fm/fm5-p3-02-02.mp3.text: I think it's a great idea. Many of our residents rarely get visitors, and the students could play board games or read with them.

fm/fm5-p3-02-03.mp3.text: I agree, but they suggested coming at four o'clock on Thursdays. That's exactly when the nurses do the afternoon medication rounds.

fm/fm5-p3-02-04.mp3.text: Could the visits start a little later?

fm/fm5-p3-02-05.mp3.text: Sure. If they came at four thirty, the rounds would be finished, and dinner isn't served until five thirty.

fm/fm5-p3-02-06.mp3.text: I'll suggest that to the teacher. But remember, every volunteer here has to pass a background check before their first visit.

fm/fm5-p3-02-07.mp3.text: Right, and those take about three weeks to process. So the program can't begin until next month.

fm/fm5-p3-02-08.mp3.text: Then I'd better get the forms to the school as soon as possible.

fm/fm5-p3-02-09.mp3.text: Why don't you drop them off in person tomorrow? That way, you can explain the process to the teacher directly.

fm/fm5-p3-03-01.mp3.text: Wendy, have you seen the fabric from this morning's dye run? It's for the Thistlewood Hotel's new curtains.

fm/fm5-p3-03-02.mp3.text: I just compared it to the sample they approved. The blue came out noticeably darker.

fm/fm5-p3-03-03.mp3.text: It's only slightly darker, though. Could we ship it as is? They need it by Friday.

fm/fm5-p3-03-04.mp3.text: Their designer is very particular. She sent back an entire order last year over a smaller difference than this.

fm/fm5-p3-03-05.mp3.text: Hmm. Then we'll have to redo the batch. But the dyeing line is fully booked through Wednesday.

fm/fm5-p3-03-06.mp3.text: What if we ran it on the night shift tonight? Then it could still be finished by Thursday afternoon.

fm/fm5-p3-03-07.mp3.text: That would work, but I'd need at least two more machine operators to stay late.

fm/fm5-p3-03-08.mp3.text: Let me pull up the staffing schedule and see who's available tonight.

fm/fm5-p3-04-01.mp3.text: Ezekiel, I just heard from the stadium. This morning's thunderstorms left the field soaked, so the Riverside match won't kick off until two o'clock.

fm/fm5-p3-04-02.mp3.text: An hour late? Then our live coverage will run an hour past its usual time slot.

fm/fm5-p3-04-03.mp3.text: Exactly. The station manager has decided that the program right after the game won't air this week. Everything after that will stay as scheduled.

fm/fm5-p3-04-04.mp3.text: OK. Our listeners will need to know about the change. Should I mention it during the noon news?

fm/fm5-p3-04-05.mp3.text: Yes, but I'd also like you to record a short announcement. We can play it every half hour until the game starts.

fm/fm5-p3-04-06.mp3.text: No problem. I'm interviewing a guest at eleven, but I'll be free after that.

fm/fm5-p3-04-07.mp3.text: Great. I'll write the script and leave it in Studio B for you.

fm/fm5-p3-05-01.mp3.text: Ronan, Noreen, thanks for meeting me. Today I'd like to talk about a backup plan in case it rains on your wedding day.

fm/fm5-p3-05-02.mp3.text: We were hoping you'd bring that up. The ceremony's in the apple orchard, and there isn't much shelter there.

fm/fm5-p3-05-03.mp3.text: Couldn't we just move everything into the barn on the property?

fm/fm5-p3-05-04.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the barn only holds about eighty people, and you've invited a hundred and twenty. So I'd recommend renting a tent instead.

fm/fm5-p3-05-06.mp3.text: Around fifteen hundred dollars. But the rental company needs a decision by the end of this month, and the deposit isn't refundable.

fm/fm5-p3-05-07.mp3.text: Hmm, that's a lot to pay for something we might not even use.

fm/fm5-p3-05-08.mp3.text: I understand. Some insurers offer wedding weather coverage that pays back part of that cost. I'll e-mail you some information about it tonight.

fm/fm5-p3-06-01.mp3.text: Hi, I own Marigold Café on Juniper Avenue. We're adding a patio for outdoor seating, and I need some shrubs for the planters around it.

fm/fm5-p3-06-02.mp3.text: I can help with that. How much sunlight does the patio get?

fm/fm5-p3-06-03.mp3.text: Not much. The building next door blocks the sun for most of the day.

fm/fm5-p3-06-04.mp3.text: OK. And how tall would you like the plants to grow?

fm/fm5-p3-06-05.mp3.text: Well, the planters are right under our front windows, so nothing taller than a meter. We don't want to block the view of the street.

fm/fm5-p3-06-06.mp3.text: Then there's really only one choice on this chart. How many would you need?

fm/fm5-p3-06-07.mp3.text: Twelve. But I don't have a truck to take them back to the café.

fm/fm5-p3-06-08.mp3.text: That's not a problem. Since your order is over two hundred dollars, we'll deliver it at no charge. We can also plant them for a small fee.

fm/fm5-p3-07-01.mp3.text: Good morning, Ms. Quintero. Please have a seat. I've started going through the documents you sent for your tax return.

fm/fm5-p3-07-02.mp3.text: Thanks, Mr. Delacroix. I'm afraid some things are missing. I couldn't find the receipts for the printer and software I bought in March.

fm/fm5-p3-07-03.mp3.text: That's all right. If you paid by card, your bank statement will show the purchases. Just ask the store for a copy of each invoice as well.

fm/fm5-p3-07-04.mp3.text: I can do that. Also, since I started working from home this year, I turned my spare bedroom into an office. Can I deduct any of those costs?

fm/fm5-p3-07-05.mp3.text: Possibly. It depends on how much of your home the office takes up. Could you measure the room and send me its size, along with the total area of your house?

fm/fm5-p3-07-06.mp3.text: Sure. I'll do that this weekend.

fm/fm5-p3-07-07.mp3.text: Great. Once I have those numbers, I should be able to finish your return by the end of next week.

fm/fm5-p3-08-01.mp3.text: Bastian, what's the status of the Comet Coaster? There's a big crowd of guests waiting at the entrance.

fm/fm5-p3-08-02.mp3.text: Not good, I'm afraid. One of the safety sensors on the track keeps sending error messages. We can't reopen the ride until it's replaced.

fm/fm5-p3-08-04.mp3.text: We don't keep that part on site. The manufacturer says it can arrive by tomorrow morning, though.

fm/fm5-p3-08-05.mp3.text: A lot of guests come to the park just for that coaster. Could we give them something to make up for it?

fm/fm5-p3-08-06.mp3.text: Good idea. Let's offer them express passes for two other rides of their choice.

fm/fm5-p3-08-07.mp3.text: All right. My team will print the passes and hand them out at the coaster entrance.

fm/fm5-p3-08-08.mp3.text: Thanks, Yolanda. I'll also post a notice on the park's mobile app so that people don't walk all the way over there.

fm/fm5-p3-09-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling the Kenwick University Admissions Office. This is Malik.

fm/fm5-p3-09-02.mp3.text: Hi, I applied to your graduate program in public health, but the online portal says my application is incomplete. I'm not sure what's missing.

fm/fm5-p3-09-03.mp3.text: Let me check for you. What's your applicant number?

fm/fm5-p3-09-04.mp3.text: It's four, zero, seven, seven, two.

fm/fm5-p3-09-05.mp3.text: OK, I see what's going on. We haven't received one of your letters of recommendation. It's the one from Professor Yamashiro.

fm/fm5-p3-09-06.mp3.text: Oh, she told me she sent it last week. The deadline is this Friday, isn't it?

fm/fm5-p3-09-07.mp3.text: Yes, but letters are accepted up to one week after the deadline. Still, you might want to remind her.

fm/fm5-p3-09-08.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll e-mail her right away.

fm/fm5-p3-10-01.mp3.text: Desmond, have you read the online reviews for our new Dewlight moisturizer? A lot of customers say the pump stops working when the bottle is about half full.

fm/fm5-p3-10-02.mp3.text: Yes, I've seen them. Our engineers took apart a few bottles, and the tube inside is too short to reach the bottom.

fm/fm5-p3-10-03.mp3.text: Could we switch to a jar instead? Jars don't have any parts that can fail.

fm/fm5-p3-10-04.mp3.text: We've already printed ten thousand boxes.

fm/fm5-p3-10-05.mp3.text: Ah, right. I hadn't thought about that. So what are our options?

fm/fm5-p3-10-06.mp3.text: Our packaging supplier can make a longer tube that fits the current bottles. They said they could deliver them in three weeks.

fm/fm5-p3-10-07.mp3.text: Good. In the meantime, I'd like to respond to the customers who've complained. Maybe we could offer them a discount on their next purchase.

fm/fm5-p3-10-08.mp3.text: That makes sense. Why don't you write a draft of the response? I'll look it over before it's posted.

fm/fm5-p3-11-01.mp3.text: Port of Tollbridge, Container Services. This is Bernadette.

fm/fm5-p3-11-02.mp3.text: Hi, I'm calling from Copperbeck Home Furnishings. Our container of dining tables was unloaded on Monday, but it still hasn't been released. The reference number is AX-3318.

fm/fm5-p3-11-03.mp3.text: Let me look that up. OK, it's on hold because your paperwork doesn't include a fumigation certificate. That's required for any shipment packed in wooden crates.

fm/fm5-p3-11-04.mp3.text: Hmm, our supplier was supposed to send that along with the other documents.

fm/fm5-p3-11-05.mp3.text: It isn't in our system. I should also mention that containers can stay here free of charge for only five days. After that, a daily storage fee applies.

fm/fm5-p3-11-06.mp3.text: Then I need to sort this out quickly. Can the certificate be submitted electronically?

fm/fm5-p3-11-07.mp3.text: Yes, your supplier can upload it directly to our online portal. Once it's approved, the container is usually released within a day.

fm/fm5-p3-11-08.mp3.text: Great. It's the middle of the night where they are, but I'll leave them a message right away.

fm/fm5-p3-12-01.mp3.text: Welcome to Nexora Wireless. How can I help you today?

fm/fm5-p3-12-02.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to add a line to my account for my daughter. She's starting high school, and I'd like her to have her own phone.

fm/fm5-p3-12-03.mp3.text: Sure. Our family plan lets you share data across all your lines, and each extra line is only fifteen dollars a month.

fm/fm5-p3-12-04.mp3.text: That sounds reasonable. Is there a fee to set it up?

fm/fm5-p3-12-05.mp3.text: Normally, there's a thirty-dollar activation fee, but we're waiving it for any line added this month.

fm/fm5-p3-12-06.mp3.text: Great. Can we do it right now? She's waiting in the car.

fm/fm5-p3-12-07.mp3.text: Of course. Since you're the account holder, I'll just need to see a photo ID.

fm/fm5-p3-12-08.mp3.text: No problem. Here's my driver's license.

fm/fm5-p3-13-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to rent a floor sander for this Saturday. I'm refinishing the wood floors in my living room.

fm/fm5-p3-13-02.mp3.text: This Saturday? It's a holiday weekend.

fm/fm5-p3-13-03.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't think about that. So they're all reserved?

fm/fm5-p3-13-04.mp3.text: I'm afraid so. But one is due back Sunday morning. I could hold it for you if you'd like to pick it up then.

fm/fm5-p3-13-05.mp3.text: That would still give me enough time. Do I need anything else?

fm/fm5-p3-13-06.mp3.text: Yes, sanding discs. They aren't included in the rental, so you'll have to buy them. A living room usually takes about ten.

fm/fm5-p3-13-07.mp3.text: OK. I've never used one of these machines before, though.

fm/fm5-p3-13-08.mp3.text: Then you're in luck. We hold a free demonstration on floor sanders here every Saturday at ten A.M.

fm/fm5-p3-13-09.mp3.text: Perfect. I'll come by for that.

fm/fm5-p4-01-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Yilmaz. This is Simone Dufresne from the Wellsbury City permit office.

fm/fm5-p4-01-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about the application you submitted for outdoor seating at your cafe on Bell Street.

fm/fm5-p4-01-03.mp3.text: Everything looks fine, except that we didn't receive a drawing that shows where the tables will go.

fm/fm5-p4-01-04.mp3.text: Without it, we can't send your application to the inspector.

fm/fm5-p4-01-05.mp3.text: I see that you'd like to open the patio by June first.

fm/fm5-p4-01-06.mp3.text: Reviews usually take about three weeks.

fm/fm5-p4-01-07.mp3.text: You can upload the drawing on our Web site, or drop it off at City Hall, Room 210.

fm/fm5-p4-01-08.mp3.text: If you have any questions, my direct number is five-five-five, zero-one-five-three.

fm/fm5-p4-02-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon, and thank you for shopping at Bramble Lane Books.

fm/fm5-p4-02-02.mp3.text: In fifteen minutes, mystery writer Colette Haverford will be reading from her new novel, The Silent Harbor, in our cafe on the second floor.

fm/fm5-p4-02-03.mp3.text: The book has been on the best-seller list for six weeks.

fm/fm5-p4-02-04.mp3.text: After the reading, Ms. Haverford will answer questions from the audience and sign copies of her books.

fm/fm5-p4-02-05.mp3.text: Seating is limited, so we recommend heading upstairs soon.

fm/fm5-p4-02-06.mp3.text: If you'd like a signed copy but can't stay, just leave your name at the information counter, and we'll have one signed for you.

fm/fm5-p4-02-07.mp3.text: Also, all mystery novels are fifteen percent off for the rest of the day.

fm/fm5-p4-03-01.mp3.text: Running out of room at home or at your business?

fm/fm5-p4-03-02.mp3.text: Stowright Storage has clean, secure units in three convenient locations around Elmsford.

fm/fm5-p4-03-03.mp3.text: All of our buildings are climate-controlled, so your furniture, documents, and electronics stay protected all year long.

fm/fm5-p4-03-04.mp3.text: And unlike other storage companies, we let you get to your unit any time, day or night.

fm/fm5-p4-03-05.mp3.text: This month, everyone who rents a ten-by-ten unit, which is perfect for the contents of a one-bedroom apartment, will get a free set of moving boxes.

fm/fm5-p4-03-06.mp3.text: To reserve a unit, call us at five-five-five, zero-one-six-four or stop by any of our locations.

fm/fm5-p4-03-07.mp3.text: Stowright Storage: room for everything you own.

fm/fm5-p4-04-01.mp3.text: This is Calvin Ostrowski, and you're listening to City Living on WFRN Radio.

fm/fm5-p4-04-02.mp3.text: My guest today is Talia Brooks, who keeps more than thirty beehives on the rooftops of office buildings around town.

fm/fm5-p4-04-03.mp3.text: Ms. Brooks started her business, Highrise Honey, four years ago with just two hives on top of her own apartment building.

fm/fm5-p4-04-04.mp3.text: Now, several companies pay her to keep hives on their roofs, and their employees receive jars of the honey as gifts.

fm/fm5-p4-04-05.mp3.text: She says the bees have also helped the flowers and trees in nearby parks grow better.

fm/fm5-p4-04-06.mp3.text: In a few minutes, she'll explain what businesses need to know before getting started.

fm/fm5-p4-04-07.mp3.text: But first, here's a short message from our sponsor.

fm/fm5-p4-05-01.mp3.text: Next, I'd like to update you on our search for a new shipping company.

fm/fm5-p4-05-02.mp3.text: As you know, customers have been complaining that their kitchenware orders take too long to arrive.

fm/fm5-p4-05-03.mp3.text: So last month we tested four carriers, and this chart shows the average delivery time for each one.

fm/fm5-p4-05-04.mp3.text: The fastest carrier charges almost twice as much as the others, so that's not an option for us.

fm/fm5-p4-05-05.mp3.text: Instead, we've decided to go with the next fastest one, which also offers free package tracking.

fm/fm5-p4-05-06.mp3.text: We'll make the switch at the beginning of next month.

fm/fm5-p4-05-07.mp3.text: Before then, the shipping information on our Web site will need to be updated.

fm/fm5-p4-05-08.mp3.text: Dorian, can you make sure that's done by Friday?

fm/fm5-p4-06-01.mp3.text: Welcome to the rooftop of Vireo Tower, everyone.

fm/fm5-p4-06-02.mp3.text: Since you're all considering leasing office space in the building, I wanted to make sure you saw this area before we finish the tour.

fm/fm5-p4-06-03.mp3.text: This garden covers the entire roof, and it's open to all tenants and their employees from seven A.M. to nine P.M.

fm/fm5-p4-06-04.mp3.text: The plants help keep the building cool in the summer, which lowers everyone's energy bills.

fm/fm5-p4-06-05.mp3.text: And take a look at that view of the harbor.

fm/fm5-p4-06-06.mp3.text: You won't find that anywhere else downtown.

fm/fm5-p4-06-07.mp3.text: Tenants can also reserve the covered area over there for team lunches and client events.

fm/fm5-p4-06-08.mp3.text: Now, let's head back down to the lobby, where my colleague has information packets with current rental rates.

fm/fm5-p4-07-01.mp3.text: Good morning, runners, and thank you for coming out to the tenth annual Riverbend Fun Run!

fm/fm5-p4-07-02.mp3.text: This year, more than eight hundred people signed up, which is a new record.

fm/fm5-p4-07-03.mp3.text: All of the money from registration fees will go toward building a new playground in Hollowell Park.

fm/fm5-p4-07-04.mp3.text: Before we begin, here are a few reminders.

fm/fm5-p4-07-05.mp3.text: There are water stations every two kilometers along the route, and volunteers in orange vests will point you in the right direction.

fm/fm5-p4-07-06.mp3.text: Please make sure your race number is pinned to the front of your shirt so that our timers can see it.

fm/fm5-p4-07-07.mp3.text: After the race, stay for the awards ceremony and enjoy free snacks from our sponsor, Dawson's Bakery.

fm/fm5-p4-08-01.mp3.text: Thanks for joining this workshop on presenting data clearly.

fm/fm5-p4-08-02.mp3.text: Earlier, we looked at how to choose the right type of chart for your information.

fm/fm5-p4-08-03.mp3.text: Now I'd like to focus on a mistake I see in almost every presentation: putting too much information on a single slide.

fm/fm5-p4-08-04.mp3.text: When an audience sees twelve lines on one graph, they stop listening to you and start trying to read it.

fm/fm5-p4-08-05.mp3.text: A better approach is to show only the one or two numbers that support your main point.

fm/fm5-p4-08-06.mp3.text: You can always put the complete data in a handout for anyone who wants the details.

fm/fm5-p4-08-07.mp3.text: Now, open the sample file on your laptop, and let's try simplifying a crowded sales chart together.

fm/fm5-p4-10-01.mp3.text: In business news, athletic footwear maker Strideline announced on Tuesday that it will start taking back worn-out sneakers at all of its stores.

fm/fm5-p4-10-02.mp3.text: Customers who drop off a pair of any brand will receive a voucher for fifteen percent off their next purchase.

fm/fm5-p4-10-03.mp3.text: The company plans to grind the old shoes into rubber pellets, which will then be used to make running tracks and playground surfaces.

fm/fm5-p4-10-04.mp3.text: Strideline's chief executive, Monique Arceneaux, said the program responds to customers who have asked what to do with shoes they no longer wear.

fm/fm5-p4-10-05.mp3.text: Industry analysts point out that the program could also bring more shoppers into Strideline stores at a time when many people buy shoes online.

p34/p3-001-01.mp3.text: Hi, Daniel. Did you get my e-mail about tomorrow's project meeting?

p34/p3-001-02.mp3.text: I did. You said we can't use Conference Room B. What happened?

p34/p3-001-03.mp3.text: The facilities team is replacing the carpet in there all week. So I booked the small room on the third floor instead.

p34/p3-001-04.mp3.text: Hmm, there are eight of us on the team. Will everyone fit?

p34/p3-001-05.mp3.text: It'll be a little tight, but it's only for one meeting. And it has a projector, so you can still show your slides.

p34/p3-001-06.mp3.text: Good, because I've put together a demo of the new client portal.

p34/p3-001-07.mp3.text: Great. Could you send the slides to everyone tonight? That way, people can look them over before we meet.

p34/p3-001-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll do that as soon as I finish this report.

p34/p3-002-01.mp3.text: Priya, how's the quarterly sales report coming along? Ms. Hargrove wants it on her desk by Thursday.

p34/p3-002-02.mp3.text: Most of it's done, but I'm still waiting on the figures from our Singapore office.

p34/p3-002-03.mp3.text: Really? They usually send those at the beginning of the month.

p34/p3-002-04.mp3.text: Apparently their accounting system was upgraded last week, and some of the data didn't transfer properly.

p34/p3-002-05.mp3.text: That's frustrating. Is there any way to work around it?

p34/p3-002-06.mp3.text: Well, I could use their preliminary numbers for now and add a note saying they'll be updated later.

p34/p3-002-07.mp3.text: I think Ms. Hargrove would be fine with that, as long as it's clearly marked.

p34/p3-002-08.mp3.text: OK. I'll call the Singapore team this afternoon to make sure the preliminary numbers are reliable.

p34/p3-003-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming, Lena and Omar. Finance just told me that our budget for the Denver trade show has been cut by fifteen percent.

p34/p3-003-02.mp3.text: Fifteen percent? But we've already paid the registration fee.

p34/p3-003-03.mp3.text: Right, so we'll have to save on other things, like travel and the booth.

p34/p3-003-04.mp3.text: What if we send three people instead of five? That would cut our hotel costs quite a bit.

p34/p3-003-05.mp3.text: I'd rather not. We need at least four people to staff the booth during the busy hours.

p34/p3-003-06.mp3.text: OK, then how about renting display equipment in Denver instead of shipping ours? Shipping alone cost us almost two thousand dollars last year.

p34/p3-003-07.mp3.text: That's a good idea. Omar, could you find out what local rental companies charge?

p34/p3-003-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll have some quotes for you by Friday.

p34/p3-004-01.mp3.text: Ayumi, Westbrook Logistics just called. They'd like to move Thursday's contract meeting up to Tuesday morning.

p34/p3-004-02.mp3.text: Tuesday? Didn't you say you'd be at the safety training all day Tuesday?

p34/p3-004-03.mp3.text: Yes, and it's mandatory, so I can't skip it. I was hoping you could lead the meeting instead.

p34/p3-004-04.mp3.text: Well, I've only been on that account for two weeks.

p34/p3-004-05.mp3.text: I know, but you've read all the files, and Mr. Ferris will be there to handle any technical questions.

p34/p3-004-06.mp3.text: All right. But I'd like to go over the contract terms with you before then.

p34/p3-004-07.mp3.text: Of course. How about tomorrow at four? I'll bring my notes from our last negotiation.

p34/p3-004-08.mp3.text: Perfect. And I'll let Westbrook know that I'll be leading the meeting.

p34/p3-005-01.mp3.text: Excuse me, Tom. Do you know if the expense reporting system is working? I can't log in.

p34/p3-005-02.mp3.text: It's down this morning. The IT department is updating the software.

p34/p3-005-03.mp3.text: Oh no. I have to submit my travel expenses from the Chicago conference by five o'clock today.

p34/p3-005-04.mp3.text: Don't worry. Accounting sent out a message about it. You can fill out a paper form and drop it off at their office.

p34/p3-005-05.mp3.text: Oh, good. Where can I get the form?

p34/p3-005-06.mp3.text: There are some in the supply cabinet next to the copy machine. Come on, I'll show you.

p34/p3-005-07.mp3.text: Thanks. I need to attach my receipts too, right?

p34/p3-005-08.mp3.text: Yes, just staple them to the back of the form.

p34/p3-006-01.mp3.text: Kevin, I just got off the phone with the photo studio. The photographer we hired for the product shoot is sick.

p34/p3-006-02.mp3.text: Oh no. Can they send someone else?

p34/p3-006-03.mp3.text: Not until next week. So the photos won't be ready when we planned.

p34/p3-006-04.mp3.text: That's a problem. We can't finish the reviews page without those photos, either.

p34/p3-006-05.mp3.text: Right. Maybe we should ask the client if they'd accept a later launch date.

p34/p3-006-06.mp3.text: Let's not do that just yet. We could use the pictures from their old catalog as placeholders for now.

p34/p3-006-07.mp3.text: That could work. I'll ask the person in charge of the photos to go through the catalog this afternoon.

p34/p3-006-08.mp3.text: Good. Let me know which pictures they pick.

p34/p3-007-01.mp3.text: Sophie, I've been going over our department's spending for the first half of the year. We've already used eighty percent of our printing budget.

p34/p3-007-02.mp3.text: Eighty percent? How did that happen?

p34/p3-007-03.mp3.text: Mostly because of the training manuals. We printed new copies for every workshop this spring.

p34/p3-007-04.mp3.text: I see. Well, most participants bring laptops these days. We could share the manuals as digital files instead.

p34/p3-007-05.mp3.text: That would help a lot. But some people might still prefer paper copies.

p34/p3-007-06.mp3.text: Then let's print copies only for people who ask for them in advance.

p34/p3-007-07.mp3.text: Good idea. I'll add a question about that to the workshop registration form.

p34/p3-007-08.mp3.text: Great. And I'll tell the trainers about the change at Monday's meeting.

p34/p3-008-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming, Grace and Raj. We need to pick a new date for the planning workshop, since the hotel canceled our booking for the twelfth.

p34/p3-008-03.mp3.text: Some water pipes burst, and the whole conference floor is closed for repairs. They've offered us the nineteenth or the twenty-sixth instead.

p34/p3-008-04.mp3.text: The nineteenth won't work for my team. The auditors are coming that week, and I'll need everyone in the office.

p34/p3-008-05.mp3.text: The twenty-sixth is fine with me, but that's pretty close to the end of the quarter.

p34/p3-008-06.mp3.text: True, but I'd rather wait than hold the workshop without the accounting team.

p34/p3-008-07.mp3.text: I appreciate that. Should I let everyone know about the new date?

p34/p3-008-08.mp3.text: Actually, I'll send out the announcement once the hotel confirms. Could you just make sure your team keeps that day free?

p34/p3-009-01.mp3.text: Hi, Rebecca. Do you have a minute? I'm not sure the design for the annual report will be finished by Friday.

p34/p3-009-03.mp3.text: Marketing changed the cover photo yesterday, so I have to redo the layout of the first few pages.

p34/p3-009-04.mp3.text: I see. How much more time do you need?

p34/p3-009-05.mp3.text: I think I could have it done by next Wednesday.

p34/p3-009-06.mp3.text: Hmm. The printer needs the files by Monday.

p34/p3-009-07.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't realize that. Then I'll come in on Saturday and work on it.

p34/p3-009-08.mp3.text: You don't have to do that. Ji-ho finished his project early, so I'll ask him to help you with the inside pages.

p34/p3-010-01.mp3.text: Hi, Carla. Are you coming to the kickoff meeting for the mobile app project this afternoon?

p34/p3-010-02.mp3.text: Yes, I'll be there. It's at two o'clock in the main conference room, right?

p34/p3-010-03.mp3.text: That's right. Actually, could you do me a favor and take notes during the meeting?

p34/p3-010-04.mp3.text: Sure. But doesn't your assistant usually do that?

p34/p3-010-05.mp3.text: She does, but she's at a training session today.

p34/p3-010-06.mp3.text: I see. Should I send the notes to the whole team afterward?

p34/p3-010-07.mp3.text: Yes, please. And include a list of everyone's tasks, so people know what they're responsible for.

p34/p3-010-08.mp3.text: Got it. By the way, will the clients be joining us?

p34/p3-010-09.mp3.text: Not this time. We'll meet with them next week, once we've set the schedule.

p34/p3-011-01.mp3.text: Jamal, have you had a chance to look at the quotes for the new office chairs?

p34/p3-011-02.mp3.text: I have. The cheapest supplier looks attractive, but they can't deliver until the end of next month.

p34/p3-011-03.mp3.text: That's too late. The new hires start on the first, and they'll need somewhere to sit.

p34/p3-011-04.mp3.text: Exactly. And the most expensive one is way over our budget, even though their chairs are really comfortable.

p34/p3-011-05.mp3.text: So what about the other two?

p34/p3-011-06.mp3.text: I tried out a sample from each, and I'd go with the less expensive one. The quality's about the same, and they include free assembly.

p34/p3-011-07.mp3.text: Sounds good. But you'll need to get Mr. Okafor in purchasing to approve it before we place the order.

p34/p3-011-08.mp3.text: I'll take the paperwork to him right after lunch.
