p34/p3-012-01.mp3.text: Natalie, Victor, we need to set up the final interview for the sales manager position. The candidate, Ms. Reyes, can only come in on Wednesday.

p34/p3-012-02.mp3.text: Wednesday? I'll be at the regional office in Boston all day.

p34/p3-012-03.mp3.text: And I have client visits until two. I'm free in the afternoon, though.

p34/p3-012-04.mp3.text: OK. Natalie, could you join by video call?

p34/p3-012-05.mp3.text: I think so, since the Boston office has a meeting room with video equipment. I'll just need to know the exact time.

p34/p3-012-06.mp3.text: Let's say three o'clock. That'll give Victor time to get back from his client visits.

p34/p3-012-07.mp3.text: Sounds good. Should I book a room here?

p34/p3-012-08.mp3.text: Yes, please. Make sure it has a large screen, so Ms. Reyes can see Natalie clearly.

p34/p3-013-01.mp3.text: Brian, the renewal notice for our project management software came in this morning. The annual fee is going up by thirty percent.

p34/p3-013-02.mp3.text: Thirty percent? That's a lot more than we budgeted for.

p34/p3-013-03.mp3.text: I know. I looked into a few other programs, and some of them are quite a bit cheaper.

p34/p3-013-04.mp3.text: But switching would mean moving all our project files and retraining the whole staff.

p34/p3-013-05.mp3.text: That's true. Then again, the renewal isn't due until September.

p34/p3-013-07.mp3.text: I'd like to set up free trials of two alternatives and have a few people from each team test them.

p34/p3-013-08.mp3.text: OK. Just make sure the results are ready before the budget meeting in August.

p34/p3-014-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mark. Are we still meeting at three today to talk about your performance goals?

p34/p3-014-02.mp3.text: That's the plan. Is something wrong?

p34/p3-014-03.mp3.text: A client in Toronto just asked for a call at three, and it's the only time she's free this week.

p34/p3-014-04.mp3.text: No problem. Would tomorrow morning work instead?

p34/p3-014-05.mp3.text: I have a department meeting until ten. How about ten thirty?

p34/p3-014-06.mp3.text: Ten thirty is fine. Should I come to your office?

p34/p3-014-07.mp3.text: Actually, let's use the small meeting room on this floor. My office is being painted tomorrow.

p34/p3-014-09.mp3.text: Yes, please bring the self-evaluation form you filled out last week.

p34/p3-014-10.mp3.text: Sure, I'll print out a copy.

p34/p3-015-01.mp3.text: Olivia, is the annual report ready to go? The board meeting is on Thursday, and it's already Monday.

p34/p3-015-02.mp3.text: Almost. I'll have the final files ready before noon today.

p34/p3-015-03.mp3.text: Good. I checked the print shop's price list, and the standard service takes five business days, so that's out.

p34/p3-015-04.mp3.text: Right. I'd like to have the copies by Wednesday, so we have time to check them for errors before the meeting.

p34/p3-015-05.mp3.text: The fastest option would get them to us tomorrow, but it's really expensive.

p34/p3-015-06.mp3.text: We don't need them that early. Let's go with the cheapest option that still gets them here by Wednesday.

p34/p3-015-07.mp3.text: OK. I'll place the order as soon as you send me the files.

p34/p3-015-08.mp3.text: Thanks. And could you ask them to deliver the copies to my office?

p34/p3-016-01.mp3.text: Hello, this is Grace Holloway from the human resources department at Pemberton Logistics. May I speak with Daniel Ruiz?

p34/p3-016-02.mp3.text: This is Daniel. Hi, Ms. Holloway. Is this about my interview on Thursday?

p34/p3-016-03.mp3.text: Yes, it is. Unfortunately, the hiring manager has to fly to a client meeting that day. Would you be able to come in on Friday morning instead?

p34/p3-016-04.mp3.text: Friday works for me. What time should I be there?

p34/p3-016-05.mp3.text: How about ten o'clock? The interview will take about an hour, and you'll also meet some members of the accounting team.

p34/p3-016-06.mp3.text: Ten is fine. Should I bring anything with me?

p34/p3-016-07.mp3.text: Please bring two copies of your resume and a list of references. I'll e-mail you directions to our office this afternoon.

p34/p3-016-08.mp3.text: Great, thank you. I look forward to meeting everyone.

p34/p3-017-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming, Priya and Lena. As you know, we're switching to a new expense reporting system next month.

p34/p3-017-02.mp3.text: I'd like the two of you to lead the training sessions for our department.

p34/p3-017-03.mp3.text: We'd be happy to. Have you decided on a format yet?

p34/p3-017-04.mp3.text: I was thinking of a single two-hour workshop in the large conference room.

p34/p3-017-05.mp3.text: Honestly, I think that might be too long. People tend to lose focus after the first hour, especially with software training.

p34/p3-017-06.mp3.text: I agree with Lena. What if we held several shorter sessions with smaller groups? That way, everyone could practice on a laptop.

p34/p3-017-07.mp3.text: That makes sense. But we'd need enough laptops for everyone.

p34/p3-017-08.mp3.text: The IT department has some loaner laptops. I can ask them if we can borrow ten for a couple of weeks.

p34/p3-017-09.mp3.text: Perfect. Please do that. And Priya, could you draft a schedule and send it to me by Friday?

p34/p3-018-01.mp3.text: Kevin, do you know what's wrong with the printer on this floor? I've been trying to print a contract for ten minutes.

p34/p3-018-02.mp3.text: It's been jamming all morning. I think the paper tray is too full, or maybe someone loaded the wrong type of paper.

p34/p3-018-03.mp3.text: That's frustrating. I need to give this contract to a client at eleven.

p34/p3-018-04.mp3.text: You could use the printer in the marketing department on the third floor. It's usually not very busy.

p34/p3-018-05.mp3.text: Good idea. But will my computer be able to send files to that printer?

p34/p3-018-06.mp3.text: It should. Just select "Marketing 3F" from the printer list.

p34/p3-018-07.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll do that now. Could you let the office manager know about this printer, though?

p34/p3-018-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll e-mail her right away.

p34/p3-019-01.mp3.text: Hi, this is Ivan from the IT help desk. You submitted a request about remote access?

p34/p3-019-02.mp3.text: Yes, thanks for calling back. I'm working from home tomorrow, but I can't log in to the company network from my laptop.

p34/p3-019-03.mp3.text: It keeps saying my password is invalid.

p34/p3-019-04.mp3.text: Did you change your office password recently?

p34/p3-019-05.mp3.text: I did, on Monday. The system asked me to update it.

p34/p3-019-06.mp3.text: That's probably the problem. The remote access program doesn't always update right away. It can take up to twenty-four hours.

p34/p3-019-07.mp3.text: Twenty-four hours? I have a presentation to prepare tonight.

p34/p3-019-08.mp3.text: I can reset your connection from here right now. It only takes a few minutes, but you'll need to restart your laptop afterward.

p34/p3-019-09.mp3.text: That would be great. Should I stay on the line?

p34/p3-019-10.mp3.text: Yes, please. I'll walk you through the steps.

p34/p3-020-01.mp3.text: Hi, Tom. Have you seen the schedule for the move to the new building?

p34/p3-020-02.mp3.text: Yes, it was posted this morning. My department goes first, so I've already started packing up my desk.

p34/p3-020-03.mp3.text: Lucky you. My team moves the day after Customer Service, and we have a big product launch that week.

p34/p3-020-04.mp3.text: That's tough timing. Have you asked the facilities manager about changing the date?

p34/p3-020-05.mp3.text: I did, but the moving company is fully booked on all the other days.

p34/p3-020-06.mp3.text: Well, here's an idea. Your team could pack everything a few days early and work on the shared laptops in the lounge until the move.

p34/p3-020-07.mp3.text: That might work. I'll suggest it to my team at our meeting this afternoon.

p34/p3-020-08.mp3.text: Also, make sure everyone labels their boxes with their new room number. The movers won't take anything without a label.

p34/p3-021-01.mp3.text: Hi, Sandra. I just got approval to attend the retail technology conference in Denver next month.

p34/p3-021-02.mp3.text: Congratulations! Would you like me to make your travel arrangements?

p34/p3-021-03.mp3.text: Yes, please. The conference runs from the twelfth to the fourteenth. Could you book a flight that gets me there the evening before?

p34/p3-021-04.mp3.text: Sure. Do you want to stay at the conference hotel? It's a bit expensive, but it's right next to the convention center.

p34/p3-021-05.mp3.text: I'd rather find something cheaper. The department's travel budget is tight this quarter.

p34/p3-021-06.mp3.text: There's a business hotel about ten minutes away by shuttle bus. I'll check if it has rooms available.

p34/p3-021-07.mp3.text: Thanks. And could you also register me for the conference? The early registration discount ends on Friday.

p34/p3-021-08.mp3.text: No problem. I'll take care of that today.

p34/p3-022-01.mp3.text: Diane, I'm booking your flight to Toronto for the eighteenth. What time is your meeting with Halvorsen Manufacturing?

p34/p3-022-02.mp3.text: It starts at one thirty at their headquarters downtown. How long is the ride from the airport?

p34/p3-022-03.mp3.text: Usually about an hour by taxi, depending on traffic. Here are the options for that day.

p34/p3-022-04.mp3.text: Hmm, the last one is the cheapest, but it obviously won't work.

p34/p3-022-05.mp3.text: Right. The ten-fifteen flight would get you downtown just before the meeting starts.

p34/p3-022-06.mp3.text: That's cutting it too close. If there's any delay, I'll be late. I'd rather have some extra time.

p34/p3-022-07.mp3.text: Then there's the six forty-five, but you'd have to leave home around four in the morning.

p34/p3-022-08.mp3.text: No, thanks. I'll take the one in between. Oh, and will the company cover a hotel that night? The meeting might run late.

p34/p3-022-09.mp3.text: Yes, as long as it's under the nightly limit. I'll book one near the client's office and send you the confirmation.

p34/p3-023-01.mp3.text: So, we've narrowed it down to two candidates for the regional sales manager position. Let's try to decide today.

p34/p3-023-02.mp3.text: I was really impressed by Ms. Okafor. She's managed a sales team before, and her results at her last company were outstanding.

p34/p3-023-03.mp3.text: She's strong, but she mentioned she can't start until September. We need someone in place before our busy season begins in July.

p34/p3-023-04.mp3.text: That's a fair point. What about Mr. Brandt, Hiroshi?

p34/p3-023-05.mp3.text: He has less management experience, but he already knows our product line well. He used to work for one of our distributors.

p34/p3-023-06.mp3.text: True. Still, the role involves leading a team of twelve. I'm not sure he's ready for that.

p34/p3-023-07.mp3.text: What if we hired Mr. Brandt and enrolled him in the leadership course our training department offers?

p34/p3-023-08.mp3.text: That could work. It starts next month, doesn't it?

p34/p3-023-09.mp3.text: Yes. I'll check whether there's still space in it before we make him an offer.

p34/p3-024-01.mp3.text: Hi, is this the building maintenance office? I'm calling from Suite 400, Kellerman Design.

p34/p3-024-02.mp3.text: Yes, this is maintenance. How can I help you?

p34/p3-024-03.mp3.text: The air conditioning in our main conference room isn't working. It's really hot in there, and we have clients arriving at two o'clock.

p34/p3-024-04.mp3.text: I'm sorry about that. Our technician is repairing a water leak on the second floor right now, but I can send him up in about an hour.

p34/p3-024-05.mp3.text: That should give him enough time before our meeting. Is there anything we can do in the meantime?

p34/p3-024-06.mp3.text: I can bring up a couple of portable fans while you wait. That should cool the room down a little.

p34/p3-024-07.mp3.text: That would help a lot. Thank you so much.

p34/p3-025-01.mp3.text: Marcus, do you have a minute? I wanted to ask you about the mentoring program for new hires.

p34/p3-025-02.mp3.text: Sure. Are you thinking of signing up as a mentor?

p34/p3-025-03.mp3.text: Actually, I've been asked to coordinate it this year. Last year's participants found it helpful, but the mentors said it took up too much of their time.

p34/p3-025-04.mp3.text: I remember that. Mentors had to meet with their new hires every week for six months.

p34/p3-025-05.mp3.text: Exactly. I'm thinking of changing it to every other week. But I'm worried the new employees won't get enough support.

p34/p3-025-06.mp3.text: Well, you could add a group lunch once a month. New hires could ask questions there, and the mentors could take turns attending.

p34/p3-025-07.mp3.text: I like that. Would you be willing to be one of the mentors?

p34/p3-025-08.mp3.text: My calendar is packed until the end of the quarter.

p34/p3-025-09.mp3.text: The program doesn't start until October.

p34/p3-025-10.mp3.text: In that case, count me in.

p34/p3-026-01.mp3.text: Hi, Rachel. I finished putting together the help desk report for April. Do you want to look at it before the managers' meeting?

p34/p3-026-02.mp3.text: Yes, thanks. Wow, password resets are still at the top.

p34/p3-026-03.mp3.text: True, but that number should drop a lot now. Since last Monday, employees have been able to reset their own passwords online.

p34/p3-026-04.mp3.text: Good. And the new laptops arriving next month will have all the standard programs already installed, so those requests should decrease too.

p34/p3-026-05.mp3.text: So where should we focus our efforts next?

p34/p3-026-06.mp3.text: Let's take on the biggest of the remaining categories. Could you find out what's causing most of those problems?

p34/p3-026-07.mp3.text: Sure. I'll go through the individual tickets this afternoon and look for patterns.

p34/p3-026-08.mp3.text: Great. Then we can present some solutions at the meeting on Thursday.

p34/p3-027-01.mp3.text: Hi, Jamal. Are you ready for the move to the new office on Friday?

p34/p3-027-02.mp3.text: Almost. I've packed most of my files, but I've run out of boxes.

p34/p3-027-03.mp3.text: The facilities team left some extra boxes in the supply room this morning. You can take as many as you need.

p34/p3-027-04.mp3.text: Great. Do you know if we should pack our computers, too?

p34/p3-027-05.mp3.text: No, the IT staff will disconnect and move all the computers on Thursday evening. We only need to pack our documents and personal items.

p34/p3-027-06.mp3.text: That's a relief. I wasn't sure how to pack my monitor safely.

p34/p3-027-07.mp3.text: Also, don't forget to write your name and new desk number on every box.

p34/p3-027-08.mp3.text: Thanks for the reminder. I'll go grab some boxes now.

p34/p3-028-01.mp3.text: OK, so the three of us are visiting the Riverside plant next Tuesday for the equipment inspection. How should we get there?

p34/p3-028-02.mp3.text: The train is one option, but the station is about twenty minutes from the plant, and there usually aren't any taxis around.

p34/p3-028-03.mp3.text: Why don't we rent a car? I'd be happy to drive. It's about a three-hour trip.

p34/p3-028-04.mp3.text: That would give us more flexibility, too. We could stop by the supplier's warehouse on the way back.

p34/p3-028-05.mp3.text: Good idea. But we should leave early. The inspection starts at ten.

p34/p3-028-06.mp3.text: Let's meet in the office parking lot at six thirty, then.

p34/p3-028-07.mp3.text: That works for me. Ethan, would you reserve the car? You have the company's account with the rental agency.

p34/p3-028-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll book one this afternoon. I'll get a large SUV, since we'll be carrying some testing equipment.

p34/p3-029-01.mp3.text: Hi, Lucia. Do you have a moment? I wanted to talk about my vacation request for the last week of August.

p34/p3-029-02.mp3.text: Sure, Paul. I saw it this morning. The only issue is that Hannah will also be away that week.

p34/p3-029-03.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't know that. Is that a problem?

p34/p3-029-04.mp3.text: Well, the quarterly client reports are due on the thirtieth, and you two usually prepare them.

p34/p3-029-05.mp3.text: I see. What if I finished my part of the reports before I left?

p34/p3-029-06.mp3.text: That would be ideal, but the sales figures won't be available until the twenty-fifth.

p34/p3-029-07.mp3.text: Hmm. Then could someone from the finance team help out while we're gone?

p34/p3-029-08.mp3.text: Jin-woo filled in last year. He did a great job.

p34/p3-029-09.mp3.text: Then I'll ask him today whether he'd be available.

p34/p3-029-10.mp3.text: Thanks. Once that's settled, I'll approve your request.

p34/p3-030-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Ferraro. I heard the parking garage will be closed starting next Monday. Is that right?

p34/p3-030-02.mp3.text: Yes. Building management sent an e-mail about it yesterday. They're repaving the whole garage, and it'll take about two weeks.

p34/p3-030-03.mp3.text: Two weeks? Where are we supposed to park?

p34/p3-030-04.mp3.text: The company has arranged for us to use the lot at Westfield Shopping Center. A free shuttle will run between there and our building every fifteen minutes.

p34/p3-030-05.mp3.text: That's helpful. But I usually get here at seven, which is pretty early. Will the shuttle be running then?

p34/p3-030-06.mp3.text: I'm not sure. The e-mail didn't mention the hours. You should check with the front desk in the lobby.

p34/p3-030-07.mp3.text: I'll do that. Otherwise, I might just take the subway for those two weeks.

p34/p3-031-01.mp3.text: Hi, I bought this coffee maker here last week, but it didn't come with a water filter. The box says one should be included.

p34/p3-031-02.mp3.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have your receipt with you?

p34/p3-031-03.mp3.text: Yes, here it is. I'd really like to keep the coffee maker, though. I just need the filter.

p34/p3-031-04.mp3.text: Unfortunately, we don't sell the filters separately, and that model is sold out right now. I can give you a full refund, or you can wait for our next shipment on Thursday.

p34/p3-031-05.mp3.text: Hmm, I'd rather not wait. Could I exchange it for a similar model instead?

p34/p3-031-06.mp3.text: Sure. The coffee makers in aisle six are in the same price range. Let me walk you over there.

p34/p3-032-01.mp3.text: Good morning, welcome to the Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?

p34/p3-032-02.mp3.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Nadia Petrov. I know check-in isn't until three, but my flight landed early. Is my room ready by any chance?

p34/p3-032-03.mp3.text: Let me check. I'm afraid housekeeping is still cleaning it. It should be ready around one o'clock.

p34/p3-032-04.mp3.text: Oh, OK. I have a meeting with a client at two, and I was hoping to change clothes before that.

p34/p3-032-05.mp3.text: I understand. We have a guest lounge on the second floor with private changing rooms. You're welcome to use it, and we can keep your luggage here at the desk.

p34/p3-032-06.mp3.text: That would be perfect. Thank you so much.

p34/p3-032-07.mp3.text: My pleasure. I'll just need a credit card for incidentals, and then I'll show you to the elevator.

p34/p3-033-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling Bella Cucina Catering. This is Marco speaking.

p34/p3-033-02.mp3.text: Hi, I'm calling from Lindell Accounting. We're holding an all-day training workshop next Wednesday, and we'd like to order lunch for about thirty people.

p34/p3-033-03.mp3.text: Great. Have you had a chance to look at the lunch packages on our Web site?

p34/p3-033-04.mp3.text: I have. Since everyone will be here all day, we'd prefer a hot meal to sandwiches. But we don't need drinks. Our office already provides coffee and juice.

p34/p3-033-05.mp3.text: Got it. One thing, though. For orders of over twenty-five people, we require a fifty-percent deposit at least three days in advance.

p34/p3-033-06.mp3.text: That shouldn't be a problem. Can I pay it by credit card?

p34/p3-033-07.mp3.text: Of course. I'll e-mail you an order form now. Just fill it out and send it back with your card details.

p34/p3-034-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon, Hartley Furniture customer service. How can I help you?

p34/p3-034-02.mp3.text: Hi, this is Owen Clarke. I ordered a sofa from you two weeks ago, and it was supposed to be delivered yesterday. But nobody showed up.

p34/p3-034-03.mp3.text: I'm so sorry, Mr. Clarke. Let me look up your order. It seems one of our delivery trucks broke down, so several deliveries were postponed.

p34/p3-034-04.mp3.text: Well, I took the whole day off work to wait for it.

p34/p3-034-05.mp3.text: I really apologize. We should have called you. The earliest we can deliver it now is Saturday.

p34/p3-034-06.mp3.text: Saturday? I'll be out of town all weekend.

p34/p3-034-07.mp3.text: In that case, we could come on Monday evening instead, between six and eight. And we'll waive the delivery fee for the inconvenience.

p34/p3-034-08.mp3.text: Monday evening works for me. Thanks.

p34/p3-035-01.mp3.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

p34/p3-035-02.mp3.text: No, we don't. Do you have a table for two?

p34/p3-035-03.mp3.text: I'm afraid all of our tables are full at the moment. The wait is about thirty minutes.

p34/p3-035-04.mp3.text: Thirty minutes? Mia, our movie starts at eight-thirty.

p34/p3-035-05.mp3.text: Right. Is there any way we could be seated sooner?

p34/p3-035-06.mp3.text: Well, there are two seats available at the counter right now. You can order from the full menu there.

p34/p3-035-07.mp3.text: That's fine with me. What do you think, Mia?

p34/p3-035-08.mp3.text: Sure, let's do that. And since we're in a bit of a hurry, could we get our menus right away?

p34/p3-035-09.mp3.text: Of course. Please follow me, and I'll bring your menus and some water right over.

p34/p3-036-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Okafor? This is Grace Lin from the Sterling Hotel's sales office. I'm returning your call about rooms for your conference in May.

p34/p3-036-02.mp3.text: Thanks for calling back. We're expecting around sixty attendees, and we'd like to reserve forty rooms for three nights.

p34/p3-036-03.mp3.text: We can certainly do that. For a group of that size, our rate is one hundred and forty dollars per night.

p34/p3-036-04.mp3.text: Hmm. The Riverside Inn offered us a hundred and twenty.

p34/p3-036-05.mp3.text: I see. Well, our rate does include breakfast and a free shuttle to the convention center.

p34/p3-036-06.mp3.text: That's worth considering. The Riverside Inn is actually a bit far from the convention center.

p34/p3-036-07.mp3.text: And if you confirm by the end of this month, I can also offer you a meeting room free of charge for your welcome reception.

p34/p3-036-08.mp3.text: That sounds great. Let me run it by my director, and I'll get back to you by Friday.

p34/p3-037-01.mp3.text: Excuse me. I'd like to buy these pants, but they're a little too long. Do you offer alterations here?

p34/p3-037-02.mp3.text: Yes, we do. Our tailor can shorten them for you. It's free with any purchase over fifty dollars.

p34/p3-037-03.mp3.text: Great. These are sixty, so that works. How long will it take?

p34/p3-037-04.mp3.text: It usually takes about three days, but we're very busy this week because of our holiday sale. They'll probably be ready next Monday.

p34/p3-037-05.mp3.text: That's fine. I don't need them until the end of the month.

p34/p3-037-06.mp3.text: Perfect. Could you write your phone number on this form? We'll send you a text message when they're ready.

p34/p3-038-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling FreshBox Meal Kits. My name is Erin. How may I help you?

p34/p3-038-02.mp3.text: Hi. I canceled my subscription last month, but I was still charged for this month's delivery.

p34/p3-038-03.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have the e-mail address on your account?

p34/p3-038-05.mp3.text: Thank you, Mr. Patel. I see what happened. Your cancellation request came in on the fifth, but the deadline for this billing cycle was the third.

p34/p3-038-06.mp3.text: I didn't know there was a deadline. And I haven't received a box this month, either.

p34/p3-038-07.mp3.text: That's because the shipment was stopped after you canceled. Since nothing was sent, I'll refund the full amount to your card. It should appear within five business days.

p34/p3-038-08.mp3.text: Thanks. Could you also send me a confirmation by e-mail?

p34/p3-038-09.mp3.text: Certainly. I'll send it right after this call.

p34/p3-039-01.mp3.text: Ms. Romero, thanks for meeting with us. Daniel and I are organizing our company's twentieth anniversary dinner, and we'd like your firm to cater it.

p34/p3-039-02.mp3.text: I'm glad to hear that. When is the event, and how many guests are you expecting?

p34/p3-039-03.mp3.text: It's on October eighteenth, and we're expecting about a hundred and fifty people.

p34/p3-039-04.mp3.text: One thing we're concerned about is dietary needs. Last year's caterer offered only one vegetarian dish, and a lot of guests complained.

p34/p3-039-05.mp3.text: That won't be an issue. We always include several vegetarian and gluten-free options. We could also set up a tasting so you can try some dishes beforehand.

p34/p3-039-06.mp3.text: That'd be helpful. Our CEO will want to be involved in choosing the menu.

p34/p3-039-07.mp3.text: Then let's schedule it for a time when she can attend. Does next week work?

p34/p3-039-08.mp3.text: I'll have to check her calendar first. I'll e-mail you some possible dates this afternoon.

p34/p3-040-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm checking out tomorrow morning, and I'd like to take the hotel shuttle to the airport. Do I need to reserve a seat?

p34/p3-040-02.mp3.text: Yes, we recommend it, since the shuttle fills up quickly. What time is your flight?

p34/p3-040-03.mp3.text: It's at noon, but it's an international flight, so I'd like to get to the airport at least two hours early.

p34/p3-040-04.mp3.text: All right. Just so you know, the first shuttle of the day leaves before our restaurant opens for breakfast.

p34/p3-040-05.mp3.text: Oh, I definitely want to eat before I go.

p34/p3-040-06.mp3.text: Then I'll put you down for the shuttle that fits your schedule. Could I have your room number?

p34/p3-040-07.mp3.text: It's 512. Also, is there somewhere I can leave my bags while I'm having breakfast?

p34/p3-040-08.mp3.text: Sure. Just bring them down to the front desk, and the driver will load them onto the shuttle for you.

p34/p3-041-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm interested in this laptop, but it's listed for sixty dollars less on Valtek Electronics' Web site. Do you match competitors' prices?

p34/p3-041-02.mp3.text: We do, as long as it's the same model and the other store has it in stock. Do you have the listing with you?

p34/p3-041-03.mp3.text: Yes, here it is on my phone.

p34/p3-041-04.mp3.text: Let me see. Oh, this one is refurbished. Our policy only applies to brand-new items.

p34/p3-041-06.mp3.text: But we're having a back-to-school promotion this week. With any laptop, you get a free carrying case and an extra year of warranty coverage.

p34/p3-041-07.mp3.text: An extra year of warranty? That usually costs more than sixty dollars.

p34/p3-041-08.mp3.text: Exactly. And the promotion ends on Sunday.

p34/p3-041-09.mp3.text: In that case, I'll take it. Do you have one in silver, though?

p34/p3-041-10.mp3.text: Let me go check our stockroom.

p34/p3-042-01.mp3.text: Carlos, do you have a minute? The customers at table eight have been waiting almost forty minutes for their food.

p34/p3-042-03.mp3.text: I checked with the kitchen. Their order never appeared on the screen. I think it's the new ordering system again.

p34/p3-042-04.mp3.text: That's the third time this week. I'll call the software company this afternoon. In the meantime, let's make sure their meals are prepared right away.

p34/p3-042-05.mp3.text: The chef is already working on it. But they seem pretty upset.

p34/p3-042-06.mp3.text: I'll go over and apologize to them myself. And let's not charge them for their meals tonight.

p34/p3-042-08.mp3.text: They're regular customers, and we want them to keep coming back. Could you take them some bread while they wait?

p34/p3-043-01.mp3.text: Greenfield Market customer service, this is Tom. How can I help you?

p34/p3-043-02.mp3.say: Hi, I'm a member of your rewards program, and I'd like to check my point balance. My member number is 4 0 7 1, 2 2 3 6.
p34/p3-043-02.mp3.text: Hi, I'm a member of your rewards program, and I'd like to check my point balance. My member number is 4071-2236.

p34/p3-043-03.mp3.text: Thank you. You currently have nine hundred and twenty points.

p34/p3-043-04.mp3.text: OK. I'm planning to order groceries for a party this weekend, and it'll probably come to around a hundred dollars. How many points would I earn?

p34/p3-043-05.mp3.text: You get one point for every dollar you spend, so about a hundred points. That would move you up to the next level.

p34/p3-043-06.mp3.text: Great. Do I need to do anything to activate the new benefit?

p34/p3-043-07.mp3.text: No, it's applied automatically the day after your level changes.

p34/p3-043-08.mp3.text: Perfect. And can I schedule the delivery for Saturday morning?

p34/p3-043-09.mp3.text: Sure, but Saturday slots fill up fast, so I'd recommend placing your order online today.

p34/p3-044-01.mp3.text: Hello, this is Laura Kim. I stayed in room 304 at your hotel until this morning, and I think I left my phone charger there.

p34/p3-044-02.mp3.text: Let me check with housekeeping, Ms. Kim. Could you hold for a moment?

p34/p3-044-04.mp3.text: Thanks for waiting. Yes, they found a black charger in your room. It's at the front desk now.

p34/p3-044-05.mp3.text: Oh, good. Unfortunately, I've already left town. Could you mail it to me?

p34/p3-044-06.mp3.text: Of course. We can send it by express mail. There's a small shipping fee, which we'll charge to the card you used for your stay.

p34/p3-044-07.mp3.text: That's fine. Let me give you my home address.

p34/p3-045-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up an online order. The name is Hannah Brooks.

p34/p3-045-02.mp3.text: Let me find it. Here you go, Ms. Brooks. That's a desk lamp and two packs of printer paper.

p34/p3-045-03.mp3.text: Hmm, I also ordered a desk chair. My confirmation e-mail lists three items.

p34/p3-045-04.mp3.text: I see that in the system, but it's not on the shelf. Let me ask my manager. Jun, do you know anything about a chair for this order?

p34/p3-045-05.mp3.text: Yes. We didn't have it in stock here, so it's being shipped from our warehouse. It should arrive tomorrow afternoon.

p34/p3-045-06.mp3.text: Oh, nobody told me that. I live forty minutes away, you know.

p34/p3-045-07.mp3.text: I'm sorry about that. We can have the chair delivered to your home at no charge. It'd be there by Thursday.

p34/p3-045-09.mp3.text: Great. I'll just need you to confirm your address on this form.

p34/p3-046-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm checking in for the 10:15 flight to Vancouver. Here's my passport.

p34/p3-046-02.mp3.text: Thank you, Ms. Ortega. Are you checking any bags today?

p34/p3-046-03.mp3.text: Just this suitcase. I packed a lot of books for a conference, so it might be heavy.

p34/p3-046-04.mp3.text: Let me see. It's twenty-six kilograms. Unfortunately, the limit for economy is twenty-three.

p34/p3-046-05.mp3.text: Oh no. Is there an extra charge?

p34/p3-046-06.mp3.text: Yes, it's forty dollars. But if you move a few items into your carry-on, you can avoid the fee.

p34/p3-046-07.mp3.text: That's a good idea. I have some room in my backpack.

p34/p3-046-08.mp3.text: Great. You can step aside over there and repack. I'll help the next customer in the meantime.

p34/p3-047-01.mp3.text: Hello, I'm calling about the two-bedroom apartment on Maple Street that's listed on your Web site. Is it still available?

p34/p3-047-02.mp3.text: It is. We've had a lot of interest, though. Three people are coming to see it tomorrow.

p34/p3-047-03.mp3.text: I see. The listing says the rent includes utilities. Is that right?

p34/p3-047-04.mp3.text: Yes, water, heat, and electricity are all covered. Internet is extra, though.

p34/p3-047-05.mp3.text: That's fine. What about parking? I drive to work every day.

p34/p3-047-06.mp3.text: There's a garage under the building, but spaces are given out on a first-come, first-served basis.

p34/p3-047-07.mp3.text: Hmm. Could I see the apartment this afternoon? I'm free after four.

p34/p3-047-08.mp3.text: I have another showing at four, but I could meet you at five thirty.

p34/p3-047-09.mp3.text: Perfect. I'll bring copies of my pay stubs in case I decide to apply.

p34/p3-048-01.mp3.text: Good morning, Lakeside Dental. Do you have an appointment?

p34/p3-048-02.mp3.text: Yes, I'm Daniel Kim. I have a cleaning at nine. Sorry I'm late. The traffic on the bridge was terrible.

p34/p3-048-03.mp3.text: That's all right. Before you go in, could you update your insurance information on this form? Our records still show your old provider.

p34/p3-048-04.mp3.text: Sure. I changed jobs in June, so I have a new plan now.

p34/p3-048-05.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Kim. I'm Sophia, the hygienist. When you're done with the form, come right in.

p34/p3-048-06.mp3.text: Thanks. Actually, one of my back teeth has been sensitive to cold drinks lately.

p34/p3-048-07.mp3.text: I'll take a look during the cleaning. If necessary, Dr. Patel can examine it today. She has an opening at ten.

p34/p3-048-08.mp3.text: That would be great. I'd rather not come back another day.

p34/p3-049-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to open a business checking account. I just started a small catering company.

p34/p3-049-02.mp3.text: Congratulations. I can help you with that. Do you have your business license with you?

p34/p3-049-03.mp3.text: Yes, here it is, along with my driver's license.

p34/p3-049-04.mp3.text: Thank you. Our basic business account has no monthly fee as long as you keep at least five hundred dollars in it.

p34/p3-049-05.mp3.text: That sounds good. I don't expect to have many transactions at first.

p34/p3-049-06.mp3.text: Then the basic account should work well. You'll just need to sign a few forms. It'll take about fifteen minutes.

p34/p3-049-07.mp3.text: No problem. Oh, and can I order checks today too?

p34/p3-049-08.mp3.text: Sure. They'll be mailed to your business address within a week.

p34/p3-050-01.mp3.text: Excuse me, I'd like a one-way ticket to Brookfield. I have a meeting there at four this afternoon.

p34/p3-050-02.mp3.text: Let me check. I'm afraid the 1:45 express is completely sold out.

p34/p3-050-03.mp3.text: Oh, that's a shame. How about the next express train?

p34/p3-050-04.mp3.text: That one wouldn't get you to Brookfield until about four fifteen.

p34/p3-050-05.mp3.text: Then that won't work. Is there anything else?

p34/p3-050-06.mp3.text: There's a local train that leaves before the 1:45. It makes more stops, but it arrives at 3:20.

p34/p3-050-07.mp3.text: Great, I'll take that one. Do you accept credit cards?

p34/p3-050-08.mp3.text: Of course. And if you buy your return ticket now, you'll get ten percent off.

p34/p3-050-09.mp3.text: Oh, in that case, make it a round trip, please.

p34/p3-051-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to send this package to my sister in Madrid. It's a birthday present.

p34/p3-051-02.mp3.text: Sure. Please put it on the scale. What's inside?

p34/p3-051-03.mp3.text: A sweater and a couple of books.

p34/p3-051-04.mp3.text: OK. Standard international shipping takes about two weeks. Express takes three to five days, but it costs more.

p34/p3-051-05.mp3.text: Her birthday is next Friday, so I'd better go with express.

p34/p3-051-06.mp3.text: All right. That'll be fifty-two dollars. You'll also need to fill out this customs form.

p34/p3-051-07.mp3.text: Do I need to list the value of each item?

p34/p3-051-08.mp3.text: Yes, write each item and its approximate value on a separate line. Then sign at the bottom.

p34/p3-052-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm calling about renewing the vendor permit for my food truck. It expires at the end of the month.

p34/p3-052-02.mp3.text: OK. Have you submitted your updated health inspection certificate? We can't process renewals without it.

p34/p3-052-03.mp3.text: Well, the inspection was done last week, but the inspector said the certificate could take ten business days to arrive.

p34/p3-052-04.mp3.text: Ten business days? Your permit expires in eight.

p34/p3-052-05.mp3.text: I know. Is there anything I can do? I'm booked for a big festival the first weekend of next month.

p34/p3-052-06.mp3.text: You could apply for a temporary extension. It's valid for thirty days, so you'd be covered until the certificate comes through.

p34/p3-052-07.mp3.text: That would solve everything. How do I apply?

p34/p3-052-08.mp3.text: The form is on our Web site. Just attach a copy of your inspection receipt and e-mail it to us by Friday.

p34/p3-053-01.mp3.text: So this is the suite on the third floor. As you can see, it gets a lot of natural light.

p34/p3-053-02.mp3.text: It's lovely, and it's much bigger than our current office. Tom, what do you think?

p34/p3-053-03.mp3.text: I like it, but the monthly rent is a bit more than we'd planned to spend.

p34/p3-053-04.mp3.text: The owner is willing to lower it if you sign a three-year lease instead of a one-year lease.

p34/p3-053-05.mp3.text: That's a long commitment for a company our size, though. We're still figuring out how fast we'll grow.

p34/p3-053-06.mp3.text: I understand. Another option is a unit on the first floor. It's smaller, but it comes with free parking for staff.

p34/p3-053-07.mp3.text: Hmm, parking is expensive around here. That could save our employees a lot of money.

p34/p3-053-08.mp3.text: Why don't we take a look at it before we decide? Do you have time now, Mr. Hayes?

p34/p3-053-09.mp3.text: Sure. I'll grab the keys from the front desk.

p34/p3-054-01.mp3.text: Greenfield Medical Clinic. How can I help you?

p34/p3-054-02.mp3.text: Hi, this is Laura Chen. I have an appointment with Dr. Russo on Thursday at two, but I need to change it.

p34/p3-054-03.mp3.text: Sure, I can help with that.

p34/p3-054-04.mp3.text: Thanks. My company is sending me to Chicago for a client meeting that day.

p34/p3-054-05.mp3.text: I see. Dr. Russo has openings on Monday morning at nine or Tuesday afternoon at three.

p34/p3-054-06.mp3.text: Monday at nine works for me.

p34/p3-054-07.mp3.text: OK, you're all set for Monday at nine. Since it's your first visit, please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out some paperwork.

p34/p3-054-08.mp3.text: Will do. Should I bring anything?

p34/p3-054-09.mp3.text: Just your insurance card and a list of any medications you're taking.

p34/p3-055-01.mp3.text: Jason, I just checked the departures board. Our flight has been delayed by an hour.

p34/p3-055-02.mp3.text: Really? Then we'll miss the opening session of the trade show.

p34/p3-055-03.mp3.text: Probably. I'll send a message to Ms. Ward so she knows we'll be late.

p34/p3-055-04.mp3.text: Good idea. Since we have extra time, do you want to get something to eat? I skipped breakfast.

p34/p3-055-05.mp3.text: Sure. There's a café right next to our gate, and I've heard their sandwiches are good.

p34/p3-055-06.mp3.text: Sounds great. I also want to use the time to go over our presentation slides once more.

p34/p3-055-07.mp3.text: Let's do that while we eat. I have the file on my laptop.

p34/p3-056-01.mp3.text: Thank you for calling Westbrook Bank card services. This is Kevin.

p34/p3-056-02.mp3.text: Hi, I'm traveling in Lisbon, and I think I left my credit card at a restaurant last night. I went back this morning, but they didn't have it.

p34/p3-056-03.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can cancel the card right away so no one else can use it.

p34/p3-056-04.mp3.text: Yes, please. Could you also check whether there have been any charges since last night?

p34/p3-056-05.mp3.text: Let me see. The last purchase was forty-eight euros at a restaurant at 9:30 P.M. Nothing after that.

p34/p3-056-06.mp3.text: That was my dinner. What a relief.

p34/p3-056-07.mp3.text: I'll send a replacement card to your home address. Or, for a small fee, we can ship it to your hotel within two days.

p34/p3-056-08.mp3.text: I'll be here for another week, so please send it to the hotel.

p34/p3-057-01.mp3.text: Hi, I reserved a compact car for three days. The name is Robert Ellis.

p34/p3-057-02.mp3.text: Welcome, Mr. Ellis. Let me pull up your reservation. Hmm, it looks like all our compact cars are out right now. A few customers returned them late.

p34/p3-057-03.mp3.text: Oh no. I have to be at a meeting downtown in an hour.

p34/p3-057-04.mp3.text: Let me ask my manager. Andre, do we have anything else available for Mr. Ellis?

p34/p3-057-05.mp3.text: We have a midsize sedan ready to go. Mr. Ellis, you can have it for the compact price, since this is our fault.

p34/p3-057-07.mp3.text: The sedan also has a built-in navigation system, so you won't need to rent a GPS unit separately.

p34/p3-057-08.mp3.text: Great, that'll save me some money. Where do I pick it up?

p34/p3-057-09.mp3.text: It's parked in space fourteen, right outside that door. Here are the keys.

p34/p3-058-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Brooks. I'm in apartment 5C. I wanted to follow up on the repair request I submitted for my dishwasher.

p34/p3-058-02.mp3.text: Right, Ms. Alvarez. The technician came by on Tuesday, but the part he needs has to be ordered from the manufacturer.

p34/p3-058-03.mp3.text: Do you know how long that'll take? It's been almost two weeks already.

p34/p3-058-04.mp3.text: The supplier said it should arrive by the end of next week.

p34/p3-058-05.mp3.text: Well, I'm hosting a dinner party on Saturday for about twelve people.

p34/p3-058-06.mp3.text: I see. In that case, would you like us to replace the dishwasher entirely? We have a new model in storage, and we could install it on Friday morning.

p34/p3-058-07.mp3.text: That would be wonderful. Will someone need to let the installer in? I'll be at work.

p34/p3-058-08.mp3.text: Don't worry. I'll be there myself to supervise. Just make sure the area around the sink is cleared.

p34/p3-059-01.mp3.text: Excuse me. My doctor sent me here for an X-ray of my knee. Where should I go?

p34/p3-059-02.mp3.text: That's done in the radiology department. But first, please check in at the registration desk right behind you.

p34/p3-059-03.mp3.text: OK. Do I need an appointment?

p34/p3-059-04.mp3.text: No, X-rays are done on a walk-in basis. In the morning, the wait is usually about thirty minutes.

p34/p3-059-05.mp3.text: That's fine. My doctor also said I might need physical therapy later.

p34/p3-059-06.mp3.text: Then you can stop by that department after your X-ray and pick up a brochure about their programs.

p34/p3-059-07.mp3.text: Great, thanks. And where are the elevators?

p34/p3-059-08.mp3.text: Just down the hall on your left.

p34/p3-060-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm here to renew my passport. I filled out the application online and printed it.

p34/p3-060-02.mp3.text: Great, that saves time. May I see your current passport and your photos?

p34/p3-060-03.mp3.text: Here you go. I had the photos taken at a pharmacy yesterday.

p34/p3-060-04.mp3.text: Hmm, these are a little too small. Passport photos need to be two inches by two inches.

p34/p3-060-05.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't realize that. Is there somewhere nearby I can get new ones?

p34/p3-060-06.mp3.text: There's a photo booth on the second floor. It's twelve dollars, and you'll have the pictures in a few minutes.

p34/p3-060-07.mp3.text: OK. I'm leaving for Tokyo in five weeks for a work assignment. Will I get my passport in time?

p34/p3-060-08.mp3.text: Standard processing takes six to eight weeks, so I'd recommend paying for expedited service. That takes about two weeks.

p34/p3-060-09.mp3.text: I'll do that, then. Let me go get the photos, and I'll be right back.

p34/p3-061-01.mp3.text: Ravi, Line 3 just stopped again. The labeling machine keeps jamming, and bottles are piling up at the end of the conveyor.

p34/p3-061-02.mp3.text: I saw that. I think the problem is the new label rolls. They're slightly thicker than the old ones, so they get stuck in the feeder.

p34/p3-061-03.mp3.text: That makes sense. The jams started on Monday, right after the new rolls were delivered.

p34/p3-061-04.mp3.text: Exactly. I can adjust the feeder settings, but it'll take about an hour, and the line has to be shut down while I do it.

p34/p3-061-05.mp3.text: Hmm, we have to finish an order for Delmont Grocers by this afternoon. Can it wait until the lunch break?

p34/p3-061-06.mp3.text: Sure, I'll do it at noon. In the meantime, could you have someone clear the jams by hand when they happen?

p34/p3-061-07.mp3.text: No problem. I'll ask Tomas to stay by the machine until then.

p34/p3-062-01.mp3.text: Good morning, Brightway Office Supply. This is Kevin speaking.

p34/p3-062-02.mp3.text: Hi, this is Amanda Cho from Larson Design. The desk chairs we ordered from your Web site arrived this morning, but they're the wrong color.

p34/p3-062-03.mp3.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Could you give me your order number?

p34/p3-062-04.mp3.text: Sure, it's four, eight, one, seven, seven. We ordered twelve black chairs, but the ones we received are gray.

p34/p3-062-05.mp3.text: I see, our warehouse made a mistake. I'll send you twelve black chairs right away, and they should arrive by Thursday.

p34/p3-062-06.mp3.text: Thank you. What should we do with the gray ones?

p34/p3-062-07.mp3.text: Just leave them in their boxes. When our driver drops off the new chairs, he'll pick up the gray ones at no charge.

p34/p3-063-01.mp3.text: Ms. Patel, thanks for coming in. I'd like you to meet Jun Park, our purchasing manager, who'll be handling the contract renewal with your company.

p34/p3-063-02.mp3.text: Nice to meet you, Jun. As I mentioned on the phone, we'd be happy to renew for two more years, but our prices for shipping boxes will go up by six percent.

p34/p3-063-03.mp3.text: Six percent is more than we expected. Our budget for next year only allows for about three.

p34/p3-063-04.mp3.text: I understand, but our paper costs have gone up sharply this year. If you sign a three-year contract instead, though, we could keep the increase at four percent.

p34/p3-063-05.mp3.text: Hmm. A longer commitment could work for us, as long as your delivery times stay the same.

p34/p3-063-06.mp3.text: I agree. Could you put that offer in writing so I can review it with our finance director?

p34/p3-063-07.mp3.text: Of course. I'll e-mail you a revised proposal by tomorrow morning.

p34/p3-064-01.mp3.text: Marcus, have you seen the results of our spring campaign for the Stridely fitness app?

p34/p3-064-02.mp3.text: Yes, I just finished reading the report. Social media brought in the most new users, which is what we expected.

p34/p3-064-03.mp3.text: Right. What surprised me was that radio did better than e-mail, even though we spent a lot less on it.

p34/p3-064-04.mp3.text: I noticed that too. But the real problem is the channel with the fewest sign-ups. It was also our most expensive one.

p34/p3-064-05.mp3.text: Then let's drop it from the summer campaign and move that money into social media ads.

p34/p3-064-06.mp3.text: Good idea. Also, the director wants us to present these results at Friday's staff meeting.

p34/p3-064-07.mp3.text: Then we'd better prepare some slides. Could you forward me the report so I can start on the charts?

p34/p3-064-08.mp3.text: Sure, I'll send it right after lunch.

p34/p3-065-01.mp3.text: Dennis, the inspection results for yesterday's batch of ceramic tiles just came back. About eight percent of them have hairline cracks.

p34/p3-065-02.mp3.text: Eight percent? We're usually under one. Was it the whole batch or just part of it?

p34/p3-065-03.mp3.text: Just the tiles fired in kiln two. The temperature log shows it ran hotter than normal most of the afternoon.

p34/p3-065-04.mp3.text: That kiln was serviced last week. Maybe the technician forgot to recalibrate the temperature sensor afterward.

p34/p3-065-05.mp3.text: Could be. Either way, we can't ship those tiles to Harmon Builders on Friday as planned.

p34/p3-065-06.mp3.text: Well, kiln one is free tomorrow.

p34/p3-065-07.mp3.text: Good idea. If we start first thing in the morning, we should still make the deadline.

p34/p3-065-08.mp3.text: I'll arrange it. Could you call the service company and have them check kiln two?

p34/p3-066-01.mp3.text: Hi, this is Grace Lin from the Seaview Hotel. I placed an order with you yesterday, and I need to make a change.

p34/p3-066-02.mp3.text: Certainly, Ms. Lin. I have your order right here. What would you like to change?

p34/p3-066-03.mp3.text: We're opening an indoor pool next month, so we'll need more bath towels. Could you double that number?

p34/p3-066-04.mp3.text: Sure. But I should let you know that bath towels are on back order right now, so the extra ones won't ship until the twentieth.

p34/p3-066-05.mp3.text: Hmm, the pool opens on the eighteenth. Is there any way to get them sooner?

p34/p3-066-06.mp3.text: We do have a similar towel in stock. It's a slightly darker shade of white, but the quality is the same.

p34/p3-066-07.mp3.text: That might work. I'd like to see it first, though.

p34/p3-066-08.mp3.text: Of course. I'll mail you a sample today so you can compare.

p34/p3-067-01.mp3.text: Lisa, did you get a chance to look at the quotes from the lumber suppliers?

p34/p3-067-02.mp3.text: I did. Northfield Timber had the lowest price, but they only deliver once a month, which won't work with our production schedule.

p34/p3-067-03.mp3.text: What about Crestwood Lumber? I've heard good things about them.

p34/p3-067-04.mp3.text: Their price is a bit higher, but they deliver every week. They also give a discount if we pay within ten days.

p34/p3-067-05.mp3.text: That sounds promising. Before we sign anything, though, I'd like to check the quality of their oak.

p34/p3-067-06.mp3.text: I thought you'd say that, so I already asked them to send some samples. They should be here by Wednesday.

p34/p3-067-07.mp3.text: Perfect. Let's have Carlos from the workshop look at them when they arrive. He has the best eye for wood.

p34/p3-068-01.mp3.text: So, how did the focus group sessions go for our new sparkling tea?

p34/p3-068-02.mp3.text: Mostly well, and participants liked the flavors, especially the peach. But several of them said the can looks too much like an energy drink.

p34/p3-068-03.mp3.text: Actually, that came up in every session. People expected it to be sweet and full of caffeine, so they were surprised when they tasted it.

p34/p3-068-04.mp3.text: That's a concern. Our whole campaign is built around the drink being a light, healthy choice.

p34/p3-068-05.mp3.text: Exactly. If the packaging sends the wrong message, we'll miss the customers we're trying to reach.

p34/p3-068-06.mp3.text: Our design agency could probably come up with a few alternatives in softer colors before the launch.

p34/p3-068-07.mp3.text: Let's do that. Nadia, could you call the agency this afternoon?

p34/p3-068-08.mp3.text: Sure, I'll call them right after lunch.

p34/p3-068-09.mp3.text: Thanks. And Owen, please write up a summary of the participants' comments for them.

p34/p3-069-01.mp3.text: Peter, Fairbanks Hardware just called. They want to add two hundred ceiling fans to their order, and they still need everything by Friday.

p34/p3-069-02.mp3.text: Friday? Our truck to their area doesn't leave until Thursday afternoon. That's cutting it close.

p34/p3-069-03.mp3.text: I know. Could we send the fans on the Wednesday truck instead?

p34/p3-069-04.mp3.text: That one's already full. We could use an outside courier, but it would cost about four hundred dollars extra.

p34/p3-069-05.mp3.text: Well, Fairbanks is one of our biggest customers. I'd rather pay extra than risk losing their business.

p34/p3-069-06.mp3.text: OK, I'll book the courier. But any shipping cost over three hundred dollars needs a manager's approval.

p34/p3-069-07.mp3.text: Right. I'll go ask our manager, Ms. Hughes, right now.

p34/p3-070-01.mp3.text: Hi, Jessica. Some buyers from Ostrava Motors are visiting our plant next Tuesday. Could you help me plan their tour?

p34/p3-070-02.mp3.text: Sure. Do they want to see the whole factory?

p34/p3-070-03.mp3.text: Mainly the assembly area, since they're interested in our new brake parts. I'd also like to show them the testing lab.

p34/p3-070-04.mp3.text: OK. Just remember that all visitors have to watch a short safety video before they enter the factory floor.

p34/p3-070-05.mp3.text: Right, we can show it in the conference room when they arrive. After the tour, I'd like to take them out to lunch.

p34/p3-070-06.mp3.text: There's a nice Italian restaurant five minutes from here. Would you like me to reserve a table for six?

p34/p3-070-07.mp3.text: Yes, please. Make it for twelve thirty.

p34/p3-071-01.mp3.text: Sophie, I just heard from Fenwick Glass. They're having equipment problems and won't be able to ship our jars for at least three weeks.

p34/p3-071-02.mp3.text: Three weeks? We need those jars for the new face cream, and the launch is only two weeks away.

p34/p3-071-03.mp3.text: I know. That's why I put together a list of other suppliers that could fill the order.

p34/p3-071-04.mp3.text: Good. Well, we'll need the jars within a week to finish packaging on time.

p34/p3-071-05.mp3.text: That rules out one of them. I'd also like to keep the price under forty cents a jar if possible.

p34/p3-071-06.mp3.text: Agreed. Our budget for this product is already tight, so let's go with the one that meets both requirements.

p34/p3-071-07.mp3.text: OK. I'll call them right away and ask for a quote on twenty thousand units.

p34/p3-072-01.mp3.text: Brian, I've been thinking about the campaign for our new line of hiking boots. What if we partnered with some outdoor influencers on social media?

p34/p3-072-02.mp3.text: I like that idea. A lot of our younger customers follow travel and hiking accounts.

p34/p3-072-03.mp3.text: Exactly. I've found a few creators with big followings, but the most popular one charges fifteen thousand dollars for three videos.

p34/p3-072-04.mp3.text: Fifteen thousand? Our entire online budget for the quarter is twenty.

p34/p3-072-05.mp3.text: I know. But some of the smaller creators charge much less, and their followers tend to be very engaged.

p34/p3-072-06.mp3.text: Then let's focus on them. Could you put together a list of three or four candidates along with their rates?

p34/p3-072-07.mp3.text: Sure. I'll have it ready for Monday's meeting.

p34/p3-073-01.mp3.text: Before we start today's shift, I want to remind you both that our new inventory system goes live on Monday.

p34/p3-073-02.mp3.text: Does that mean we won't have to count stock by hand at the end of every week anymore?

p34/p3-073-03.mp3.text: That's right. Every item will be scanned when it comes in and when it goes out, so the counts will update automatically.

p34/p3-073-04.mp3.text: That'll save us a lot of time. But I've heard the handheld scanners can be tricky to use.

p34/p3-073-05.mp3.text: That's why the software company is sending a trainer here on Thursday morning. The session will last about two hours.

p34/p3-073-06.mp3.text: Thursday morning? That's when the big shipment from Corville Foods arrives, and I'm supposed to unload it.

p34/p3-073-07.mp3.text: Good point. I'll ask the trainer to hold a second session in the afternoon so you can attend that one.

p34/p3-074-01.mp3.text: Victor, I just read the feedback from the user trials of our new blender. Testers liked the design, but many said it was louder than they expected.

p34/p3-074-02.mp3.text: I'm not surprised. We switched to a more powerful motor late in development, but we never redesigned the housing to absorb the extra vibration.

p34/p3-074-03.mp3.text: Can we fix that without changing the motor? Testers really liked how quickly it blends.

p34/p3-074-04.mp3.text: We could add rubber mounts inside the base. They'd reduce the noise a lot, and they'd only add a few cents per unit.

p34/p3-074-05.mp3.text: That sounds reasonable, but would it affect the production timeline? Retailers are expecting our first shipment in March.

p34/p3-074-06.mp3.text: The mold for the base would need a small modification. Our tooling supplier says that takes about ten days.

p34/p3-074-07.mp3.text: Then we should still be on schedule. Go ahead and request the change, and send me the revised drawings when they're ready.

p34/p3-075-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to order some printed materials for a trade show next month. We need five hundred brochures and two large banners.

p34/p3-075-02.mp3.text: Certainly. Do you have the designs ready?

p34/p3-075-03.mp3.text: Yes, our designer finished them yesterday. The files are on this flash drive.

p34/p3-075-04.mp3.text: Great. For the brochures, I'd recommend our glossy paper. It makes the colors look much brighter.

p34/p3-075-05.mp3.text: That sounds nice. Is it much more expensive?

p34/p3-075-06.mp3.text: It's about ten percent more than standard paper. But if you order a thousand brochures, you'll get fifteen percent off the total.

p34/p3-075-07.mp3.text: Hmm, we're going to another trade show in the fall, so we could use the extras there. OK, let's make it a thousand.

p34/p3-075-08.mp3.text: Excellent. Let me check your files now.

p34/p3-076-01.mp3.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Regional Marketing Summit. Can I have your name, please?

p34/p3-076-02.mp3.text: Hi, it's Daniel Okafor from Brightline Media. I registered online last week.

p34/p3-076-03.mp3.text: Let me see. Here's your badge, Mr. Okafor. Oh, I'm sorry. It looks like your company name is spelled wrong.

p34/p3-076-04.mp3.text: Ah, yes, it says "Brightlane." Would it be possible to get a new one?

p34/p3-076-05.mp3.text: Of course. I can print a corrected badge right now. It'll only take a minute.

p34/p3-076-06.mp3.text: Thanks. Also, I'd like to attend the afternoon workshop on social media advertising. Do I need to sign up separately?

p34/p3-076-07.mp3.text: Yes, seating is limited, so you'll need to add your name to the list. You can do that at the information booth next to the main hall.

p34/p3-076-08.mp3.text: Great. I'll go there as soon as I get my badge.

p34/p3-077-01.mp3.text: Sofia, Raj, I just got an e-mail from Dr. Hassan. He's sick and can't give his talk at tomorrow's seminar.

p34/p3-077-02.mp3.text: Oh no. His session on supply chain trends was the main reason a lot of people signed up.

p34/p3-077-03.mp3.text: What if we asked Ms. Lindqvist? She gave a similar presentation at the logistics forum in March.

p34/p3-077-04.mp3.text: Good idea, but she's speaking at another event downtown tomorrow morning. I saw it on her company's Web site.

p34/p3-077-05.mp3.text: Our session isn't until three o'clock.

p34/p3-077-06.mp3.text: That's true. And it's only a fifteen-minute drive from downtown.

p34/p3-077-07.mp3.text: OK, then I'll call her right away. Sofia, could you prepare an announcement for the attendees in case the topic changes slightly?

p34/p3-077-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'll draft it and send it to you for approval before I post it.

p34/p3-078-01.mp3.text: Marcus, the organizers of the Home Design Expo sent us the floor plan. We need to choose our booth by Friday.

p34/p3-078-02.mp3.text: Great. Since we're showing our new line of kitchen storage products, we want as many visitors as possible to see it.

p34/p3-078-03.mp3.text: The spot near the main entrance would be ideal, but it's over our budget. We have about a thousand dollars to spend.

p34/p3-078-04.mp3.text: What about the one by the food court? People spend a lot of time there.

p34/p3-078-05.mp3.text: True, but it might be noisy, and we'll be doing product demonstrations all day.

p34/p3-078-06.mp3.text: Hmm. Then let's go with the one in the center aisle. It's a little more than we planned, but it's worth it.

p34/p3-078-07.mp3.text: I agree. I'll ask our finance manager to approve the extra cost.

p34/p3-079-01.mp3.text: Hi, this is Grace from Thornfield Catering. I'm calling about the menu for your company's anniversary reception on the twelfth.

p34/p3-079-02.mp3.text: Thanks for calling back. Actually, there's been a change. Our CEO invited several clients from overseas, so we're now expecting around 180 guests instead of 120.

p34/p3-079-03.mp3.text: That shouldn't be a problem for the food itself. But the banquet hall you booked holds only 150 people for a seated dinner.

p34/p3-079-04.mp3.text: I see. Would a standing reception with appetizers work instead?

p34/p3-079-05.mp3.text: Yes, the room can easily fit 200 that way. And honestly, it encourages guests to mingle more.

p34/p3-079-06.mp3.text: That sounds even better for networking. Could you send me a revised quote by tomorrow? I need to present it to the finance team on Thursday.

p34/p3-079-07.mp3.text: Certainly. I'll also include a few vegetarian options, since some of your international guests may have dietary restrictions.

p34/p3-080-01.mp3.text: Hello, this is Ana Ruiz from Pellman Accounting on the eighth floor. I saw a notice in the lobby about the elevators.

p34/p3-080-02.mp3.text: Yes, Ms. Ruiz. Both elevators on the east side will be inspected this Saturday from 8 A.M. to 2 P.M.

p34/p3-080-03.mp3.text: I see. Some of our staff will be coming in that day to finish our quarterly reports. Will they be able to get to our floor?

p34/p3-080-04.mp3.text: Yes, the west elevators will still be working. They're next to the parking garage entrance.

p34/p3-080-05.mp3.text: Oh, good. Our team usually comes in through the main lobby, so I'll let them know.

p34/p3-080-06.mp3.text: Thank you. I'll also put up some signs on Saturday morning to direct people.

p34/p3-080-07.mp3.text: That would be helpful. Thanks for your time.

p34/p3-081-01.mp3.text: Hi, Ms. Chen. It's Tom Bradley from Bradley Renovations. I'm calling with an update on your office project.

p34/p3-081-02.mp3.text: Hi, Tom. Is everything still on schedule?

p34/p3-081-03.mp3.text: Mostly. The old carpet was removed this week as planned. But the paint color you chose is out of stock at our supplier.

p34/p3-081-04.mp3.text: Oh no. Is there a similar color available?

p34/p3-081-05.mp3.text: There's one that's very close. I'll e-mail you a photo this afternoon. If you approve it today, we won't lose any time.

p34/p3-081-06.mp3.text: OK, I'll look at it as soon as I get it. By the way, the smell of paint really bothers some of our staff.

p34/p3-081-07.mp3.text: I understand. Many of our clients have their employees work remotely during that stage.

p34/p3-081-08.mp3.text: That's a good idea. I'll tell everyone to work from home that week.

p34/p3-082-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming so quickly. Water started dripping from the ceiling above our kitchen about an hour ago.

p34/p3-082-02.mp3.text: No problem. It looks like the leak is coming from a pipe in the apartment upstairs. Have you contacted the building manager?

p34/p3-082-03.mp3.text: I left her a message, but she hasn't called back yet. We open for dinner at five.

p34/p3-082-05.mp3.text: I know. Is there anything you can do in the meantime?

p34/p3-082-06.mp3.text: I can shut off the water to that section of the building for now. That should stop the dripping until I can get into the upstairs unit.

p34/p3-082-07.mp3.text: But will we still have water in the kitchen? We can't cook without it.

p34/p3-082-08.mp3.text: Your kitchen is on a separate line, so you'll be fine. I'll go turn it off now.

p34/p3-083-01.mp3.text: As you both know, the parking garage will be resurfaced starting next Monday. The work will take about two weeks.

p34/p3-083-02.mp3.text: Right. And the whole garage will be closed during that time, won't it?

p34/p3-083-03.mp3.text: Only the first two levels. The third level will stay open, but that's just about sixty spaces.

p34/p3-083-04.mp3.text: That won't be nearly enough. We have more than two hundred employees who drive to work.

p34/p3-083-05.mp3.text: I know. So I've arranged for us to use the lot at Fairview Church on Oak Street. It's about a ten-minute walk from here.

p34/p3-083-06.mp3.text: What about rainy days? That's a long walk in bad weather.

p34/p3-083-07.mp3.text: The company will run a shuttle van every fifteen minutes during rush hours.

p34/p3-083-08.mp3.text: That should help. I'll put together a notice for the staff explaining all of this.

p34/p3-083-09.mp3.text: And I'll reserve the third-level spaces for visitors and employees with disabilities.

p34/p3-084-01.mp3.text: Thanks for meeting with me, Ms. Patel. I'd like to show you BookEase, our new online scheduling system for medical clinics.

p34/p3-084-02.mp3.text: Sure. Right now, our receptionists spend hours every day answering calls just to book appointments.

p34/p3-084-03.mp3.text: That's exactly what BookEase solves. Patients choose a time on your Web site, and the system sends them a text reminder the day before.

p34/p3-084-04.mp3.text: Reminders would be great. We have a lot of missed appointments.

p34/p3-084-05.mp3.text: Our clients report about thirty percent fewer no-shows in the first three months.

p34/p3-084-06.mp3.text: That's impressive. But I'm worried that our older patients might not be comfortable booking online.

p34/p3-084-07.mp3.text: They can still call. Your staff can enter phone bookings into the same calendar.

p34/p3-084-08.mp3.text: OK. I'd like to discuss it with the clinic's director first.

p34/p3-084-09.mp3.text: Of course. Here's a brochure, and I'll e-mail you a link to a free thirty-day trial.

p34/p3-085-01.mp3.text: Did you find everything you needed today?

p34/p3-085-02.mp3.text: Yes, thanks. Oh, I saw a sign at the entrance about home delivery. Is that new?

p34/p3-085-03.mp3.text: Yes, we just started it this week. You can order groceries on our Web site, and we'll bring them to your door the same day.

p34/p3-085-04.mp3.text: That sounds convenient. How much does it cost?

p34/p3-085-05.mp3.text: Delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars. Otherwise, it's five dollars.

p34/p3-085-06.mp3.text: Great. I usually spend more than that anyway.

p34/p3-085-07.mp3.text: Here's a card with the Web site address. If you sign up this month, you'll also get ten percent off your first order.

p34/p3-085-08.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll sign up when I get home tonight.

p34/p3-086-01.mp3.text: Lauren, have you seen the results of the customer survey for our next fitness watch?

p34/p3-086-02.mp3.text: I have. Longer battery life came out on top, which isn't surprising.

p34/p3-086-03.mp3.text: Right, but we've already improved the battery by fifty percent in the new design, so that's covered.

p34/p3-086-04.mp3.text: What about water resistance? A lot of swimmers asked for it.

p34/p3-086-05.mp3.text: Unfortunately, that would mean redesigning the whole case, and there's no way we can do that before the spring launch.

p34/p3-086-06.mp3.text: Then I think we should focus on the next most popular feature. Our software team could add it with an update.

p34/p3-086-07.mp3.text: Agreed. Can you check with them about how long it would take?

p34/p3-086-08.mp3.text: Sure. I'm meeting with them tomorrow morning, so I'll bring it up then.

p34/p3-087-01.mp3.text: Hi. I'd like to deposit these two checks into my savings account.

p34/p3-087-02.mp3.text: Certainly. By the way, did you know you can now deposit checks with our mobile app? We added that feature last month.

p34/p3-087-03.mp3.text: Really? I didn't know that. How does it work?

p34/p3-087-04.mp3.text: You just take a photo of the front and back of the check. The money usually appears in your account by the next business day.

p34/p3-087-05.mp3.text: That would save me a trip. I come here every week on my lunch break.

p34/p3-087-06.mp3.text: A lot of customers say the same thing. Would you like me to help you set it up now?

p34/p3-087-07.mp3.text: I've got a meeting at one.

p34/p3-087-08.mp3.text: No problem. This brochure explains all the steps. And you can call our help line anytime if you have questions.

p34/p3-087-09.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll try it this weekend.

p34/p3-088-01.mp3.text: Hi. I'd like to check out these books, but the machine says my library card has expired.

p34/p3-088-02.mp3.text: Let me take a look. Yes, it expired last month. I can renew it for you now. Do you have a photo ID with your current address?

p34/p3-088-04.mp3.text: Thanks. All set. Your card is good for another three years.

p34/p3-088-05.mp3.text: Great. Oh, and I heard the library has a 3D printer now. Can anyone use it?

p34/p3-088-06.mp3.text: Any cardholder can. But you need to take a thirty-minute safety class first. The next one is on Thursday evening.

p34/p3-088-07.mp3.text: Do I have to sign up for it?

p34/p3-088-08.mp3.text: Yes. You can register at the front desk on the second floor or on our Web site.

p34/p3-088-09.mp3.text: I'll do it online, then. Thanks.

p34/p3-089-01.mp3.text: Welcome, Javier and Thomas. Thanks for volunteering at the Harbor History Museum. Today I'll explain what our tour guides do.

p34/p3-089-02.mp3.text: We're excited to get started. Will we be leading tours right away?

p34/p3-089-03.mp3.text: Not yet. For the first two weeks, you'll follow one of our experienced guides and observe their tours.

p34/p3-089-04.mp3.text: That's a relief. There's a lot of information to remember, especially about the shipbuilding exhibit.

p34/p3-089-05.mp3.text: Don't worry. Each of you will get a handbook with all the key facts. It's also available online.

p34/p3-089-06.mp3.text: Do we need to wear anything special?

p34/p3-089-07.mp3.text: Just comfortable shoes. We'll provide a name tag and a museum vest. Actually, let's go pick those up now. They're in the storage room downstairs.

p34/p3-090-01.mp3.text: Hi, I'm calling about the community garden on Maple Avenue. I'd like to rent a plot this year.

p34/p3-090-02.mp3.text: Thanks for your interest. Unfortunately, all forty plots were reserved within the first week. We do have a waiting list, though.

p34/p3-090-03.mp3.text: How long is the wait, usually?

p34/p3-090-04.mp3.text: Well, last year only two people on the list ended up getting a plot.

p34/p3-090-05.mp3.text: Oh, that's disappointing. I was hoping to grow vegetables for my family.

p34/p3-090-06.mp3.text: Have you thought about our shared garden section? Volunteers take care of it together twice a week, and everyone takes home part of the harvest.

p34/p3-090-07.mp3.text: That actually sounds fun. Is there a fee?

p34/p3-090-08.mp3.text: No, but volunteers have to attend an orientation first. The next one is this Saturday at the community center.

p34/p3-090-09.mp3.text: I'm free then. Could you put my name down?

p34/p4-001-01.mp3.text: Hello, Ms. Fairbanks, this is Daniel from Ridgeway Auto Repair.

p34/p4-001-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about the car you dropped off for brake repairs this morning.

p34/p4-001-03.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the replacement part we ordered hasn't arrived yet because of a delay at the supplier's warehouse.

p34/p4-001-04.mp3.text: It should be here by tomorrow afternoon, so your car will be ready on Thursday instead of today.

p34/p4-001-06.mp3.text: If you need a vehicle in the meantime, we can lend you one of our loaner cars at no charge.

p34/p4-001-07.mp3.say: Just call me back at 5 5 5, 0 1 4 2 and let me know, and I'll have it ready for you.
p34/p4-001-07.mp3.text: Just call me back at 555-0142 and let me know, and I'll have it ready for you.

p34/p4-002-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Okafor. This is Linda Sorensen, the events coordinator at the Riverside Hotel.

p34/p4-002-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about the training workshop your company is holding here next Tuesday.

p34/p4-002-03.mp3.text: You mentioned in your e-mail that the number of participants has increased to about sixty.

p34/p4-002-04.mp3.text: Unfortunately, the room you originally reserved only holds forty people.

p34/p4-002-05.mp3.text: Since you wanted to stay on the second floor near our business center, I've moved you to the only room on that floor that can fit your entire group.

p34/p4-002-06.mp3.text: The rental rate is a little higher, but I've applied a ten percent discount for the inconvenience.

p34/p4-002-07.mp3.text: Could you confirm the change by replying to the e-mail I just sent you?

p34/p4-003-01.mp3.text: Hi, Rebecca. It's Tom Whitaker from marketing.

p34/p4-003-02.mp3.text: I just found out that I have to fly to Chicago tomorrow morning to meet with one of our biggest clients about their contract renewal.

p34/p4-003-03.mp3.text: That means I won't be able to give the quarterly sales presentation to the board on Wednesday.

p34/p4-003-04.mp3.text: Would you be willing to present it in my place?

p34/p4-003-06.mp3.text: But you helped me put the slides together, so you already know most of the material.

p34/p4-003-07.mp3.text: I'll e-mail you my speaking notes tonight so you can review them.

p34/p4-003-08.mp3.text: Please let me know by the end of the day if that works for you.

p34/p4-004-01.mp3.text: Hello, Mr. Delgado. This is Sandra Kim from the Oakview Apartments management office.

p34/p4-004-02.mp3.text: I'm calling to let you know that plumbers will be replacing some pipes in your building this Friday.

p34/p4-004-03.mp3.text: Because of this work, the water will be turned off from nine A.M. to two P.M.

p34/p4-004-04.mp3.text: Bottled water will be available in the lobby for residents during that time.

p34/p4-004-05.mp3.text: The plumbers will also need to enter your unit to check the pipes under your kitchen sink.

p34/p4-004-06.mp3.text: If you won't be home that morning, please leave a key at the front desk by Thursday evening.

p34/p4-004-07.mp3.text: We apologize for any inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

p34/p4-005-01.mp3.text: Good morning, Ms. Mori. This is Victor Alvarez in human resources at Brightline Logistics.

p34/p4-005-02.mp3.text: Thank you for applying for the warehouse supervisor position.

p34/p4-005-03.mp3.text: Our hiring manager was impressed with your experience, and we'd like to invite you in for an interview.

p34/p4-005-04.mp3.text: We're available next Monday or Tuesday, any time between ten and four.

p34/p4-005-05.mp3.text: The interview will include a short tour of our distribution center, so please wear comfortable shoes.

p34/p4-005-06.mp3.text: Also, please bring a copy of your forklift operator certificate, since it wasn't attached to your application.

p34/p4-005-07.mp3.say: Please call me back at 5 5 5, 0 1 8 7 to let me know which time works best for you.
p34/p4-005-07.mp3.text: Please call me back at 555-0187 to let me know which time works best for you.

p34/p4-006-01.mp3.text: Hi, Mr. Brennan, it's Gloria from Fresh Harvest Produce.

p34/p4-006-02.mp3.text: I'm calling about tomorrow's delivery to your restaurant.

p34/p4-006-03.mp3.text: Heavy rain has damaged much of the tomato crop at the farm we usually buy from, so we can only send half of the tomatoes you ordered.

p34/p4-006-04.mp3.text: However, we do have plenty of canned tomatoes from a supplier in Italy.

p34/p4-006-05.mp3.text: I realize you prefer fresh ingredients for your sauces.

p34/p4-006-06.mp3.text: But several chefs in town have been using these for months, and we've never had a complaint about them.

p34/p4-006-07.mp3.text: If you'd like to try them, I can add a few cans to your order at our wholesale price.

p34/p4-006-08.mp3.text: I'll need to hear back from you by five o'clock today to make any changes to the order.

p34/p4-007-01.mp3.text: Hello, Ms. Ishikawa. This is Raymond Cole from Summit Commercial Realty, returning your call.

p34/p4-007-02.mp3.text: I've looked into the four office spaces on the list I sent you last week.

p34/p4-007-03.mp3.text: Since your team will need at least 1,700 square feet, only two of them are really suitable.

p34/p4-007-04.mp3.text: Of those two, I'd recommend the less expensive one.

p34/p4-007-05.mp3.text: The owner told me this morning that he's willing to lower the rent by three hundred dollars a month.

p34/p4-007-06.mp3.text: The only condition is that you sign a lease for at least two years.

p34/p4-007-07.mp3.text: Other businesses have shown interest in the space, so I wouldn't wait too long.

p34/p4-007-08.mp3.text: I'm free to show it to you on Thursday afternoon if that suits your schedule.

p34/p4-008-01.mp3.text: Hello, this message is for Harold Jensen. This is Nadia calling from Copperleaf Printing.

p34/p4-008-02.mp3.text: We're getting ready to print the five hundred brochures you ordered for your gallery's spring exhibition.

p34/p4-008-03.mp3.text: However, the glossy paper you selected is out of stock, and our supplier can't ship more until the end of the month.

p34/p4-008-04.mp3.text: Since your exhibition opens on the twelfth, I don't think waiting is an option.

p34/p4-008-05.mp3.text: We do have a matte paper of the same weight, and it actually costs a bit less.

p34/p4-008-06.mp3.text: I'll mail you a sample this afternoon so you can see how your photos will look on it.

p34/p4-008-07.mp3.text: Once you approve it, we can have the order finished within three business days.

p34/p4-009-01.mp3.text: Attention, passengers on Skyward Air Flight 418 to Denver.

p34/p4-009-02.mp3.text: We regret to inform you that this flight has been delayed because of a mechanical problem with the aircraft.

p34/p4-009-03.mp3.text: Our maintenance crew is working on it now, and we expect to begin boarding at approximately 3:45, about ninety minutes later than scheduled.

p34/p4-009-04.mp3.text: To make your wait more comfortable, we're offering each passenger a fifteen-dollar meal voucher.

p34/p4-009-05.mp3.text: Please see an agent at the gate counter to pick one up.

p34/p4-009-06.mp3.text: The vouchers can be used at any restaurant or cafe in this terminal.

p34/p4-009-07.mp3.text: If you have a connecting flight in Denver, please speak with an agent so we can check whether it will be affected.

p34/p4-010-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon. This is an announcement for Northway Airlines passengers scheduled to depart from Gate C9.

p34/p4-010-02.mp3.text: Due to a scheduling change, your flight will now depart from Gate B3.

p34/p4-010-03.mp3.text: The departure time has not changed, and boarding will begin in about twenty minutes.

p34/p4-010-04.mp3.text: To get to Gate B3, please take the moving walkway near the information desk, then turn left at the bookstore.

p34/p4-010-05.mp3.text: The walk from here takes about ten minutes, so we recommend that you head there now.

p34/p4-010-06.mp3.text: Passengers who need help getting to the new gate may request a cart ride at the information desk.

p34/p4-010-07.mp3.text: Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for any inconvenience.

p34/p4-011-01.mp3.text: Attention, all passengers traveling on the Lakeshore Line this weekend.

p34/p4-011-02.mp3.text: Because of scheduled track repairs, there will be no train service between Milford Station and Carver Junction on Saturday and Sunday.

p34/p4-011-03.mp3.text: Free shuttle buses will carry passengers between these two stations instead.

p34/p4-011-04.mp3.text: The buses will leave from the east entrance of this station every twenty minutes.
