p34/p4-011-05.mp3.text: Please note that the trip by bus takes about thirty minutes longer than by train.

p34/p4-011-06.mp3.text: Passengers with tight schedules should plan to leave home earlier than usual.

p34/p4-011-07.mp3.text: Regular service will resume on Monday morning.

p34/p4-011-08.mp3.text: For updated timetables, please visit our Web site at www.example.com/lakeshore.

p34/p4-012-01.mp3.text: Good evening, shoppers, and thank you for choosing Greenway Market.

p34/p4-012-02.mp3.text: For the next hour only, all fresh baked goods in our bakery department are thirty percent off the regular price.

p34/p4-012-03.mp3.text: That includes our popular whole wheat bread, muffins, and fruit pies.

p34/p4-012-04.mp3.text: You'll find the bakery department at the back of the store, right next to the dairy section.

p34/p4-012-05.mp3.text: Also, don't forget that members of our rewards program earn double points on every purchase this week.

p34/p4-012-06.mp3.text: If you're not a member yet, you can sign up for free at any checkout counter.

p34/p4-012-07.mp3.text: It only takes a minute, and you'll start saving right away.

p34/p4-013-02.mp3.text: Our store will be closing in thirty minutes, at nine o'clock.

p34/p4-013-03.mp3.text: Before you go, be sure to stop by aisle seven, where we've marked down last year's wireless headphones by fifty percent.

p34/p4-013-04.mp3.text: We only received twenty pairs, and a dozen have already been sold.

p34/p4-013-05.mp3.text: Also, if you're buying a laptop or tablet tonight, ask our staff about extending your warranty.

p34/p4-013-06.mp3.text: For just twenty dollars, your device will be covered for an additional two years.

p34/p4-013-07.mp3.text: Please note that the self-checkout machines will shut down at 8:50, so plan to finish your shopping before then.

p34/p4-013-08.mp3.text: Thank you for shopping with us.

p34/p4-014-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the second day of the Pacific Regional Healthcare Conference.

p34/p4-014-02.mp3.text: Before we begin, I have a quick update about this morning's schedule.

p34/p4-014-03.mp3.text: Dr. Amara Whitfield, who was scheduled to give the opening keynote at nine, is stuck in traffic because of a road closure near the airport.

p34/p4-014-04.mp3.text: Rather than make you wait, we've switched her talk with the panel discussion on hospital technology that was planned for eleven.

p34/p4-014-05.mp3.text: So the panel will start here in this hall in about ten minutes.

p34/p4-014-06.mp3.text: The printed programs in your welcome packets don't reflect this change, but the conference app has already been updated.

p34/p4-014-07.mp3.text: In the meantime, coffee and pastries are available in the lobby, courtesy of our sponsor, Clearpath Medical Systems.

p34/p4-015-01.mp3.text: Good morning. This is Kevin Tran from building management with an announcement for all tenants of Lindale Tower.

p34/p4-015-02.mp3.text: Starting next Monday, the two elevators on the north side of the lobby will be out of service for about three weeks while they're being upgraded.

p34/p4-015-03.mp3.text: During that time, the south elevators will still be running, but you should expect longer waits during the morning rush.

p34/p4-015-04.mp3.text: To help with this, we're asking tenants on the second through fourth floors to use the stairs whenever possible.

p34/p4-015-05.mp3.text: In addition, the freight elevator will be reserved for deliveries only between eight and ten A.M.

p34/p4-015-06.mp3.text: If your company is expecting a large delivery during the work period, please register it with the front desk at least one day in advance.

p34/p4-015-07.mp3.text: We appreciate your cooperation while we make these improvements.

p34/p4-016-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Bellmont Chocolate factory.

p34/p4-016-02.mp3.text: My name is Gavin, and I'll be guiding you through our production facility today.

p34/p4-016-03.mp3.text: We'll start in the roasting room, where cocoa beans are heated to bring out their flavor.

p34/p4-016-04.mp3.text: After that, we'll walk past the molding line, where the chocolate is poured into bars.

p34/p4-016-05.mp3.text: Please note that taking photos is not allowed inside the production area, since some of our equipment was specially designed for us.

p34/p4-016-06.mp3.text: Also, for safety reasons, everyone needs to wear a hairnet, which you can pick up from the bin by the door.

p34/p4-016-07.mp3.text: At the end of the tour, you'll each receive a free sample box to take home.

p34/p4-017-01.mp3.text: Hello, and welcome to the Harlow Museum of Science.

p34/p4-017-02.mp3.text: I'm Priya, and I'll be leading your group this afternoon.

p34/p4-017-03.mp3.text: Our tour lasts about ninety minutes, and we'll visit every floor of the building except one.

p34/p4-017-04.mp3.text: I'm sorry to say the ocean life exhibit is closed today while workers install a new aquarium tank.

p34/p4-017-05.mp3.text: However, your ticket will let you come back for free any day this month to see it.

p34/p4-017-06.mp3.text: Also, the museum café on the ground floor is offering ten percent off for tour groups today.

p34/p4-017-07.mp3.text: Just show your ticket at the counter.

p34/p4-017-08.mp3.text: All right, let's head to the elevator and begin with our most popular exhibit, on space exploration.

p34/p4-018-01.mp3.text: Good morning, and thank you for joining the Lakeview City walking tour.

p34/p4-018-02.mp3.text: I'm Daniel, and over the next three hours, we'll explore the oldest neighborhood in town.

p34/p4-018-03.mp3.text: Our first stop is the Carver Clock Tower, which was completed in 1892 and still keeps perfect time.

p34/p4-018-04.mp3.text: From there, we'll walk along the canal to see some of the original merchant houses.

p34/p4-018-05.mp3.text: Now, according to the schedule, we're supposed to eat lunch at the open-air market by the river.

p34/p4-018-06.mp3.text: But have you seen the sky?

p34/p4-018-07.mp3.text: If it starts raining, we'll go to the indoor food hall on Pine Street instead.

p34/p4-018-08.mp3.text: Either way, please keep your tour badge visible, because it gets you a discount at several shops along the route.

p34/p4-019-01.mp3.text: Welcome to the Rosedale Botanical Garden.

p34/p4-019-02.mp3.text: My name is Helen, and I'm one of the volunteer guides here.

p34/p4-019-03.mp3.text: Today we'll be walking through three areas: the rose garden, the tropical greenhouse, and the herb garden.

p34/p4-019-04.mp3.text: The greenhouse is quite warm and humid, so you may want to take off your jackets before we go in.

p34/p4-019-05.mp3.text: We ask that you stay on the paths and do not pick any flowers or leaves.

p34/p4-019-06.mp3.text: Halfway through, we'll stop at the visitor center, where you can use the restrooms and buy drinks.

p34/p4-019-07.mp3.text: And if you enjoy today's visit, please consider joining our membership program, which includes free admission all year.

p34/p4-020-01.mp3.text: Good morning, and welcome to Whitfield Manor, home to the Whitfield family for over two hundred years.

p34/p4-020-02.mp3.text: I'm Oliver, and I'll be taking you through the main house, which was restored last year with help from local historians.

p34/p4-020-03.mp3.text: Many of the furniture pieces you'll see are originals, so please don't touch or lean on them.

p34/p4-020-04.mp3.text: After the house tour, you're welcome to explore the grounds and watch our craft demonstrations.

p34/p4-020-05.mp3.text: You'll find the schedule printed on the back of your map.

p34/p4-020-06.mp3.text: I should mention, though, that the twelve-thirty demonstration won't take place today, as the instructor is unwell.

p34/p4-020-07.mp3.text: We'll post the new date on our Web site as soon as it's confirmed.

p34/p4-020-08.mp3.text: Now, if you'll follow me, we'll start in the dining room, where the family once hosted royal visitors.

p34/p4-021-01.mp3.text: Hi, everyone, I'm Sandra Okafor, and welcome to the Trailmark Bicycles assembly plant.

p34/p4-021-02.mp3.text: This facility began operating just two years ago, and it now produces over five hundred bikes a day.

p34/p4-021-03.mp3.text: In a moment, we'll see the frame-welding area, which is fully automated.

p34/p4-021-04.mp3.text: Then we'll move on to the final assembly line, where our technicians attach the wheels and brakes by hand.

p34/p4-021-05.mp3.text: Each bike is test-ridden by a staff member before it's packed and shipped.

p34/p4-021-06.mp3.text: Unfortunately, our paint shop is off-limits to visitors because of the strong chemical fumes.

p34/p4-021-07.mp3.text: But you can watch a short video about it in the lobby after the tour.

p34/p4-022-01.mp3.text: Thanks for joining today's tour of the Point Avery Lighthouse.

p34/p4-022-02.mp3.text: Built in 1856, it guided ships along this coast for more than a century before it was replaced by an automated signal.

p34/p4-022-03.mp3.text: Today it's managed by the county historical society, which relies mostly on donations to keep it open.

p34/p4-022-04.mp3.text: We'll begin in the keeper's cottage, where you'll see the logbooks the keepers used to record the weather every day.

p34/p4-022-05.mp3.text: Then, for those who are interested, we'll climb the one hundred and twelve steps to the top.

p34/p4-022-06.mp3.text: I should warn you that the staircase is narrow and steep.

p34/p4-022-07.mp3.text: If you'd rather not make the climb, you're welcome to stay in the cottage and watch a short film about the keepers' daily lives.

p34/p4-022-08.mp3.text: Either way, we'll all meet again at the gift shop at eleven.

p34/p4-023-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we get started on the agenda, I have a quick announcement.

p34/p4-023-02.mp3.text: Starting next Monday, we'll be using a new online system for submitting expense reports.

p34/p4-023-03.mp3.text: Paper forms will no longer be accepted after the end of this month.

p34/p4-023-04.mp3.text: The new system lets you upload photos of your receipts directly from your phone, so it should save you a lot of time.

p34/p4-023-05.mp3.text: To help everyone get used to it, the finance team will hold a training session this Thursday at two o'clock in Conference Room B.

p34/p4-023-06.mp3.text: If you can't attend, a recording will be available on the company intranet.

p34/p4-023-07.mp3.text: Please make sure you've set up your account by Friday.

p34/p4-024-01.mp3.text: OK, let's move on to an update on the mobile app for Greenway Grocers.

p34/p4-024-02.mp3.text: As you know, the client originally wanted the app ready by the end of October.

p34/p4-024-03.mp3.text: Yesterday, though, they asked if we could launch it two weeks earlier, in time for their autumn sales event.

p34/p4-024-04.mp3.text: I know that's a tight deadline, especially since we're still fixing problems with the payment screen.

p34/p4-024-05.mp3.text: Well, Rachel's team just wrapped up their own project.

p34/p4-024-06.mp3.text: I've already spoken with her, and she's happy to lend us two of her developers.

p34/p4-024-07.mp3.text: So, this afternoon, I'd like each of you to send me a list of tasks that could be handed over to them.

p34/p4-024-08.mp3.text: That way, they can get started first thing tomorrow.

p34/p4-025-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming, everyone. I want to go over a change to our remote work policy.

p34/p4-025-02.mp3.text: Based on feedback from last month's employee survey, management has decided to allow staff to work from home up to two days a week.

p34/p4-025-03.mp3.text: This will begin on November first.

p34/p4-025-04.mp3.text: However, everyone will still need to be in the office on Wednesdays, since that's when we hold our weekly department meetings.

p34/p4-025-05.mp3.text: To request your remote days, please fill out the form on the HR portal and get approval from your supervisor.

p34/p4-025-06.mp3.text: We'll also be providing a one-time allowance of two hundred dollars to help you set up a home office.

p34/p4-025-07.mp3.text: If you have questions, Marcus from human resources will be available in his office all afternoon.

p34/p4-026-01.mp3.text: Before we finish, I want to share the results of the customer survey we ran at all five of our cafés last month.

p34/p4-026-02.mp3.text: More than eight hundred customers responded, which is far more than we expected.

p34/p4-026-03.mp3.text: As you can see on this chart, the most popular request was for longer opening hours.

p34/p4-026-04.mp3.text: Unfortunately, we just don't have enough staff to stay open later at the moment.

p34/p4-026-05.mp3.text: We will, however, be able to act on the second most popular request, starting next month.

p34/p4-026-06.mp3.text: Our IT contractor has already begun working on it.

p34/p4-026-07.mp3.text: In the meantime, I'd like you to think about how we could advertise this new service to our regular customers.

p34/p4-026-08.mp3.text: Please bring your suggestions to next Monday's meeting.

p34/p4-027-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone. I just have a couple of quick announcements.

p34/p4-027-02.mp3.text: First, the employee parking lot will be repaved next week, from Monday to Wednesday.

p34/p4-027-03.mp3.text: During that time, you can park in the public garage across the street.

p34/p4-027-04.mp3.text: The company will cover the cost, so just keep your parking receipts and give them to Linda at the front desk.

p34/p4-027-05.mp3.text: Second, I'm happy to tell you that our team won this year's regional customer service award.

p34/p4-027-06.mp3.text: To celebrate, we'll be having a catered lunch in the break room on Friday at noon.

p34/p4-027-07.mp3.text: Please let me know by Wednesday if you have any dietary restrictions.

p34/p4-028-01.mp3.text: Let's turn to the main item on today's agenda, which is warehouse safety.

p34/p4-028-02.mp3.text: Last quarter, we had four incidents where workers were hurt while lifting heavy boxes.

p34/p4-028-03.mp3.text: None were serious, but that's four too many.

p34/p4-028-04.mp3.text: So, starting next month, any item weighing over twenty-five kilograms must be moved with a lift or by two people.

p34/p4-028-05.mp3.text: We'll also be replacing the old hand carts on the loading dock with new ones that are easier to steer.

p34/p4-028-06.mp3.text: Shift supervisors will be responsible for making sure the new rule is followed.

p34/p4-028-07.mp3.text: I'd like to thank Ji-ho Park for researching how other warehouses handle this issue.

p34/p4-028-08.mp3.text: He'll be leading a short demonstration of proper lifting techniques right after this meeting.

p34/p4-029-01.mp3.text: I'd like to give you all a quick update on our new line of sports drinks.

p34/p4-029-02.mp3.text: Last week, we held two focus groups, and overall, people loved the taste.

p34/p4-029-03.mp3.text: The main complaint was about the bottle, which many participants found hard to open while exercising.

p34/p4-029-04.mp3.text: Our design team has already come up with a new cap that can be opened with one hand.

p34/p4-029-05.mp3.text: The good news is that this change shouldn't affect our launch date in March.

p34/p4-029-06.mp3.text: However, it will increase production costs slightly, so I'll be meeting with the finance department tomorrow to review the budget.

p34/p4-029-07.mp3.text: In the meantime, please keep the focus group results to yourselves, as we haven't shared them with our distributors yet.

p34/p4-030-01.mp3.text: Next, I want to talk about how we book business travel.

p34/p4-030-02.mp3.text: Until now, each department has made its own flight and hotel reservations.

p34/p4-030-03.mp3.text: But an audit found that we were often paying different prices for the same routes.

p34/p4-030-04.mp3.text: So, as of next quarter, all travel will be booked through Skyline Corporate Travel, an agency that has negotiated discounted rates with several airlines.

p34/p4-030-05.mp3.text: Requests should be submitted at least fourteen days before departure, unless the trip is for an urgent client matter.

p34/p4-030-06.mp3.text: I realize this adds an extra step, and some of you prefer choosing your own hotels.

p34/p4-030-07.mp3.text: You'll still be able to state a preference, and the agency will try to accommodate it within our budget limits.

p34/p4-030-08.mp3.text: An outline of the new procedure will be e-mailed to you this afternoon.

p34/p4-031-01.mp3.text: Is your living room ready for a fresh new look?

p34/p4-031-02.mp3.text: Then come to Brightwell Furniture, where our fifteenth anniversary sale starts this Friday.

p34/p4-031-03.mp3.text: For one week only, all sofas and dining tables are thirty percent off.

p34/p4-031-04.mp3.text: And if you spend more than five hundred dollars, we'll deliver your purchase for free.

p34/p4-031-05.mp3.text: Not sure what fits your space? Our design consultants can visit your home and take measurements at no cost.

p34/p4-031-06.mp3.say: Just call 5 5 5, 0 1 4 2 to book an appointment.
p34/p4-031-06.mp3.text: Just call 555-0142 to book an appointment.

p34/p4-031-07.mp3.text: Our showroom is open seven days a week, from ten in the morning until eight at night.

p34/p4-031-08.mp3.text: Brightwell Furniture is located on Maple Avenue, right across from Fenwick Park.

p34/p4-032-01.mp3.text: This is Doug Pressley with your morning traffic update on WRKT Radio.

p34/p4-032-02.mp3.text: Drivers heading downtown on Highway 9 should expect heavy delays this morning.

p34/p4-032-03.mp3.text: A truck has broken down in the left lane near the Carver Street exit, and crews are working to move it.

p34/p4-032-04.mp3.text: Until the lane reopens, traffic will be backed up for about three miles.

p34/p4-032-05.mp3.text: If you can, take Route 14 instead, which is moving smoothly right now.

p34/p4-032-06.mp3.text: Also, remember that the Lindell Bridge will be closed this weekend for scheduled repainting.

p34/p4-032-07.mp3.text: During the closure, drivers will be detoured to the Elm Street Bridge, about a mile to the north.

p34/p4-032-08.mp3.text: Now let's go to Karen Liu for the latest weather forecast.

p34/p4-033-01.mp3.text: Ridgeline Fitness is opening its third location, in the Eastgate Shopping Center, on June 1!

p34/p4-033-02.mp3.text: To celebrate, we're offering a special deal for anyone who joins at the new branch.

p34/p4-033-03.mp3.text: Our most popular plan, which usually costs sixty dollars a month, will be available for just forty dollars a month for your entire first year.

p34/p4-033-04.mp3.text: This plan gives you unlimited access to group fitness classes, the swimming pool, and our sauna.

p34/p4-033-05.mp3.text: On top of that, every new member receives two free sessions with a certified personal trainer.

p34/p4-033-06.mp3.text: This offer ends on June 30, so don't wait.

p34/p4-033-07.mp3.text: Visit www.ridgelinefitness.example to see the class schedule and sign up online.

p34/p4-034-01.mp3.text: In business news, Halvorsen Foods announced yesterday that it will build a new production facility just outside Millbrook.

p34/p4-034-02.mp3.text: The snack maker says the plant will create around three hundred jobs when it opens next spring.

p34/p4-034-03.mp3.text: The company had also considered sites in two neighboring states.

p34/p4-034-04.mp3.text: Company president Nadia Ferris said Millbrook's skilled workforce and highway access made the final decision easy.

p34/p4-034-05.mp3.text: Now, the city has been trying to attract new manufacturers for nearly a decade.

p34/p4-034-06.mp3.text: So, this is a big deal.

p34/p4-034-07.mp3.text: Halvorsen will hold a job fair at the Millbrook Convention Center on March 12 for anyone interested in applying.

p34/p4-034-08.mp3.text: Details are available on the company's Web site.

p34/p4-035-01.mp3.text: Are you too busy to drop off your dry cleaning?

p34/p4-035-02.mp3.text: Let Crestview Cleaners come to you!

p34/p4-035-03.mp3.text: With our new pickup service, a driver will collect your clothes from your home or office and return them, cleaned and pressed, within forty-eight hours.

p34/p4-035-04.mp3.text: Scheduling is easy with our mobile app, and you can track your order every step of the way.

p34/p4-035-05.mp3.text: Crestview has been serving the Palmer Heights area for over twenty years, and our customers trust us with everything from business suits to wedding dresses.

p34/p4-035-06.mp3.text: Download the app this month and get your first pickup free.

p34/p4-036-01.mp3.text: Good morning, this is Ryan Okafor with the KVLT weather forecast.

p34/p4-036-02.mp3.text: It's going to be a beautiful start to the week, with sunny skies and temperatures reaching the low seventies this afternoon.

p34/p4-036-03.mp3.text: But enjoy it while it lasts, because a storm system is moving in from the west.

p34/p4-036-04.mp3.text: We expect heavy rain to begin Tuesday evening and continue through Wednesday.

p34/p4-036-05.mp3.text: Because of the forecast, organizers of the Riverside Food Festival have moved the event from Wednesday to Saturday.

p34/p4-036-06.mp3.text: The good news is that the weekend looks dry and mild.

p34/p4-036-07.mp3.text: I'll be back at the top of the hour with your full five-day forecast.

p34/p4-037-01.mp3.text: Running a small business means wearing a lot of hats.

p34/p4-037-02.mp3.text: You're the manager, the salesperson, and, at the end of the month, the accountant.

p34/p4-037-04.mp3.text: Our online software tracks your expenses, sends invoices automatically, and prepares your tax forms in minutes.

p34/p4-037-05.mp3.text: Now, you might be thinking, I'm not good with computers.

p34/p4-037-06.mp3.text: Well, if you can send an e-mail, you can use SumSpring.

p34/p4-037-07.mp3.text: And if you ever have a question, our friendly support team is available by phone twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.

p34/p4-037-08.mp3.text: Try it free for sixty days at sumspring.example.com. No credit card required.

p34/p4-038-01.mp3.text: Welcome back to Local Matters on WBNX. I'm Grace Whitfield.

p34/p4-038-02.mp3.text: Last night, the Ashford City Council voted on how to spend this year's two-million-dollar improvement fund.

p34/p4-038-03.mp3.text: Earlier this year, the city asked residents which upgrades they wanted most, and more than a thousand people responded.

p34/p4-038-04.mp3.text: The top request won't need public money, since a private developer is already building a large parking garage downtown.

p34/p4-038-05.mp3.text: So the council chose to fund the residents' second choice, and work is expected to begin in August.

p34/p4-038-06.mp3.text: Some council members had argued for splitting the money among several smaller projects.

p34/p4-038-07.mp3.text: However, Mayor Daniel Hsu said that a single, well-funded project would have a bigger impact.

p34/p4-038-08.mp3.text: After the break, we'll talk with a resident who helped organize the survey.

p34/p4-039-01.mp3.text: If you work from home, you know how hard it can be to stay focused.

p34/p4-039-02.mp3.text: Between household chores and a noisy neighborhood, getting things done isn't always easy.

p34/p4-039-03.mp3.text: At Hartwell Commons, you can rent a desk in a quiet, professional workspace by the day, the week, or the month.

p34/p4-039-04.mp3.text: Every membership comes with high-speed Internet, free coffee, and access to our printing center.

p34/p4-039-05.mp3.text: Monthly members can also reserve one of our conference rooms for client meetings at no extra charge.

p34/p4-039-06.mp3.text: And unlike many shared offices, we're open around the clock, so night owls are welcome too.

p34/p4-039-07.mp3.text: Come see for yourself during our open house on Saturday, October 18, from ten to four.

p34/p4-039-08.mp3.text: Everyone who stops by will receive a complimentary one-day pass.

p34/p4-040-01.mp3.text: Turning to business news, electronics retailer Pembrook announced this morning that it will close twelve of its stores by the end of the year.

p34/p4-040-02.mp3.text: The company says more customers are now shopping on its Web site, and its large stores have become too costly to operate.

p34/p4-040-03.mp3.text: Instead, Pembrook plans to open smaller showrooms where shoppers can try out products before ordering them online.

p34/p4-040-04.mp3.text: Employees at the affected stores will be offered positions at the new showrooms or at the company's distribution centers.

p34/p4-040-05.mp3.text: Analysts had predicted much deeper cuts.

p34/p4-040-06.mp3.text: In fact, some expected the company to close half of its sixty locations.

p34/p4-040-07.mp3.text: Pembrook's stock rose four percent after the announcement.

p34/p4-040-08.mp3.text: We'll have more on this story at noon.

p34/p4-041-01.mp3.text: Spring is finally here, and Linwood Garden Center is ready to help you get your yard in shape!

p34/p4-041-02.mp3.text: Our annual spring sale runs from Thursday through Sunday, with a different category of products on sale each day.

p34/p4-041-03.mp3.text: And here's something special: on the day potted plants are discounted, our head gardener, Marcus Bell, will lead a free workshop on container gardening.

p34/p4-041-04.mp3.text: Space is limited to thirty people, so please sign up at our customer service desk in advance.

p34/p4-041-05.mp3.text: Also, if you're planning a large project, ask about our landscape design service.

p34/p4-041-06.mp3.text: Our designers will create a custom plan for your yard, and the design fee will be deducted from any plants you buy from us.

p34/p4-041-07.mp3.text: Linwood Garden Center, on Route 6 in Fairhaven.

p34/p4-042-01.mp3.text: This is Lena Morales with the WQRT evening news.

p34/p4-042-02.mp3.text: Starting next Monday, the Brayton Transit Authority will begin running express buses between the airport and the downtown business district.

p34/p4-042-03.mp3.text: The new service will run every fifteen minutes during rush hour and every half hour at other times.

p34/p4-042-04.mp3.text: Officials say the trip will take about twenty-five minutes, roughly half the time of the current local route.

p34/p4-042-05.mp3.text: To mark the launch, all rides on the express line will be free during its first week.

p34/p4-042-06.mp3.text: After that, the regular fare of three dollars will apply.

p34/p4-042-07.mp3.text: Riders can find the full timetable at brayton-transit.example.com or at any downtown station.

p34/p4-043-01.mp3.text: Is your old refrigerator costing you money every month?

p34/p4-043-02.mp3.text: Older appliances can use twice as much electricity as today's energy-efficient models.

p34/p4-043-03.mp3.text: That's why Corbin Appliance Outlet is launching its Trade Up program.

p34/p4-043-04.mp3.text: Trade in your old refrigerator, washer, or dryer, and we'll take up to two hundred dollars off the price of a new model.

p34/p4-043-05.mp3.text: We'll even remove your old appliance and recycle it, free of charge, when we deliver your new one.

p34/p4-043-06.mp3.text: That means no heavy lifting and no trips to the dump for you.

p34/p4-043-07.mp3.text: The Trade Up program runs through the end of August at all four of our locations.

p34/p4-043-08.mp3.text: Visit corbin-appliance.example.com to find the store nearest you.

p34/p4-044-01.mp3.text: And now for the business report.

p34/p4-044-02.mp3.text: Figures released today by the Harbor City Tourism Board show that the number of visitors to the city rose by eleven percent last year, setting a new record.

p34/p4-044-03.mp3.text: The board credits the increase largely to the reopening of the waterfront convention center, which hosted more than forty international events.

p34/p4-044-04.mp3.text: Hotels have clearly benefited, with occupancy rates averaging above ninety percent during the summer.

p34/p4-044-06.mp3.text: Some restaurant owners in the old town district say they've had trouble hiring enough staff to keep up with demand.

p34/p4-044-07.mp3.text: To address the issue, the tourism board will hold a hospitality job fair next month in partnership with Harbor City Community College.

p34/p4-044-08.mp3.text: I'm Priya Natarajan, and that's your business update.

p34/p4-045-01.mp3.text: This fall, the Calloway Playhouse presents its most exciting season yet, with five brand-new productions, from comedies to classic dramas.

p34/p4-045-02.mp3.text: And the best way to enjoy them all is with a season subscription.

p34/p4-045-03.mp3.text: Subscribers save up to twenty-five percent compared to buying individual tickets.

p34/p4-045-04.mp3.text: They also get to choose their seats before tickets go on sale to the general public.

p34/p4-045-05.mp3.text: And if your plans change, you can exchange your tickets for another performance date at no charge.

p34/p4-045-06.mp3.text: Subscriptions are on sale now, but only until September 15.

p34/p4-045-07.mp3.text: After that, tickets for each show will be sold separately.

p34/p4-045-08.mp3.say: Call our box office at 5 5 5, 0 1 8 7, and our staff will help you find the package that suits your schedule.
p34/p4-045-08.mp3.text: Call our box office at 555-0187, and our staff will help you find the package that suits your schedule.

p34/p4-046-01.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the second day of the Midwest Logistics Forum.

p34/p4-046-02.mp3.text: I'm Daniel Ferreira, and I'll be your host for this morning's sessions.

p34/p4-046-03.mp3.text: It's my pleasure to introduce our keynote speaker, Dr. Helen Okafor.

p34/p4-046-04.mp3.text: Dr. Okafor spent fifteen years designing warehouse systems before founding her own consulting firm, Brightpath Supply Solutions.

p34/p4-046-05.mp3.text: Last year, she published a widely read book on reducing delivery delays in rural areas.

p34/p4-046-06.mp3.text: Today, she'll be sharing some of the practical strategies from that book.

p34/p4-046-07.mp3.text: After her talk, copies will be available for purchase at the registration desk, and Dr. Okafor has kindly agreed to sign them.

p34/p4-046-08.mp3.text: Please join me in giving her a warm welcome.

p34/p4-047-01.mp3.text: Thank you all for coming to the Harborview Hotel's annual staff appreciation dinner.

p34/p4-047-02.mp3.text: Tonight, we're presenting our Employee of the Year award to someone many of you know well, Marcus Bell from our front desk team.

p34/p4-047-03.mp3.text: This year, Marcus trained six new receptionists and wrote a check-in guide that's now used at all four of our locations.

p34/p4-047-04.mp3.text: He also received more positive mentions in guest reviews than any other staff member.

p34/p4-047-05.mp3.text: And when our reservation system went down during the busiest weekend of the summer, Marcus checked guests in by hand for nine hours straight.

p34/p4-047-06.mp3.text: Believe me, that's not in the job description.

p34/p4-047-07.mp3.text: As a token of our appreciation, Marcus will receive an extra week of paid vacation.

p34/p4-047-08.mp3.text: Marcus, please come up and say a few words.

p34/p4-048-01.mp3.text: If I could have everyone's attention for a few minutes, please.

p34/p4-048-02.mp3.text: As most of you know, today is Patricia Gomez's last day with Larkfield Engineering after twenty-six years.

p34/p4-048-03.mp3.text: Patricia joined us as a drafting assistant when we had only twelve employees, and she's retiring as our director of operations.

p34/p4-048-04.mp3.text: Along the way, she led our move to the current headquarters and launched the internship program that brought many of you here.

p34/p4-048-05.mp3.text: Patricia tells me she plans to spend a lot of her free time sailing with her husband.

p34/p4-048-06.mp3.text: But she isn't leaving us entirely. She's agreed to serve as an adviser on our bridge project in Clayton next spring.

p34/p4-048-07.mp3.text: To thank her, we've put together a photo album filled with messages from all of you, which I'll present to her now.

p34/p4-049-01.mp3.text: Good evening, and thank you for joining us to celebrate Fenwick Foods' fiftieth anniversary.

p34/p4-049-02.mp3.text: As the timeline in your program shows, we've come a long way since our founder, Rosa Fenwick, opened a single bakery.

p34/p4-049-03.mp3.text: Of all these milestones, the one that means the most to me is the year we first sold our products outside the country.

p34/p4-049-04.mp3.text: That's because it's the year I joined the company as a sales representative.

p34/p4-049-05.mp3.text: Back then, our international team was just three people working out of a storage room.

p34/p4-049-06.mp3.text: Today, our products are sold in eleven countries, and we employ more than two thousand people.

p34/p4-049-07.mp3.text: To mark this anniversary, we're establishing a scholarship fund for students of food science, and details on how to apply will be posted on our Web site next week.

p34/p4-050-01.mp3.text: Welcome to Cedar Valley Medical Center, and congratulations on joining our nursing staff.

p34/p4-050-02.mp3.text: My name is Jonathan Pryce, and I'm the director of human resources.

p34/p4-050-03.mp3.text: Today's orientation will run until four o'clock, and lunch will be provided in the cafeteria at noon.

p34/p4-050-04.mp3.text: This morning, you'll receive your employee ID badges and take a tour of the main building.

p34/p4-050-05.mp3.text: In the afternoon, a senior nurse from each department will explain the procedures you'll follow on your units.

p34/p4-050-06.mp3.text: Before we begin, please check that your name is spelled correctly on the sign-in sheet that's being passed around.

p34/p4-050-07.mp3.text: That's exactly how it will be printed on your badge.

p34/p4-051-01.mp3.text: Good evening, and thank you for coming out to the Westbrook Public Library on such a rainy night.

p34/p4-051-02.mp3.text: I'm Anita Rao, and I coordinate our monthly Local Voices lecture series.

p34/p4-051-03.mp3.text: Tonight's guest is Samuel Okoye, an architect who has spent the last decade restoring historic buildings across our region.

p34/p4-051-04.mp3.text: You may know his work even if you don't know his name. He led the renovation of the old train station that's now home to the Westbrook Art Center.

p34/p4-051-05.mp3.text: When I first invited Samuel to speak here, he told me he'd much rather be on a scaffold than on a stage.

p34/p4-051-06.mp3.text: Well, it took three phone calls.

p34/p4-051-07.mp3.text: Samuel will speak for about forty minutes, and then we'll open the floor to questions.

p34/p4-051-08.mp3.text: Since we're recording tonight's lecture for the library's Web site, please use the microphone in the aisle when asking yours.

p34/p4-052-01.mp3.text: Good evening, and welcome to the Riverside Chamber of Commerce's annual Small Business Awards.

p34/p4-052-02.mp3.text: Our final award tonight, for Outstanding Community Service, goes to Greenleaf Cafe and its owner, Mei Lin Tan.

p34/p4-052-03.mp3.text: Over the past year, Greenleaf donated more than three thousand meals to local shelters.

p34/p4-052-04.mp3.text: Ms. Tan also opened her cafe after hours to host free cooking classes for teenagers.

p34/p4-052-05.mp3.text: Unfortunately, she couldn't be with us tonight because she's attending a family wedding overseas.

p34/p4-052-06.mp3.text: Accepting the award on her behalf is her head chef, Robert Diaz.

p34/p4-052-07.mp3.text: Before Robert comes up, I'd like to remind everyone that photos from tonight's ceremony will be posted on the chamber's social media pages tomorrow.

p34/p4-053-01.mp3.text: On behalf of everyone at Norvale Textiles, I'd like to welcome our visitors from Kasuga Fabrics in Osaka.

p34/p4-053-02.mp3.text: We're delighted to host you for this three-day visit as we begin our new partnership.

p34/p4-053-03.mp3.text: As you know, our two companies will be developing a line of outdoor clothing made from recycled materials.

p34/p4-053-04.mp3.text: This afternoon, our production manager, Gary Holt, will show you around our dyeing facility.

p34/p4-053-05.mp3.text: Tomorrow, you'll meet with our design team to review the first samples.

p34/p4-053-06.mp3.text: And on Friday, we'll wrap up your visit with a dinner cruise on the river, weather permitting.

p34/p4-053-07.mp3.text: If you need anything during your stay, my assistant, Leah Kim, can be reached at extension 214.

p34/p4-054-02.mp3.text: Before we get started, I need to make a change to this afternoon's schedule.

p34/p4-054-03.mp3.text: Ms. Harlow, who's leading the e-mail writing session, just called to say she's stuck in heavy traffic.

p34/p4-054-04.mp3.text: She doesn't expect to get here for at least another two hours.

p34/p4-054-05.mp3.text: So we're going to switch her session with the one that comes right after it.

p34/p4-054-06.mp3.text: For now, though, we'll start with handling complaints as planned.

p34/p4-054-07.mp3.text: Please take out the worksheet in the blue folder on your table, since we'll be using it throughout this session.

p34/p4-054-08.mp3.text: We'll take a short break at around two-fifty, and coffee will be available in the lobby.

p34/p4-055-01.mp3.text: Good morning, and thanks for coming to this short training on our new expense reporting software.

p34/p4-055-02.mp3.text: Starting next month, all travel expenses must be submitted through this system instead of on paper forms.

p34/p4-055-03.mp3.text: First, log in with the same username and password you use for your company e-mail.

p34/p4-055-04.mp3.text: Next, click 'New Report' and enter the dates and purpose of your trip.

p34/p4-055-05.mp3.text: Then take a photo of each receipt with your phone and upload it directly to the report.

p34/p4-055-06.mp3.text: When you're finished, submit the report to your manager for approval.

p34/p4-055-07.mp3.text: Most expenses are reimbursed within five business days.

p34/p4-055-08.mp3.text: Now, please open the laptops in front of you, and let's create a sample report together.

p34/p4-056-01.mp3.text: Thank you for signing up for today's seminar on marketing for small businesses.

p34/p4-056-02.mp3.text: I know most of you run shops on tight budgets, so I won't be talking about expensive television campaigns.

p34/p4-056-03.mp3.text: Instead, I'll focus on one thing: getting your existing customers to bring in new ones.

p34/p4-056-04.mp3.text: Studies show that people trust recommendations from friends far more than any advertisement.

p34/p4-056-05.mp3.text: One bakery I worked with offered a free pastry to every customer who referred a friend, and its sales rose by thirty percent in six months.

p34/p4-056-06.mp3.text: In a few minutes, I'll ask you to work in pairs to design a similar program for your own business.

p34/p4-056-07.mp3.text: But first, write down the three things your customers praise most often, because that's where every good referral program begins.

p34/p4-057-01.mp3.text: Okay, everyone, gather around so you can all see the forklift.

p34/p4-057-02.mp3.text: In this part of the training, I'll show you the safety check you'll need to complete at the start of every shift.

p34/p4-057-03.mp3.text: First, walk around the forklift and look for any leaks or damage to the tires.

p34/p4-057-04.mp3.text: Then get in the driver's seat and test the horn, the lights, and the brakes.

p34/p4-057-05.mp3.text: Record the results on the checklist attached to the clipboard by the charging station.

p34/p4-057-06.mp3.text: Last year, a driver here skipped this check and ran into a shelf because of a brake problem.

p34/p4-057-07.mp3.text: That shelf held our entire stock of glassware.

p34/p4-057-08.mp3.text: Now, Kevin, why don't you try the check first while the rest of us watch?

p34/p4-058-01.mp3.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the second session of our workshop for facility managers.

p34/p4-058-02.mp3.text: On the screen is a chart showing how energy is typically used in an office building.

p34/p4-058-03.mp3.text: Most people assume they should start with the largest category, but upgrading heating and cooling systems usually requires a major investment.

p34/p4-058-04.mp3.text: So today, I'm going to focus on the second-largest category, since you can reduce it quickly at very little cost.

p34/p4-058-05.mp3.text: One of my clients in Portland made a few simple changes last spring and cut her usage in that category by a third in just two months.

p34/p4-058-06.mp3.text: I've put a list of the products she used in your handout, along with what each one costs.

p34/p4-058-07.mp3.text: Take a minute to look it over, and then I'll walk you through the changes one by one.

p34/p4-059-01.mp3.text: Welcome to the Sunday baking class here at Maple Street Kitchen.

p34/p4-059-02.mp3.text: Today, we're making whole-wheat bread, and by the end of the class, each of you will take home your own loaf.

p34/p4-059-03.mp3.text: You'll find that all the ingredients have already been measured out for you at your stations.

p34/p4-059-04.mp3.text: The most important step is kneading the dough, so I'll demonstrate that first.

p34/p4-059-05.mp3.text: Make sure you knead for at least ten minutes, or your bread won't rise properly.

p34/p4-059-06.mp3.text: While the dough rests, we'll have coffee in the dining area next door.

p34/p4-059-07.mp3.text: Oh, and before you touch any ingredients, please wash your hands at the sink in the back.

p34/p4-060-01.mp3.text: Thanks for coming to this workshop for new team leaders. Today's topic is giving feedback to your staff.

p34/p4-060-02.mp3.text: Many new managers wait until the annual review to discuss performance, but by then, small problems have often become big ones.

p34/p4-060-03.mp3.text: That's why I recommend holding short one-on-one meetings every two weeks.

p34/p4-060-04.mp3.text: Keep them to about fifteen minutes, and always begin by asking employees what's going well for them.

p34/p4-060-05.mp3.text: Then move on to one area for improvement. Just one, so the conversation stays focused.

p34/p4-060-06.mp3.text: Later this morning, you'll practice with a partner using the scenarios printed on these cards.

p34/p4-060-07.mp3.text: Before that, though, our HR director, Ms. Abernathy, is going to join us to explain the new review forms.
